8.5.d: दूरादिहेव यत सत्यरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत | वि भानुं विश्वधातनत ||
8.5.e: WHEN, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away,  She spreadeth light on every side.

8.5.d: नर्वद दस्रा मनोयुजा रथेन पर्थुपाजसा | सचेथे अश्विनोषसम ||
8.5.e: Like Heroes on your will-yoked car farshining, Wonder-Workers! ye  Attend, O Aśvins, on the Dawn.

8.5.d: युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू परति सतोम अद्र्क्षत | वाचं दूतोयथोहिषे ||
8.5.e: By you, O Lords of ample wealth our songs of praise have been observed:  As envoy have I brought the prayer.

8.5.d: पुरुप्रिया ण ऊतये पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू | सतुषे कण्वासोश्विना ||
8.5.e: Kaṇvas must praise the Aśvins dear to many, making many glad,  Most rich, that they may succour us.

8.5.d: मंहिष्ठा वाजसातमेषयन्ता शुभस पती | गन्तारा दाशुषो गर्हम ||
8.5.e: Most liberal, best at winning strength, inciters, Lords of splendour who  Visit the worshipper's abode.

8.5.d: ता सुदेवाय दाशुषे सुमेधामवितारिणीम | घर्तैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम ||
8.5.e: So for devout Sudeva dew with fatness his unfailing mead,  And make it rich for sacrifice.

8.5.d: आ न सतोममुप दरवत तूयं शयेनेभिराशुभिः | यातमश्वेभिरश्विना ||
8.5.e: Hitherward running speedily with horses, as with rapid hawks,  Come, Aśvins, to our song of praise

8.5.d: येभिस्तिस्रः परावतो दिवो विश्वानि रोचना | तरीन्रक्तून परिदीयथः ||
8.5.e: Wherewith the three wide distances, and all the lights that are in heaven.  Ye traverse, and three times of night.

8.5.d: उत नो गोमतीरिष उत सातीरहर्विदा | वि पथः सातये सितम ||
8.5.e: O Finders of the Day, that we may win us food of kine and wealth,  Open the paths for us to tread.

8.5.d: आ नो गोमन्तमश्विना सुवीरं सुरथं रयिम | वोळ्हमश्वावतीरिषः ||
8.5.e: O Aśvins, bring us wealth in kine, in noble heroes, and in cars:  Bring us the strength that horses give.

8.5.d: वाव्र्धाना शुभस पती दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी | पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ||
8.5.e: Ye Lords of splendour, glorified, ye Wonder-Workers borne on paths  Of gold, drink sweets with Somajuice.

8.5.d: अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवसू मघवद्भ्यश्च सप्रथः | छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यम ||
8.5.e: To us, ye Lords of ample wealth, and to our wealth chiefs extend  Wide shelter, ne’er to be assailed.

8.5.d: नि षु बरह्म जनानां याविष्टं तूयमा गतम | मो षवन्यानुपारतम ||
8.5.e: Come quickly downward to the prayer of people whom ye favour most:  Approach not unto other folk.

8.5.d: अस्य पिबतमश्विना युवं मदस्य चारुणः | मध्वो रातस्यधिष्ण्या ||
8.5.e: Ye Aśvins whom our minds perceive, drink of this lovely gladdening draught,  The mcath which we present to you.

8.5.d: अस्मे आ वहतं रयिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम | पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम ||
8.5.e: Bring riches hither unto us in hundreds and in thousands, source  Of plenteous food, sustaining all.

8.5.d: पुरुत्रा चिद धि वां नरा विह्वयन्ते मनीषिणः | वाघद्भिरश्विना गतम ||
8.5.e: Verily sages call on you, ye Heroes, in full many a place.  Moved by the priests, O Aśvins, conic.

8.5.d: जनासो वर्क्तबर्हिषो हविष्मन्तो अरंक्र्तः | युवां हवन्ते अश्विना ||
8.5.e: Men who have trimmed the sacred grass, bringing oblations and prepared,  O Aśvins, are invoking you.

8.5.d: अस्माकमद्य वामयं सतोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः | युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ||
8.5.e: May this our hymn of praise to-day, most powerful to bring you, be,  O Aśvins, nearest to your hearts.

8.5.d: यो ह वां मधुनो दर्तिराहितो रथचर्षणे | ततः पिबतमश्विना ||
8.5.e: The skin filled full of savoury meath, laid in the pathway of your car-  O Aśvins, drink ye both therefrom.

8.5.d: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू पश्वे तोकाय शं गवे | वहतं पीवरीरिषः ||
8.5.e: For this, ye Lords of ample wealth, bring blessing for our herd, our kine,  Our progeny, and plenteous food.

8.5.d: उत नो दिव्या इष उत सिन्धून्रहर्विदा | अप दवारेव वर्षथः ||
8.5.e: Ye too unclose to us like doors the strengthening waters of the sky,  And rivers, ye who find the day.

8.5.d: कदा वां तौग्र्यो विधत समुद्रे जहितो नरा | यद वां रथो विभिष पतात ||
8.5.e: When did the son of Tugra serve you, Men? Abandoned in the sea,  That with winged steeds your car might fly.

8.5.d: युवं कण्वाय नासत्यापिरिप्ताय हर्म्ये | शश्वदूतीर्दशस्यथः ||
8.5.e: Ye, O Nāsatyas, ministered to Kaṇva with repeated aid,  When cast into the heated pit.

8.5.d: ताभिरा यातमूतिभिर्नव्यसीभिः सुशस्तिभिः | यद वां वर्षण्वसू हुवे ||
8.5.e: Come near with those most recent aids of yours which merit eulogy,  When I invoke you, Wealthy Gods.

8.5.d: यथा चित कण्वमावतं परियमेधमुपस्तुतम | अत्रिं शिञ्जारमश्विना ||
8.5.e: As ye protected Kaṇva erst, Priyamedha and Upastuta,  Atri, Sinjara, Aśvins Twain

8.5.d: यथोत कर्त्व्ये धने.अंशुं गोष्वगस्त्यम | यथा वाजेषु सोभरिम ||
8.5.e: And Amsu in decisive fight, Agastya in the fray for kine.  And, in his battles, Sobhari.

8.5.d: एतावद वां वर्षण्वसू अतो वा भूयो अश्विना | गर्णन्तः सुम्नमीमहे ||
8.5.e: For so much bliss, or even more, O Aśvins, Wealthy Gods, than this,  We pray white singing hymns to you.

8.5.d: रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरं हिरण्याभीशुमश्विना | आ हि सथाथो दिविस्प्र्शम ||
8.5.e: Ascend your car with golden seat, O Aśvins, and with reins of gold,  That reaches even to the sky.

8.5.d: हिरण्ययी वां रभिरीषा अक्षो हिरण्ययः | उभा चक्रा हिरण्यया ||
8.5.e: Golden is its supporting shaft, the axle also is of gold,  And both the wheels are made of gold.

8.5.d: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू परावतश्चिदा गतम | उपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ||
8.5.e: Thereon, ye Lords of ample wealth, come to us even from afar,  Come ye to this mine eulogy.

8.5.d: आ वहेथे पराकात पूर्वीरश्नन्तावश्विना | इषो दासीरमर्त्या ||
8.5.e: From far away ye come to us, Aśvins, enjoying plenteous food  Of Dāsas, O Immortal Ones.

8.5.d: आ नो दयुम्नैरा शरवोभिरा राया यातमश्विना | पुरुश्चन्द्रा नासत्या ||
8.5.e: With splendour, riches, and renown, O Aśvins, hither come to us,  Nāsatyas, shining brilliantly.

8.5.d: एह वां परुषितप्सवो वयो वहन्तु पर्णिनः | अछा सवध्वरं जनम ||
8.5.e: May dappled horses, steeds who fly with pinions, bring you hitherward  To people skilled in sacrifice.

8.5.d: रथं वामनुगायसं य इषा वर्तते सह | न चक्रमभि बाधते ||
8.5.e: The whcel delayeth not that car of yours accompanied by song,  That cometh with a store of food.

8.5.d: हिरण्ययेन रथेन दरवत्पाणिभिरश्वैः | धीजवना नासत्या ||
8.5.e: Borne on that chariot wrought of gold, with coursers very fleet of foot,  Come, O Nāsatyas, swift as thought.

8.5.d: युवं मर्गं जाग्र्वांसं सवदथो वा वर्षण्वसू | ता नःप्र्ङकतमिषा रयिम ||
8.5.e: O Wealthy Gods, ye taste and find the brisk and watchful wild beast good.  Associate wealth with food for us.

8.5.d: ता मे अश्विना सनीनां विद्यातं नवानाम | यथा चिच्चैद्यः कशुः शतमुष्ट्रानां ददत सहस्रा दश गोनाम ||
8.5.e: As such, O Aśvins, find for me my share of new-presented gifts,  As Kasu, Cedi's son, gave me a hundred head of buffaloes, and ten thousand kine.

8.5.d: यो मे हिरण्यसन्द्र्शो दश राज्ञो अमंहत | अधस्पदा इच्चैद्यस्य कर्ष्टयश्चर्मम्ना अभितो जनाः ||
8.5.e: He who hath given me for mine own ten Kings like gold to look upon.  At Caidya's feet are all the people round about, all those who think upon the shield.

8.5.d: माकिरेना पथा गाद येनेमे यन्ति चेदयः | अन्यो नेत सूरिरोहते भूरिदावत्तरो जनः ||
8.5.e: No man, not any, goes upon the path on which the Cedis walk.  No other prince, no folk is held more liberal of gifts than they.

8.6.d: महानिन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वर्ष्टिमानिव | सतोमैर्वत्सस्य वाव्र्धे ||
8.6.e: INDRA, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain,  Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds.

8.6.d: परजां रतस्य पिप्रतः पर यद भरन्त वह्नयः | विप्रा रतस्य वाहसा ||
8.6.e: When the priests, strengthening the Son of Holy Law, present their gifts,  Singers with Order's hymn of praiser.

8.6.d: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत सतोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम | जामिब्रुवत आयुधम ||
8.6.e: Since Kaṇvas with their lauds have made Indra complete the sacrifice.  Words are their own appropriate arms.

8.6.d: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कर्ष्टयः | समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ||
8.6.e: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men, bow down,  As rivers bow them to the sea.

8.6.d: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यद समवर्तयत | इन्द्रश्चर्मेवरोदसी ||
8.6.e: This power of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like  A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.

8.6.d: वि चिद वर्त्रस्य दोधतो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा | शिरो बिभेदव्र्ष्णिना ||
8.6.e: The fiercely-moving Vṛtra's head he severed with his thunderbolt,  His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.

8.6.d: इमा अभि पर णोनुमो विपामग्रेषु धीतयः | अग्नेः शोचिर्न दिद्युतः ||
8.6.e: Here are-we sing them loudly forth-our thoughts among-the best of songs.  Even lightnings like the blaze of fire.

8.6.d: गुहा सतीरुप तमना पर यच्छोचन्त धीतयः | कण्वार्तस्य धारया ||
8.6.e: When bidden thoughts, spontaneously advancing, glow, and with the stream  Of sacrifice the Kaṇvas shine.

8.6.d: पर तमिन्द्र नशीमहि रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम | पर बरह्मपूर्वचित्तये ||
8.6.e: Indra, may we obtain that wealth in horses and in herds of cows,  And prayer that may be noticed first.

8.6.d: अहमिद धि पितुष परि मेधां रतस्य जग्रभ | अहं सूर्य इवाजनि ||
8.6.e: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of the Holy Law  I was born like unto the Sun.

8.6.d: अहं परत्नेन मन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत | येनेन्द्रःशुष्ममिद दधे ||
8.6.e: After the lore of ancient time I make, like Kaṇva, beauteous songs,  And Indra's selfgains strength thereby.

8.6.d: ये तवामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुरषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः | ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ||
8.6.e: Whatever Ṛṣis have not praised thee, Indra, or have lauded thee,  By me exalted wax thou strong.

8.6.d: यदस्य मन्युरध्वनीद वि वर्त्रं पर्वशो रुजन | अपः समुद्रमैरयत ||
8.6.e: When his wrath thundered, when he rent Vṛtra to pieces, limb by limb,  He sent the waters to the sea.

8.6.d: नि शुष्ण इन्द्र धर्णसिं वज्रं जघन्थ दस्यवि | वर्षाह्युग्र शर्ण्विषे ||
8.6.e: Against the Dasyu gusna thou, Indra, didst hurl thy during bolt:  Thou, Dread one, hast a hero's fame.

8.6.d: न दयाव इन्द्रमोजसा नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम | न विव्यचन्त भूमयः ||
8.6.e: Neither the heavens nor firmaments nor regions of the earth contain  Indra, the Thunderer with his might.

8.6.d: यस्त इन्द्र महीरप सतभूयमान आशयत | नि तं पद्यासु शिश्नथः ||
8.6.e: O Indra him who lay at length staying thy copious waters thou,  In his own footsteps, smotest down

8.6.d: य इमे रोदसी मही समीची समजग्रभीत | तमोभिरिन्द्र तं गुहः ||
8.6.e: Thou hiddest deep in darkness itim, O Indra, who had set his grasp  On spacious heaven and earth conjoined.

8.6.d: य इन्द्र यतयस्त्वा भर्गवो ये च तुष्टुवुः | ममेदुग्र शरुधी हवम ||
8.6.e: Indra, whatever Yatis and Bhṛgus have offered praise to thee,  Listen, thou Mighty, to my call.

8.6.d: इमास्त इन्द्र पर्श्नयो घर्तं दुहत आशिरम | एनां रतस्य पिप्युषीः ||
8.6.e: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught;  Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice;

8.6.d: या इन्द्र परस्वस्त्वासा गर्भमचक्रिरन | परि धर्मेव सूर्यम ||
8.6.e: Which, teeming, have received thee as a life-germ, Indra, with their mouth,  Like Sūrya who sustaineth all.

8.6.d: तवामिच्छवसस पते कण्वा उक्थेन वाव्र्धुः | तवां सुतास इन्दवः ||
8.6.e: O Lord of Might, with hymns of praise the Kaṇvas have increased thy power,  The drops poured forth have strengthened thee.

8.6.d: तवेदिन्द्र परणीतिषूत परशस्तिरद्रिवः | यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः ||
8.6.e: Under thy guidance, Indra, mid thy praises, Lord of Thunder, shall  The sacrifice be soon performed.

8.6.d: आ न इन्द्र महीमिषं पुरं न दर्षि गोमतीम | उत परजां सुवीर्यम ||
8.6.e: Indra, disclose much food for us, like a stronghold with store of kine:  Give progeny and heroic strength.

8.6.d: उत तयदाश्वश्व्यं यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा | अग्रे विक्षुप्रदीदयत ||
8.6.e: And, Indra, grant us all that wealth of fleet steeds which shone bright of old  Among the tribes of Nahusas.

8.6.d: अभि वरजं न तत्निषे सूर उपाकचक्षसम | यदिन्द्र मर्ळयासि नः ||
8.6.e: Hither thou seemest to attract heaven's fold which shines before our eyes,  When, Indra, thou art kind to us.

8.6.d: यदङग तविषीयस इन्द्र परराजसि कषितीः | महानपार ओजसा ||
8.6.e: Yea, when thou puttest forth thy power, Indra, thou governest the folk.  Mighty, unlimited in strength.

8.6.d: तं तवा हविष्मतीर्विश उप बरुवत ऊतये | उरुज्रयसमिन्दुभिः ||
8.6.e: The tribes who bring oblations call to thee, to thee to give them help,  With drops to thee who spreadest far.

8.6.d: उपह्वरे गिरीणां संगथे च नदीनाम | धिया विप्रो अजायत ||
8.6.e: There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams  The Sage was manifest with song.

8.6.d: अतः समुद्रमुद्वतश्चिकित्वानव पश्यति | यतो विपान एजति ||
8.6.e: Thence, marking, from his lofty place downward he looks upon the sea,  And thence with rapid stir he moves.

8.6.d: आदित परत्नस्य रेतसो जयोतिष पश्यन्ति वासरम | परो यदिध्यते दिवा ||
8.6.e: Then, verify, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed,  Kindled on yonder side of heaven.

8.6.d: कण्वास इन्द्र ते मतिं विश्वे वर्धन्ति पौंस्यम | उतो शविष्ठ वर्ष्ण्यम ||
8.6.e: Indra, the Kaṇvas all exalt thy wisdom and thy manly power,  And, Mightiest! thine heroic strength.

8.6.d: इमां म इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं जुषस्व पर सु मामव | उत परवर्धया मतिम ||
8.6.e: Accept this eulogy of mine, Indra, and guard me carefully:  Strengthen my thought and prosper it.

8.6.d: उत बरह्मण्या वयं तुभ्यं परव्र्द्ध वज्रिवः | विप्रा अतक्ष्म जीवसे ||
8.6.e: For thee, O Mighty, Thunder-armed, we singers through devotionhave  Fashioned the hymn that we may live.

8.6.d: अभि कण्वा अनूषतापो न परवता यतीः | इन्द्रं वनन्वती मतिः ||
8.6.e: To Indra have the Kaṇvas sung, like waters speeding down a slope:  The song is fain to go to him.

8.6.d: इन्द्रमुक्थानि वाव्र्धुः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः | अनुत्तमन्युमजरम ||
8.6.e: As rivers swell the ocean, so our hymns of praise make Indra strong,  Eternal, of resistIess wrath.

8.6.d: आ नो याहि परावतो हरिभ्यां हर्यताभ्याम | इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ||
8.6.e: Come with thy lovely Bay Steeds, come to us from regions far away  O Indra, drink this Soma juice.

8.6.d: तवामिद वर्त्रहन्तम जनासो वर्क्तबर्हिषः | हवन्ते वाजसातये ||
8.6.e: Best slayer of Vṛtras, men whose sacred grass is ready trimmed  Invoke thee for the gain of spoil.

8.6.d: अनु तवा रोदसी उभे चक्रं न वर्त्येतशम | अनु सुवानास इन्दवः ||
8.6.e: The heavens and earth come after thee as the wheel follows Etaśa:  To thee flow Soma-drops effused.

8.6.d: मन्दस्वा सु सवर्णर उतेन्द्र शर्यणावति | मत्स्वा विवस्वतो मती ||
8.6.e: Rejoice, O Indra, in the light, rejoice in Saryandyan, be Glad in the sacrificer's hymn.

8.6.d: वाव्र्धान उप दयवि वर्षा वज्र्यरोरवीत | वर्त्रहा सोमपातमः ||
8.6.e: Grown strong in heaven, the Thunder-armed hath bellowed, Vṛtra-slayer, Bull,  Chief drinker of the Soma juice.

8.6.d: रषिर्हि पूर्वजा अस्येक ईशान ओजसा | इन्द्र चोष्कूयसे वसु ||
8.6.e: Thou art a Ṛṣi born of old, sole Ruler over all by might:  Thou, Indra, guardest well our wealth.

8.6.d: अस्माकं तवा सुतानुप वीतप्र्ष्ठा अभि परयः | शतंवहन्तु हरयः ||
8.6.e: May thy Bay Steeds with beauteous backs, a hundred, bring thee to the feast,  Bring thee to these our Soma-draughts.

8.6.d: इमां सु पूर्व्यां धियं मधोर्घ्र्तस्य पिप्युषीम | कण्वा उक्थेन वाव्र्धुः ||
8.6.e: The Kaṇvas with their hymns of praise have magnified this ancient thought  That swells with streams of meath and oil.

8.6.d: इन्द्रमिद विमहीनां मेधे वर्णीत मर्त्यः | इन्द्रं सनिष्युरूतये ||
8.6.e: Mid mightiest Gods let mortal man choose Indra at the sacrifice,  Indra, whoe’er would win, for help.

8.6.d: अर्वाञ्चं तवा पुरुष्टुत परियमेधस्तुता हरी | सोमपेयायवक्षतः ||
8.6.e: Thy steeds, by Priyamedhas praised, shall bring thee, God whom all invoke,  Hither to drink the Somajuice.

8.6.d: शतमहं तिरिन्दिरे सहस्रं पर्शावा ददे | राधांसियाद्वानाम ||
8.6.e: A hundred thousand have I gained from Parsu, from Tirindira,  And presents of the Yadavas.

8.6.d: तरीणि शतान्यर्वतां सहस्रा दश गोनाम | ददुष पज्राय साम्ने ||
8.6.e: Ten thousand head of kine, and steeds three times a hundred they bestowed  On Pajra for the Sāma-song.

8.6.d: उदानट ककुहो दिवमुष्ट्राञ्चतुर्युजो ददत | शरवसा याद्वं जनम ||
8.6.e: Kakuha hath reached up to heaven, bestowing buffaloes yoked in fours,  And matched in fame the Yadavas.

8.7.d: पर यद वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मरुतो विप्रो अक्षरत | वि पर्वतेषु राजथ ||
8.7.e: O MARUTS, when the sage hath poured the Tṛṣṭup forth as food for you,  Ye shine amid the mountain-clouds.

8.7.d: यदङग तविषीयवो यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम | नि पर्वता अहासत ||
8.7.e: When, Bright Ones, fain to show your might ye have determined on your course,  The mountain-clouds have bent them down.

8.7.d: उदीरयन्त वायुभिर्वाश्रासः पर्श्निमातरः | धुक्षन्तपिप्युशीमिषम ||
8.7.e: Loud roaring with the winds the Sons of Pṛśni have upraised themselves:  They have poured out the streaming food.

8.7.d: वपन्ति मरुतो मिहं पर वेपयन्ति पर्वतान | यद यामं यान्ति वायुभिः ||
8.7.e: The Maruts spread the mist abroad and make mountains rock and reel,  When with the winds they go their way

8.7.d: नि यद यामाय वो गिरिर्नि सिन्धवो विधर्मणे | महे शुष्माय येमिरे ||
8.7.e: What time the rivers and the hills before your coming bowed them down,  So to sustain your mighty force.

8.7.d: युष्मानु नक्तमूतये युष्मान दिवा हवामहे | युष्मान परयत्यध्वरे ||
8.7.e: We call on you for aid by night, on you for succour in the day,  On you while sacrifice proceeds.

8.7.d: उदु तये अरुणप्सवश्चित्रा यामेभिरीरते | वाश्रा अधिष्णुना दिवः ||
8.7.e: These, verily, wondrous, red of hue, speed on their courses with a roar  Over the ridges of the sky.

8.7.d: सर्जन्ति रश्मिमोजसा पन्थां सूर्याय यातवे | ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ||
8.7.e: With might they drop the loosened rein so that the Sun may run his course,  And spread themselves with beams of light.

8.7.d: इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं सतोमं रभुक्षणः | इमं मे वनता हवम ||
8.7.e: Accept, ye Maruts, this my song, accept ye this mine hymn of praise,  Accept, Ṛbhukṣans, this my call.

8.7.d: तरीणि सरांसि पर्श्नयो दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु | उत्सं कवन्धमुद्रिणम ||
8.7.e: The dappled Cows have poured three lakes, meath for the Thunder-wielding God,  From the great cask, the watery cloud.

8.7.d: मरुतो यद ध वो दिवः सुम्नायन्तो हवामहे | आ तू न उपगन्तन ||
8.7.e: O Maruts, quickly come to us when, longing for felicity,  We call you hither from the sky.

8.7.d: यूयं हि षठा सुदानवो रुद्रा रभुक्षणो दमे | उत परचेतसो मदे ||
8.7.e: For, Rudras and Ṛbhukṣans, ye, Most Bountiful, are in the house,  Wise when the gladdening draught is drunk.

8.7.d: आ नो रयिं मदच्युतं पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम | इयर्ता मरुतो दिवः ||
8.7.e: O Maruts, send us down from heaven riches distilling rapturous joy,  With plenteous food, sustaining all.

8.7.d: अधीव यद गिरीणां यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम | सुवानैर्मन्दध्व इन्दुभिः ||
8.7.e: When, Bright Ones, hither from the hills ye have resolved to take your way,  Ye revel in the drops effused.

8.7.d: एतावतश्चिदेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः | अदाभ्यस्य मन्मभिः ||
8.7.e: Man should solicit with his lauds happiness which belongs to them,  So great a band invincible.

8.7.d: ये दरप्सा इव रोदसी धमन्त्यनु वर्ष्टिभिः | उत्सं दुहन्तो अक्षितम ||
8.7.e: They who like fiery sparks with showers of rain blow through the heaven and earth,  Milking the spring that never fails.

8.7.d: उदु सवानेभिरीरत उद रथैरुदु वायुभिः | उत सतोमैः पर्श्निमातरः ||
8.7.e: With chariots and tumultuous roar, with tempests and with hymns of praise  The Sons of Pṛśni hurry forth.

8.7.d: येनाव तुर्वशं यदुं येन कण्वं धनस्प्र्तम | राये सु तस्य धीमहि ||
8.7.e: For wealth, we think of that whereby ye aided Yadu, Turvaśa,  And KanVa who obtained the spoil.

8.7.d: इमा उ वः सुदानवो घर्तं न पिप्युषीरिषः | वर्धान काण्वस्य मन्मभिः ||
8.7.e: May these our viands Bounteous Ones I that flow in streams like holy oil,  With Kaṇva's hymns, increase your might.

8.7.d: कव नूनं सुदानवो मदथा वर्क्तबर्हिषः | बरह्मा को वःसपर्यति ||
8.7.e: Where, Bounteous Lords for whom the grass is trimmed, are ye rejoicing now?  What Brahman is adoring you?

8.7.d: नहि षम यद ध वः पुरा सतोमेभिर्व्र्क्तबर्हिषः | शर्धान रतस्य जिन्वथ ||
8.7.e: Is it not there where ye of old, supplied with sacred grass, for lauds  Inspired the strong in sacrifice?

8.7.d: समु तये महतीरपः सं कषोणी समु सूर्यम | सं वज्रं पर्वशो दधुः ||
8.7.e: They brought together both the worlds, the mighty waters, and the Sun,  And, joint by joint, the thunderbolt.

8.7.d: वि वर्त्रं पर्वशो ययुर्वि पर्वतानराजिनः | चक्राणा वर्ष्णि पौंस्यम ||
8.7.e: They sundered Vṛtra limb from limb and split the gloomy mountain-clouds,  Performing a heroic deed.

8.7.d: अनु तरितस्य युध्यतः शुष्ममावन्नुत करतुम | अन्विन्द्रं वर्त्रतूर्ये ||
8.7.e: They reinforced the power and strength of Trita as he fought, and helped  Indra in battle with the foe.

8.7.d: विद्युद्धस्ता अभिद्यवः शिप्राः शीर्षन हिरण्ययीः | शुभ्रा वयञ्जत शरिये ||
8.7.e: They deck themselves for glory, bright, celestial, lightning in their hands,  And helms of gold upon their heads.

8.7.d: उशना यत परावत उक्ष्णो रन्ध्रमयातन | दयौर्न चक्रदद भिया ||
8.7.e: When eagerly ye from far away came to the cavern of the Bull,  He bellowed in his fear like Heaven.

8.7.d: आ नो मखस्य दावने.अश्वैर्हिरण्यपाणिभिः | देवास उप गन्तन ||
8.7.e: Borne by your golden-footed steeds, O Gods, come hither to receive  The sacrifice we offer you.

8.7.d: यदेषां पर्षती रथे परष्टिर्वहति रोहितः | यान्ति शुभ्रा रिणन्नपः ||
8.7.e: When the red leader draws along their spotted deer yoked to the car.  The Bright Ones come, and shed the rain.

8.7.d: सुषोमे शर्यणावत्यार्जीके पस्त्यावति | ययुर्निचक्रया नरः ||
8.7.e: Susoma, Saryakiavan, and Arjika full of homes, have they.  These Heroes, sought with downward car.

8.7.d: कदा गछाथ मरुत इत्था विप्रं हवमानम | मार्डीकेभिर्नाधमानम ||
8.7.e: When, Maruts, ye come to him, the singer who invokes you thus,  With favours to your suppliant?

8.7.d: कद ध नूनं कधप्रियो यदिन्द्रमजहातन | को वः सखित्व ओहते ||
8.7.e: What now? where have ye still a friend since ye left Indra all alone?  Who counteth on your friendship now?

8.7.d: सहो षु णो वज्रहस्तैः कण्वासो अग्निं मरुद्भिः | सतुषेहिरण्यवाशीभिः ||
8.7.e: The Kaṇvas sing forth Agni's praise together with our Maruts’ who  Wield thunder and wear swords of gold.

8.7.d: ओ षु वर्ष्णः परयज्यूना नव्यसे सुविताय | वव्र्त्यां चित्रवाजान ||
8.7.e: Hither for new felicity may I attract the Impetuous Ones,  The Heroes with their wondrous strength

8.7.d: गिरयश्चिन नि जिहते पर्शानासो मन्यमानाः | पर्वताश्चिन नि येमिरे ||
8.7.e: Before them sink the very hills deerning themseives abysses: yea,  Even the mountains bend them down.

8.7.d: आक्ष्णयावानो वहन्त्यन्तरिक्षेण पततः | धातारः सतुवते वयः ||
8.7.e: Steeds flying on their tortuous path through mid-air carry them, and give  The man who lauds them strength and life.

8.7.d: अग्निर्हि जानि पूर्व्यश्छन्दो न सूरो अर्चिषा | ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ||
8.7.e: Agni was born the first of all, like Sūrya lovely with his light:  With lustre these have spread abroad.

8.8.d: आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिरश्विना गछतं युवम | दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ||
8.8.e: WITH all the succours that are yours, O Aśvins, hither come to us:  Wonderful, borne on paths of gold, drink ye the meath with Soma juice.

8.8.d: आ नूनं यातमश्विना रथेन सूर्यत्वचा | भुजी हिरण्यपेशसा कवी गम्भीरचेतसा ||
8.8.e: Come now, ye Aśvins, on your car decked with a sun-bright canopy,  Bountiful, with your golden forms, Sages with depth of intellect.

8.8.d: आ यातं नहुषस पर्यान्तरिक्षात सुव्र्क्तिभिः | पिबाथोश्विना मधु कण्वानां सवने सुतम ||
8.8.e: Come hither from the Nahusas, come, drawn by pure hymns, from mid-air.  O Aśvins, drink the savoury juice shed in the Kaṇvas' sacrifice.

8.8.d: आ नो यातं दिवस पर्यान्तरिक्षादधप्रिया | पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामिह सुषाव सोम्यं मधु ||
8.8.e: Come to us hither from the heavens, come from mid-air, well-loved by us:  Here Kaṇva's son hath pressed for you the pleasant meath of Soma juice.

8.8.d: आ नो यातमुपश्रुत्यश्विना सोमपीतये | सवाहा सतोमस्य वर्धना पर कवी धीतिभिर्नरा ||
8.8.e: Come, Aśvins, to give car to us, to drink the Soma, Aśvins, come.  Hail, Strengtheners of the praise-song speed onward, ye Heroes, with your thoughts.

8.8.d: यच्चिद धि वां पुर रषयो जुहूरे.अवसे नरा | आ यातमश्विना गतमुपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ||
8.8.e: As, Heroes, in the olden time the Ṛṣis called you to their aid,  So now, O Aśvins, come to us, come near to this mine eulogy.

8.8.d: दिवश्चिद रोचनादध्या नो गन्तं सवर्विदा | धीभिर्वत्सप्रचेतसा सतोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता ||
8.8.e: Even from the luminous sphere of heaven come to us, ye who find the light,  Carers for Vatsa, through our prayers and lauds, O yewho hearour call.

8.8.d: किमन्ये पर्यासते.अस्मत सतोमेभिरश्विना | पुत्रः कण्वस्य वां रषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीव्र्धत ||
8.8.e: Do others more than we adore the Aśvins with their hymns of praise?  The Ṛṣi Vatsa, Kaṇva's son, hath magnified you with his songs.

8.8.d: आ वां विप्र इहावसे.अह्वत सतोमेभिरश्विना | अरिप्रा वर्त्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं मयोभुवा ||
8.8.e: The holy singer with his hymns hath called you, Aśvins, hither-ward;  Best Vṛtra-slayers, free from stain, as such bring us felicity.

8.8.d: आ यद वां योषणा रथमतिष्ठद वाजिनीवसू | विश्वान्यश्विना युवं पर धीतान्यगछतम ||
8.8.e: What time, ye Lords of ample wealth, the Lady mounted on your car,  Then, O ye Aśvins, ye attained all wishes that your hearts desired.

8.8.d: अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना | वत्सो वां मधुमद वचो.अशंसीत काव्यः कविः ||
8.8.e: Come thence, O Aśvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments:  Vatsa the sage, the sage's son, hath sung a song of sweets to you.

8.8.d: पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू मनोतरा रयीणाम | सतोमं मे अश्विनाविममभि वह्नी अनूषाताम ||
8.8.e: Cheerers of many, rich in goods, discoverers of opulence,  The Aśvins, Riders through the sky, have welcomed this my song of praise.

8.8.d: आ नो विश्वान्यश्विना धत्तं राधांस्यह्रया | कर्तं न रत्वियावतो मा नो रीरधतं निदे ||
8.8.e: O Aśvins, grant us all rich gifts wherewith no man mav interfere.  Make us observe the stated times: give us not over to reproach.

8.8.d: यन नास्त्या परावति यद वा सथो अध्यम्बरे | अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ||
8.8.e: Whether, Nāsatyas, ye be nigh, or whether ye be far away,  Come thence, O Aśvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments.

8.8.d: यो वां नासत्याव रषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीव्र्धत | तस्मै सहस्रनिर्णिजमिषं धत्तं घर्तश्चुतम ||
8.8.e: Vatsa the Ṛṣi with his songs, Nāsatyas, hath exalted you:  Grant him rich food distilling oil, graced with a thousand ornaments.

8.8.d: परास्मा ऊर्जं घर्तश्चुतमश्विना यछतं युवम | यो वां सुम्नाय तुष्टवद वसूयाद दानुनस पती ||
8.8.e: Bestow on him, O Aśvins, food that strengthens, and that drops with oil,  On him who praises you for bliss, and, Lords of bounty, prays for wealth.

8.8.d: आ नो गन्तं रिशादसेमं सतोमं पुरुभुजा | कर्तं नः सुश्रियो नरेमा दातमभिष्टये ||
8.8.e: Come to us, ye who slay the foe, Lords of rich treasure, to this hymn.  O Heroes, give us high renown and these good things of earth for help.

8.8.d: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः परियमेधा अहूषत | राजन्तावध्वराणामश्विना यामहूतिषु ||
8.8.e: The Priyamedhas have invoked you with all succours that are yours,  You, Aśvins, Lords of solemn rites, with calls entreating you to come.

8.8.d: आ नो गन्तं मयोभुवाश्विना शम्भुवा युवम | यो वां विपन्यू धीतिभिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीव्र्धत ||
8.8.e: Come to us, Aśvins, ye Who bring felicity, auspicious Ones,  To Vatsa who with prayer and hymn, lovers of song, hath honoured you.

8.8.d: याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजम | याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नो.अवतं नरा ||
8.8.e: Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped GoSarya erst,  Gave Vaśa, Dasavraja aid, and Kaṇva and Medhatithi:

8.8.d: याभिर्नरा तरसदस्युमावतं कर्त्व्ये धने | ताभिः षवस्मानश्विना परावतं वाजसातये ||
8.8.e: And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray:  For these, O Aśvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength.

8.8.d: पर वां सतोमाः सुव्र्क्तयो गिरो वर्धन्त्वश्विना | पुरुत्रा वर्त्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्प्र्हा ||
8.8.e: O Aśvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you:  Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you.

8.8.d: तरीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सान्ति गुहा परः | कवी रतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग जीवेभ्यस परि ||
8.8.e: Three places of the Aśvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now.  Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.

8.9.d: आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे | परास्मै यछतमव्र्कं पर्थु छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः ||
8.9.e: To help and favour Vatsa now, O Aśvins, come ye hitherward.  Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away.

8.9.d: यदन्तरिक्षे यद दिवि यत पञ्च मानुषाननु | नर्म्णन्तद धत्तमश्विना ||
8.9.e: All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air,  Bestow, ye Aśvins, upon us.

8.9.d: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमाम्र्शुः | एवेत काण्वस्य बोधतम ||
8.9.e: Remember Kaṇva first of all among the singers, Aśvins, who  Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.

8.9.d: अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना सतोमेन परि षिच्यते | अयं सोमो मधुमान वाजिनीवसू येन वर्त्रं चिकेतथः ||
8.9.e: Aśvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused,  This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe.

8.9.d: यदप्सु यद वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कर्तम | तेन माविष्टमश्विना ||
8.9.e: Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants,  Therewith, O Aśvins, succour me.

8.9.d: यन नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद वा देव भिषज्यथः | अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गछथः ||
8.9.e: What force, Nāsatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal,  This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.

8.9.d: आ नूनमश्विनोरषिः सतोमं चिकेत वामया | आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि ||
8.9.e: Now hath the Ṛṣi splendidly thought out the Aśvins' hymn of praise.  Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets.

8.9.d: आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना | आ वां सतोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत ||
8.9.e: Ye Aśvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way.  May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.

8.9.d: यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि | यद वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत काण्वस्य बोधतम ||
8.9.e: When, O Nāsatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns,  Or, Aśvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially.

8.9.d: यद वां कक्षीवानुत यद वयश्व रषिर्यद वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव | पर्थी यद वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम ||
8.9.e: As erst Kakṣīvān and the Ṛṣi Vyaśva, as erst Dīrghatamas invoked your presence,  Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Pṛthi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Aśvins.

8.9.d: यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा | वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम ||
8.9.e: Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies,  Come to the house to give us seed and offspring,

8.9.d: यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा | यदादित्येभिरभुभिः सजोषसा यद वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः ||
8.9.e: Whether with Indra ye be faring, Aśvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vāyu,  In concord with the Ṛbhus or Ādityas, or standing still in Viṣṇu's striding-places.

8.9.d: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये | यत पर्त्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः ||
8.9.e: When I, O Aśvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength,  Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Aśvins' noblest grace.

8.9.d: आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता | इमे सोमासोधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ ||
8.9.e: Now come, ye Aśvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you;  These Soma-draughts to aid Yadu and  Turvaśa, these offered you mid Kaniva's Sons.

8.9.d: यन नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम | तेन नूनं विमदाय परचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यछतम ||
8.9.e: Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away,  Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.

8.9.d: अभुत्स्यु पर देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः | वयावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः ||
8.9.e: Together with the Goddess, with the Aśvins' Speech have I awoke.  Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men.

8.9.d: पर बोधयोषो अश्विना पर देवि सून्र्ते महि | पर यज्ञहोतरानुषक पर मदाय शरवो बर्हत ||
8.9.e: Awake the Aśvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains!  Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught!

8.9.d: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे | आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नर्पाय्यम ||
8.9.e: Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun,  And to this man-protecting home the chariot ofthe Aśvins comes.

8.9.d: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः | यद वा वाणीरनूषत पर देवयन्तो अश्विना ||
8.9.e: When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk,  And voices sound the song of praise, the Aśvins' worshippers show first.

8.9.d: पर दयुम्नाय पर शवसे पर नर्षाह्याय शर्मणे | पर दक्षाय परचेतसा ||
8.9.e: Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men,  And power and skill, most sapient Ones!

8.9.d: यन नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः यद वासुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या ||
8.9.e: When Aśvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house.  With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.

8.10.d: यत सथो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद वादो रोचने दिवः | यद वा समुद्रे अध्याक्र्ते गर्हे.अत आ यातमश्विना ||
8.10.e: WHETHER ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven,  Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Aśvins, hitherward.

8.10.d: यद वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत काण्वस्य बोधतम | बर्हस्पतिं विश्वान देवानहं हुव इन्द्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा ||
8.10.e: Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kaṇva's son.  I call Bṛhaspati, Indra, Viṣṇu, all the gods, the Aśvins borne by rapid steeds.

8.10.d: तया नवश्विना हुवे सुदंससा गर्भे कर्ता | ययोरस्ति परणः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यम ||
8.10.e: Those Aśvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive,  With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods.

8.10.d: ययोरधि पर यज्ञा असूरे सन्ति सूरयः | ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य परचेतसा सवधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु ||
8.10.e: On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun:  These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice.

8.10.d: यदद्याश्विनावपाग यत पराक सथो वाजिनीवसू | यद दरुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतम ||
8.10.e: Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west,  With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me.

8.10.d: यदन्तरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद वेमे रोदसी अनु | यद्वा सवधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना ||
8.10.e: Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth,  Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Aśvins, hitherward.

8.11.d: तवमग्ने वरतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा | तवं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ||
8.11.e: THOU Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou art  To be adored at sacrifice.

8.11.d: तवमसि परशस्यो विदथेषु सहन्त्य | अग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम ||
8.11.e: O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals,  Bearing our offerings to the Gods.

8.11.d: स तवमस्मदप दविषो युयोधि जातवेदः | अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः ||
8.11.e: O Jātavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us,  Themand their godless enmities.

8.11.d: अन्ति चित सन्तमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः | नोप वेषि जातवेदः ||
8.11.e: Thou, Jātavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man,  However nigh itbe to thee.

8.11.d: मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे | विप्रासो जातवेदसः ||
8.11.e: We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name oof thee,  Immortal Jātavedas' name.

8.11.d: विप्रं विप्रासो.अवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये | अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ||
8.11.e: Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid:  We call on Agni with our songs.

8.11.d: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत परमाच्चित सधस्थात | अग्ने तवां कामया गिरा ||
8.11.e: May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place,  Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

8.11.d: पुरुत्रा हि सद्रंं असि विशो विश्वा अनु परभुः | समत्सुत्वा हवामहे ||
8.11.e: Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord.  In fray and fightt we call on thee.
When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife,  The giver of rich gifts in war.

8.11.d: परत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि | सवां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ||
8.11.e: Ancient, adorablie at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest.  Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.

8.12.d: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति | येना हंसि नयत्रिणं तमीमहे ||
8.12.e: JOY, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewith  Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long.

8.12.d: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं सवर्णरम | येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे ||
8.12.e: Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Daśagva, and the God  Who stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long.

8.12.d: येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथानिव परचोदयः | पन्थां रतस्य यातवे तमीमहे ||
8.12.e: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods  To go the way ordained by Law, for that we long.

8.12.d: इमं सतोममभिष्टये घर्तं न पूतमद्रिवः | येना नुसद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ ||
8.12.e: Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone,  Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great.

8.12.d: इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते | इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ ||
8.12.e: Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea.  Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great.

8.12.d: यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे | दिवो न वर्ष्टिं परथयन ववक्षिथ ||
8.12.e: The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond,  Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great.

8.12.d: ववक्षुरस्य केतवो उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः | यत सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत ||
8.12.e: The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms,  When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth.

8.12.d: यदि परव्र्द्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषानघः | आदित त इन्द्रियं महि पर वाव्र्धे ||
8.12.e: When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes,  Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power.

8.12.d: इन्द्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति | अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः पर वाव्र्धे ||
8.12.e: Indra consumeth with the rays of Sūrya the malicious man:  Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong.

8.12.d: इयं त रत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी | सपर्यन्ती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत ||
8.12.e: This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee:  Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks.

8.12.d: गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः करतुं पुनीत आनुषक | सतोमैरिन्द्रस्य वाव्र्धे मिमीत इत ||
8.12.e: The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul.  By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks.

8.12.d: सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये | पराची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत ||
8.12.e: Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught:  Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks.

8.12.d: यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसो.अभिप्रमन्दुरायवः | घर्तं न पिप्य आसन्य रतस्य यत ||
8.12.e: He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns,  Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth.

8.12.d: उत सवराजे अदिति सतोममिन्द्राय जीजनत | पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय रतस्य यत ||
8.12.e: Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord:  The work of sacrifice for help is glorified.

8.12.d: अभि वह्नय ऊतये.अनूषत परशस्तये | न देव विव्रता हरी रतस्य यत ||
8.12.e: The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy:  God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains.

8.12.d: यत सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद वा घ तरित आप्त्ये | यद वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ||
8.12.e: If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Viṣṇu's or Tṛta Āptya's side,  Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops;

8.12.d: यद वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे | अस्माकमित सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः ||
8.12.e: Or, Śakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air,  Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.

8.12.d: यद वासि सुन्वतो वर्धो यजमानस्य सत्पते | उक्थे वा यस्यरण्यसि समिन्दुभिः ||
8.12.e: Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice,  Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.

8.12.d: देवं-देवं वो.अवस इन्द्रम-इन्द्रं गर्णीषणि | अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे वयानशुः ||
8.12.e: To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help,  And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained.

8.12.d: यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमम | होत्राभिरिन्द्रं वाव्र्धुर्व्यानशुः ||
8.12.e: With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most,  Indra with lauds have they increasedthis have they gained.

8.12.d: महीरस्य परणीतयः पूर्वीरुत परशस्तयः | विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे वयानशुः ||
8.12.e: His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold:  He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained.

8.12.d: इन्द्रं वर्त्राय हन्तवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः | इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे ||
8.12.e: For slaying Vṛtra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place.  Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength.

8.12.d: महान्तं महिना वयं सतोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतम | अर्कैरभिप्र णोनुमः समोजसे ||
8.12.e: We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call,  With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength.

8.12.d: न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम | अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः ||
8.12.e: Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God:  They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength.

8.12.d: यदिन्द्र पर्तनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः | आदित ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ||
8.12.e: What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight,  Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

8.12.d: यदा वर्त्रं नदीव्र्तं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः | आदित ते ... ||
8.12.e: When Vṛtra, stayer of the floods, thou si"est, Thundeicr with might,  Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

8.12.d: यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा तरीणि पदा विचक्रमे | आदित ते . .. ||
8.12.e: When Viṣṇu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his,  Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

8.12.d: यदा ते हर्यता हरी वाव्र्धाते दिवे-दिवे | आदित ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ||
8.12.e: When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day,  Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

8.12.d: यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिन्द्र नियेमिरे | आ इत ते व. ... ||
8.12.e: When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee,  Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

8.12.d: यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं जयोतिरधारयः | आदित्ते व. ... ||
8.12.e: When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above,  Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

8.12.d: इमां त इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः | जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं पराध्वरे ||
8.12.e: To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy,  Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice.

8.12.d: यदस्य धामनि परिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन | नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना पराध्वरे ||
8.12.e: When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voice  Milk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice,

8.12.d: सुवीर्यं सवश्व्यं सुगव्यं इन्द्र दद्धि नः | होतेव पूर्वचित्तये पराध्वरे ||
8.12.e: As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds ana kine  That we may first remember thee for sacrifice.

8.13.d: इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु करतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यम | विदे वर्धस्यदक्षसो महान हि षः ||
8.13.e: INDRA, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds.  He gains the power that brings success, for great is he.

8.13.d: स परथमे वयोमनि देवानां सदने वर्धः | सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित ||
8.13.e: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success,  Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods.

8.13.d: तमह्वे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम | भवा नःसुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वर्धे ||
8.13.e: Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray.  Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid.

8.13.d: इयं त इन्द्र गिर्वणो रातिः कषरति सुन्वतः | मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ||
8.13.e: Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows.  Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth.

8.13.d: नूनं तदिन्द्र दद्धि नो यत तवा सुन्वन्त ईमहे | रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा सवर्विदम ||
8.13.e: Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee.  Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven.

8.13.d: सतोता यत ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद गिरः | वया इवानु रोहते जुषन्त यत ||
8.13.e: What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee,  Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire.

8.13.d: परत्नवज्जनया गिरः शर्णुधी जरितुर्हवम | मदे-मदे ववक्षिथा सुक्र्त्वने ||
8.13.e: Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call.  Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse.

8.13.d: करीळन्त्यस्य सून्र्ता आपो न परवता यतीः | अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः ||
8.13.e: Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope,  Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven;

8.13.d: उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कर्ष्टीनामेक इद वशी | नमोव्र्धैरवस्युभिः सुते रण ||
8.13.e: Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk,  By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught.

8.13.d: सतुहि शरुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य परसक्षिणा | गन्तारा दाशुषो गर्हं नमस्विनः ||
8.13.e: Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays:  They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer.

8.13.d: तूतुजानो महेमते.अश्वेभिः परुषितप्सुभिः | आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद धि ते ||
8.13.e: Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect,  With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for ’tis thy joy.

8.13.d: इन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गर्णत्सु धारय | शरवः सूरिभ्यो अम्र्तं वसुत्वनम ||
8.13.e: Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: give  Our princes everlasting fame and opulence.

8.13.d: हवे तवा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यन्दिने दिवः | जुषाण इन्द्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि ||
8.13.e: I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day:  With thy car-horses, Indra, come wellpleased to us.

8.13.d: आ तू गहि पर तु दरव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः | तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे ||
8.13.e: Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught:  Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known.

8.13.d: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वर्त्रहन | यद वा समुद्रे अन्धसो.अवितेदसि ||
8.13.e: If, Śakra, Vṛtra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us.  Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice.

8.13.d: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तु नो गिर इन्द्रं सुतास इन्दवः | इन्द्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः ||
8.13.e: Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong:  The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him.

8.13.d: तमिद विप्रा अवस्यवः परवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः | इन्द्रं कषोणीरवर्धयन वया इव ||
8.13.e: Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste,  Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow.

8.13.d: तरिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत | तमिद वर्धन्तुनो गिरः सदाव्र्धम ||
8.13.e: At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind:  May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us.

8.13.d: सतोता यत ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्य रतुथा दधे | शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः ||
8.13.e: When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee,  They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful.

8.13.d: तदिद रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं परत्नेषु धामसु | मनो यत्रावि तद दधुर्विचेतसः ||
8.13.e: That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways,  With reference whereto the wise have ordered this.

8.13.d: यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यन्धसः | येन विश्वा अति दविषो अतारिम ||
8.13.e: If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice,  By help whereof we may subdue all enemies.

8.13.d: कदा त इन्द्र गिर्वण सतोता भवाति शन्तमः | कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः ||
8.13.e: O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest?  When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds?

8.13.d: उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वर्षणा वहतो रथम | अजुर्यस्य मदिन्तमं यमीमहे ||
8.13.e: And thy two highIy-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who art  Untouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray.

8.13.d: तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं परत्नाभिरूतिभिः | नि बर्हिषि परिये सददध दविता ||
8.13.e: With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise.  He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass.

8.13.d: वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत रषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः | धुक्षस्वपिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः ||
8.13.e: Wax miglity, thou whom many laud for aids which Ṛṣis have extolled.  Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well.

8.13.d: इन्द्र तवमवितेदसीत्था सतुवतो अद्रिवः | रतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजम ||
8.13.e: O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee:  From sacrifice I send to thee a mindyoked hymn.

8.13.d: इह तया सधमाद्य युजानः सोमपीतये | हरी इन्द्र परतद्वसू अभि सवर ||
8.13.e: Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast,  Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with weal tb, consent to come.

8.13.d: अभि सवरन्तु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत शरियम | उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि परयः ||
8.13.e: Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee,  And all the Marut companies come tothe feast.

8.13.d: इमा अस्य परतूर्तयः पदं जुषन्त यद दिवि | नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे ||
8.13.e: These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love,  Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know.

8.13.d: अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे पराचि परयत्यध्वरे | मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग विचक्ष्य ||
8.13.e: That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds,  He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice.

8.13.d: वर्षायमिन्द्र ते रथ उतो ते वर्षणा हरी | वर्षा तवंशतक्रतो वर्षा हवः ||
8.13.e: O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine:  O Śatakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call.

8.13.d: वर्षा गरावा वर्षा मदो वर्षा सोमो अयं सुतः | वर्षायज्ञो यमिन्वसि वर्षा हवः ||
8.13.e: Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice:  Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call.

8.13.d: वर्षा तवा वर्षणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरुतिभिः | वावन्थ हि परतिष्टुतिं वर्षा हवः ||
8.13.e: As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids:  For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.

8.14.d: यदिन्द्राहं यथा तवमीशीय वस्व एक इत | सतोता मेगोषखा सयात ||
8.14.e: IF I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth,  My worshipper should be rich in kine.

8.14.d: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे | यदहं गोपतिः सयाम ||
8.14.e: I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage,  Were I the Lord of herds of kine.

8.14.d: धेनुष ट इन्द्र सून्र्ता यजमानाय सुन्वते | गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ||
8.14.e: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow  Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.

8.14.d: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः | यद दित्ससिस्तुतो मघम ||
8.14.e: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence,  The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.

8.14.d: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद यद भूमिं वयवर्तयत | चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ||
8.14.e: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and made  Himself a diadem in heaven.

8.14.d: वाव्र्धानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः | ऊतिमिन्द्रा वर्णीमहे ||
8.14.e: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great  Hast won all treasures for thine own.

8.14.d: वयन्तरिक्षमतिरन मदे सोमस्य रोचना | इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम ||
8.14.e: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light,  When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

8.14.d: उद गा आजदङगिरोभ्य आविष कर्ण्वन गुहा सतीः | अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम ||
8.14.e: Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Aṅgirases,  And Vala he cast headlong down.

8.14.d: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दर्ळ्हानि दरंहितानि च | सथिराणि नपराणुदे ||
8.14.e: By Indra were the lumirious realms of heaven established and secured,  Firm and immovable from their place.

8.14.d: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव सतोम इन्द्राजिरायते | वि ते मदा अराजिषुः ||
8.14.e: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods:  Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.

8.14.d: तवं हि सतोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः | सतोतॄणामुत भद्रक्र्त ||
8.14.e: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify:  Thou blessest those who worship thee.

8.14.d: इन्द्रमित केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः | उप यज्ञंसुराधसम ||
8.14.e: Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice,  The Bountiful to our sacrifice.

8.14.d: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः | विश्वा यदजयः सप्र्धः ||
8.14.e: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci,  Subduing all contending hosts.
The Dasyus, when they fain would climb  by magic arts and mount to heaven,  Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.

8.14.d: असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं वयनाशयः | सोमपा उत्तरो भवन ||
8.14.e: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side  Their settlement who poured no gifts.

8.15.d: तं वभि पर गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम | इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ||
8.15.e: SING forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud.  Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise.

8.15.d: यस्य दविबर्हसो बर्हत सहो दाधार रोदसी | गिरीन्रज्रानपः सवर्व्र्षत्वना ||
8.15.e: Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth,  And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.

8.15.d: स राजसि पुरुष्टुत एको वर्त्राणि जिघ्नसे | इन्द्र जैत्रा शरवस्या च यन्तवे ||
8.15.e: Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vṛtras dead,  To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.

8.15.d: तं ते मदं गर्णीमसि वर्षणं पर्त्सु सासहिम | उ लोकक्र्त्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम ||
8.15.e: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray,  Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.

8.15.d: येन जयोतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ | मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ||
8.15.e: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Āyu and for Manu's sake:  Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.

8.15.d: तदद्या चित त उक्थिनो.अनु षटुवन्ति पूर्वथा | वर्षपत्नीरपो जया दिवे-दिवे ||
8.15.e: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine:  Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong.

8.15.d: तव तयदिन्द्रियं बर्हत तव शुष्ममुत करतुम | वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम ||
8.15.e: That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence,  Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen.

8.15.d: तव दयौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पर्थिवी वर्धति शरवः | तवामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ||
8.15.e: O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown;  The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on.

8.15.d: तवां विष्णुर्ब्र्हन कषयो मित्रो गर्णाति वरुणः | तवांशर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम ||
8.15.e: Viṣṇu the lofty ruling Power, Varuṇa, Mitra sing thy praise:  In thee the Marut3' company have great delight.

8.15.d: तवं वर्षा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इन्द्र जज्ञिषे | सत्रा विश्वा सवपत्यानि दधिषे ||
8.15.e: O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts:  Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own.

8.15.d: सत्रा तवं पुरुष्टुत एको वर्त्राणि तोशसे | नान्य इन्द्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति ||
8.15.e: Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vṛtras to their rest:  None else than Indra executes the mighty deed.

8.15.d: यदिन्द्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवन्त ऊतये | अस्माकेभिर्न्र्भिरत्रा सवर्जय ||
8.15.e: Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid,  Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven.

8.15.d: अरं कषयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन | इन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिम ||
8.15.e: Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place:  For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.

8.16.d: पर सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं सतोता नव्यं गीर्भिः | नरं नर्षाहं मंहिष्ठम ||
8.16.e: PRAISE Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the Chief  Most liberal who controlleth men.

8.16.d: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च शरवस्या | अपामवोन समुद्रे ||
8.16.e: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs.  Like the floods' longing for the sea.

8.16.d: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे जयेष्ठराजं भरे कर्त्नुम | महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः ||
8.16.e: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight,  Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.
Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and give  joy in the field where heroes win.

8.16.d: तमिद धनेषु हितेष्वधिवाकाय हवन्ते | येषामिन्द्रस्ते जयन्ति ||
8.16.e: Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate:  They who have Indra win the day.
Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites:  Indra is he who giveth case.

8.16.d: इन्द्रो बरह्मेन्द्र रषिरिन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः | महान महीभिः शचीभिः ||
8.16.e: Indra is priest and Ṛṣi, he is much invoked by many men,  And mighty by his mighty powers.

8.16.d: स सतोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः | एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः ||
8.16.e: Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might,  Victorious even when alone.

8.16.d: तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः | इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कषितयः ||
8.16.e: The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs,  With hymns and sacred eulogies

8.16.d: परणेतारं वस्यो अछा कर्तारं जयोतिः समत्सु | सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान ||
8.16.e: Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war,  And quells their foemen in the fray.

8.16.d: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति सवस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः | इन्द्रो विश्वा अति दविषः ||
8.16.e: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship  Safely beyond all enemies.

8.16.d: स तवं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च | अछा चनः सुम्नं नेषि ||
8.16.e: As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us,  And lead us to felicity.

8.17.d: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम | एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ||
8.17.e: COME, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here  Sit thou on this my sacred grass.

8.17.d: आ तवा बरह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना | उप बरह्मणि नः शर्णु ||
8.17.e: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward  Give car and listen to our prayers.

8.17.d: बरह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः | सुतावन्तो हवामहे ||
8.17.e: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend,  We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.

8.17.d: आ नो याहि सुतावतो.अस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप | पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः ||
8.17.e: Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy,  Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice.

8.17.d: आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु | गर्भाय जिह्वया मधु ||
8.17.e: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread:  Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink.

8.17.d: सवादुष टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान तन्वे तव | सोमः शमस्तु ते हर्दे ||
8.17.e: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice:  Sweet be the Soma to thine heart.

8.17.d: अयमु तवा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संव्र्तः | पर सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु ||
8.17.e: Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach,  O active Indra, close to thee.

8.17.d: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे | इन्द्रो वर्त्राणि जिघ्नते ||
8.17.e: Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neck  And stout arms, smites the Vṛtras down.

8.17.d: इन्द्र परेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा | वर्त्राणि वर्त्रहञ जहि ||
8.17.e: O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might:  Thou Vṛtra-slayer slay the fiends,

8.17.d: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङकुशो येना वसु परयछसि | यजमानाय सुन्वते ||
8.17.e: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to him  Who sheds the juice and worships thee.

8.17.d: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि | एहीमस्य दरवापिब ||
8.17.e: Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass:  Run hither, come and drink thereof.

8.17.d: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः | आखण्डल पर हूयसे ||
8.17.e: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delight  Thou art invoked, Akhandala!

8.17.d: यस्ते शर्ङगव्र्षो नपात परणपात कुण्डपाय्यः | नयस्मिन दध्र आ मनः ||
8.17.e: To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Srngavrs! to thee,  To him have I addressed my thought.

8.17.d: वास्तोष पते धरुवा सथूणांसत्रं सोम्यानाम | दरप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा ||
8.17.e: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers:  The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Ṛṣis’ Friend.

8.17.d: पर्दाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः | भूर्णिमश्वं नयत तुजा पुरो गर्भेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.17.e: Holy Prdikusanu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o’er many men,  Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.

8.18.d: इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः | आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि ||
8.18.e: Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled grace  Of these Ādityas and their aid to cherish life.

8.18.d: अनर्वाणो हयेषां पन्था आदित्यानाम | अदब्धाः सन्ति पायवः सुगेव्र्धः ||
8.18.e: For not an enemy molests the paths which these Ādityas tread:  Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness.

8.18.d: तत सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा | शर्म यछन्तु सप्रथो यदीमहे ||
8.18.e: Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman  Give us the shelter widely spread which we implore.

8.18.d: देवेभिर्देव्यदिते.अरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि | समत सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः ||
8.18.e: With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi:  Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well.

8.18.d: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे | अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयो.अनेहसः ||
8.18.e: For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof,  Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe.

8.18.d: अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः | अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदाव्र्धा ||
8.18.e: Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night,  Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief!

8.18.d: उत सया नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत | सा शन्ताति मयस करदप सरिधः ||
8.18.e: And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help,  With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes.

8.18.d: उत तया दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना | युयुयातामितो रपो अप सरिधः ||
8.18.e: And may the Aśvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health:  May they remove iniquity and chase our foes.

8.18.d: शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः | शं वातो वात्वरपा अप सरिधः ||
8.18.e: May Agni bless us with his fires, and Sūrya warm us pleasantly:  May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes.

8.18.d: अपामीवामप सरिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम | आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ||
8.18.e: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity:  Ādityas, keep us ever far from sore distress.

8.18.d: युयोता शरुमस्मदानादित्यास उतामतिम | रधग दवेषःक्र्णुत विश्ववेदसः ||
8.18.e: Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Ādityas! far away:  Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth!

8.18.d: तत सु नः शर्म यछतादित्या यन मुमोचति | एनस्वन्तं चिदेनसः सुदानवः ||
8.18.e: Now, O Ādityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free,  Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods 1

8.18.d: यो नः कश्चिद रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः | सवैः षेवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः ||
8.18.e: Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us,  May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds.

8.18.d: समित तमघमश्नवद दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुम | यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावानुप दवयुः ||
8.18.e: May sin o’ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing,  Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false.

8.18.d: पाकत्रा सथन देवा हर्त्सु जानीथ मर्त्यम | उप दवयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः ||
8.18.e: Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts;  Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true.

8.18.d: आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वर्णीमहे | दयावाक्षामारे अस्मद रपस कर्तम ||
8.18.e: Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods:  Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth.

8.18.d: ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः | अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन ||
8.18.e: So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry us  Beyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship.

8.18.d: तुचे तनाय तत सु नो दराघीय आयुर्जीवसे | आदित्यासःसुमहसः कर्णोतन ||
8.18.e: Ādityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seed  Extended term of life that they may live long days.

8.18.d: यज्ञो हीळो वो अन्तर आदित्या अस्ति मर्ळत | युष्मे इद वो अपि षमसि सजात्ये ||
8.18.e: Sacrifice, O Ādityas, is your inward monitor: be kind,  For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you.

8.18.d: बर्हद वरूथं मरुतां देवं तरातारमश्विना | मित्रमीमहे वरुणं सवस्तये ||
8.18.e: The Maruts’ high protecting aid, the Aśvins, and the God who saves,  Mitra and Varuṇa for weal we supplicate.

8.18.d: अनेहो मित्रार्यमन नर्वद वरुण शंस्यम | तरिवरूथं मरुतो यन्त नश्छर्दिः ||
8.18.e: Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa!  Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men.

8.18.d: ये चिद धि मर्त्युबन्धव आदित्या मनवः समसि | पर सू नायुर्जीवसे तिरेतन ||
8.18.e: And as we human beings, O Ādityas, are akin to death,  Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.

8.19.d: तं गूर्धया सवर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे | देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे ||
8.19.e: SING praise to hiin, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger,  And sent oblation to Gods.

8.19.d: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यन्तुरम | अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे परेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम ||
8.19.e: Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari-  Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice.

8.19.d: यजिष्ठं तवा वव्र्महे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम | अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम ||
8.19.e: Thee have we chosen skilftillest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods,  Wise finisher of this holy rite:

8.19.d: ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं शरेष्ठशोचिषम | स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ||
8.19.e: The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent.  May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuṇa, and the Floods.

8.19.d: यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये | यो नमसा सवध्वरः ||
8.19.e: The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore,  And reverence, skilled in sacrifice.

8.19.d: तस्येदर्वन्तो रंहयन्त आशवस्तस्य दयुम्नितमं यशः | न तमंहो देवक्र्तं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यक्र्तं नशत ||
8.19.e: Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his.  No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o’ertaketh him.

8.19.d: सवग्नयो वो अग्निभिः सयाम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते | सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ||
8.19.e: May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might:  Thou as our Friend hast worthy men.

8.19.d: परशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियो.अग्नी रथो न वेद्यः | तवे कषेमासो अपि सन्ति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणाम ||
8.19.e: Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear.  Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth.

8.19.d: सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरो.अग्ने मर्तः सुभग स परशंस्यः | स धीभिरस्तु सनिता ||
8.19.e: That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial gifts  May he win riches by his thoughts.

8.19.d: यस्य तवमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि कषयद्वीरः स साधते | सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कर्तम ||
8.19.e: He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o’er men.  He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize.

8.19.d: यस्याग्निर्वपुर्ग्र्हे सतोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः | हव्या वा वेविषद विषः ||
8.19.e: He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well,  And zealously tends his offerings-

8.19.d: विप्रस्य वा सतुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु | अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कर्धि वसो विविदुषो वचः ||
8.19.e: His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts,  Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent.

8.19.d: यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति | गिरा वाजिरशोचिषम ||
8.19.e: He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh,  Or him who flashes fast with song,

8.19.d: समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः | विश्वेत स धीभिः सुभगो जनानति दयुम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत ||
8.19.e: The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God,  Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods.

8.19.d: तदग्ने दयुम्नमा भर यत सासहत सदने कं चिदत्रिणम | मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः ||
8.19.e: Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode,  The wrath of evil-hearted folk.

8.19.d: येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः | वयं तत ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इन्द्रत्वोता विधेमहि ||
8.19.e: That, wherewith Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the Aśvins, Bhaga give us light,  That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee.

8.19.d: ते घेदग्ने सवाध्यो ये तवा विप्र निदधिरे नर्चक्षसम | विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुम ||
8.19.e: O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise,  O God, for men to look upon:

8.19.d: त इद वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि | तैद वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद धनं ये तवे कामं नयेरिरे ||
8.19.e: Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice.  They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee.

8.19.d: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः | भद्रा उत परशस्तयः ||
8.19.e: -May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss;  Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.

8.19.d: भद्रं मनः कर्णुष्व वर्त्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः | अव सथिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः ||
8.19.e: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight.  Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.

8.19.d: ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं नयेरिरे | यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनम ||
8.19.e: I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger,  Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts.

8.19.d: तिग्मजम्भाय तरुणाय राजते परयो गायस्यग्नये | यः पिंशते सून्र्ताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घ्र्तेभिराहुतः ||
8.19.e: Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast-  Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him,

8.19.d: यदी घर्तेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च | असुर इव निर्णिजम ||
8.19.e: While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword,  As doth the Asura his robe.

8.19.d: यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगन्धिना | विवासते वार्याणि सवध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः ||
8.19.e: The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth,  Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God.

8.19.d: यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं सयामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः | सहसः सूनवाहुत ||
8.19.e: Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts!  And I were the Immortal God

8.19.d: न तवा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय सन्त्य | न मे सतोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः सयादग्ने न पापया ||
8.19.e: I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One.  My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin.

8.19.d: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभ्र्तो दुरोण आ देवानेतु पर णो हविः ||
8.19.e: Like a son cherished in his father's houi§e, let our oblation rise unto the Gods.

8.19.d: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो | सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः ||
8.19.e: With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wish  A mortal with a God to help.

8.19.d: तव करत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव परशस्तिभिः | तवामिदाहुः परमतिं वसो ममाग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे ||
8.19.e: O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth.  Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal.

8.19.d: पर सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः | यस्य तवं सख्यमावरः ||
8.19.e: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength,  Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

8.19.d: तव दरप्सो नीलवान वाश रत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे | तवं महीनामुषसामसि परियः कषपो वस्तुषु राजसि ||
8.19.e: Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up.  Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.

8.19.d: तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं सवभिष्टिमवसे | सम्राजं तरासदस्यवम ||
8.19.e: We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers,  The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend.

8.19.d: यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव | विपो न दयुम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव कषत्राणि वर्धयन ||
8.19.e: O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem,  I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might.

8.19.d: यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यम | मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः ||
8.19.e: The mortal whom, Ādityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bank  Of all the princes, Bounteous Ones

8.19.d: यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः कषयन्तं मानुषाननु | वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन सयामेद रतस्य रथ्यः ||
8.19.e: Whoe’er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men-  May we, O Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law.

8.19.d: अदान मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पञ्चाशतं तरसदस्युर्वधूनाम | मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः ||
8.19.e: A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son,  Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave.

8.19.d: उत मे परयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि | तिसॄणांसप्ततीनां शयावः परणेता भुवद वसुर्दियानां पतिः ||
8.19.e: And Śyāva too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvastu's ford:  A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.

8.20.d: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत परस्थावानो माप सथाता समन्यवः | सथिरा चिन नमयिष्णवः ||
8.20.e: LET none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away,  Ye benders even of what is firm.

8.20.d: वीळुपविभिर्मरुत रभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः | इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्प्र्हो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः ||
8.20.e: Maruts, Ṛbhukṣans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright.  Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari.

8.20.d: विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवताम | विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषाम ||
8.20.e: For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Martits, who are passing strong,  Swift Viṣṇu's band, who send the rain.,

8.20.d: वि दवीपानि पापतन तिष्ठद दुछुनोभे युजन्त रोदसी | पर धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ सवभानवः ||
8.20.e: Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one.  Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves.

8.20.d: अच्युता चिद वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः | भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते ||
8.20.e: Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach,  And the earth trembles as ye come.

8.20.d: अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे दयौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बर्हत | यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा तवक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः ||
8.20.e: To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way,  Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming omaments on their forms.

8.20.d: सवधामनु शरियं नरो महि तवेषा अमवन्तो वर्षप्सवः | वहन्ते अह्रुतप्सवः ||
8.20.e: After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wear  Great splendour as they show erect.

8.20.d: गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये | गोबन्धवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महान्तो नः सपरसे नु ||
8.20.e: The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk.  May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight.

8.20.d: परति वो वर्षदञ्जयो वर्ष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वम | हव्या वर्षप्रयाव्णे ||
8.20.e: Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company,  To those whose leader is the Bull.

8.20.d: वर्षणश्वेन मरुतो वर्षप्सुना रथेन वर्षनाभिना | आ शयेनासो न पक्षिणो वर्था नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत ||
8.20.e: Come hither, O ye Mares, on your stronghorsed car, solid in look, with solid naves.  Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our ofrerings.

8.20.d: समानमञ्ज्येषां वि भराजन्ते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु | दविद्युतत्य रष्टयः ||
8.20.e: Their decoration is the same: their omaments of gold are bright upon their arms;  Their lances glitter splendidly.

8.20.d: त उग्रासो वर्षण उग्रबाहवो नकिष टनूषु येतिरे | सथिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वो.अनीकेष्वधि शरियः ||
8.20.e: They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms.  Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face.

8.20.d: येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम तवेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे | वयो न पित्र्यं सहः ||
8.20.e: Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it,  And life-power like ancestral might.

8.20.d: तान वन्दस्व मरुतस्तानुप सतुहि तेषां हि धुनीनाम | अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषाम ||
8.20.e: Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the car  Of these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts.

8.20.d: सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो वयुष्टिषु | योवा नूनमुतासति ||
8.20.e: Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn,  And even now shall he be blest.

8.20.d: यस्य वा यूयं परति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ | अभि ष दयुम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत ||
8.20.e: The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof,  With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world.

8.20.d: यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशन्त्यसुरस्य वेधसः | युवानस्तथेदसत ||
8.20.e: Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire,  O Youthful Ones, so shall it be:

8.20.d: ये चार्हन्ति मरुतः सुदानवः समन मीळ्हुषश्चरन्ति ये | अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हर्दा युवान आ वव्र्ध्वम ||
8.20.e: And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain-  Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own.

8.20.d: यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वर्ष्णः पावकानभि सोभरे गिरा | गाय गा इव चर्क्र्षत ||
8.20.e: O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls,  Even as a plougher to his steers.

8.20.d: साहा ये सन्ति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पर्त्सु होत्र्षु | वर्ष्णश्चन्द्रान न सुश्रवस्तमान गिरा वन्दस्व मरुतो अह ||
8.20.e: Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight:  They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song.

8.20.d: गावश्चिद घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः | रिहते ककुभो मिथः ||
8.20.e: Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy,  Lick, all by turns, each other's head.

8.20.d: मर्तश्चिद वो नर्तवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भरात्र्त्वमायति | अधिनो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि ||
8.20.e: Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you.  Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us.

8.20.d: मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः | यूयंसखायः सप्तयः ||
8.20.e: O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts’ medicine,  Ye Coursers who are Friends to us.

8.20.d: याभिः सिन्धुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथाक्रिविम | मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः ||
8.20.e: Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aids  Wherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need.

8.20.d: यत सिन्धौ यदसिक्न्यां यत समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः | यत पर्वतेषु भेषजम ||
8.20.e: Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath,  Or mountains or the seas contain.

8.20.d: विश्वं पश्यन्तो बिभ्र्था तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत | कषमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ||
