8.20.e: Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith.  Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.

8.21.d: वयमु तवामपूर्व्य सथूरं न कच्चिद भरन्तो.अवस्यवः | वाजे चित्रं हवामहे ||
8.21.e: WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves,  Call on thee wonderful in fight

8.21.d: उप तवा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धर्षत | तवामिद धयवितारं वव्र्महे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम ||
8.21.e: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth.  We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, havie chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.

8.21.d: आ याहीम इन्दवो.अश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते | सोमं सोमपते पिब ||
8.21.e: Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine:  Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!

8.21.d: वयं हि तवा बन्धुमन्तमबन्धवो विप्रास इन्द्र येमिम | या ते धामानि वर्षभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ||
8.21.e: For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin.  With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice.

8.21.d: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे | अभि तवामिन्द्र नोनुमः ||
8.21.e: Sitting like birds beside thy meath., mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee,  Indra, to thee we sing aloud.

8.21.d: अछा च तवैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद वि दीधयः | सन्ति कामासो हरिवो ददिष टवं समो वयं सन्ति नो धियः ||
8.21.e: We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile?  Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here.

8.21.d: नूत्ना इदिन्द्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः | विद्मा पुरा परीणसः ||
8.21.e: For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid.  Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth.

8.21.d: विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्यमा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे | उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति ||
8.21.e: Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee.  O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God.

8.21.d: यो न इदम-इदं पुरा पर वस्य आनिनाय तमु व सतुषे | सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ||
8.21.e: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you,  Even Indra, O my friends, for help

8.21.d: हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि षमा यो अमन्दत | आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं सतोत्र्भ्यो मघवा शतम ||
8.21.e: Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight.  May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.

8.21.d: तवया ह सविद युजा वयं परति शवसन्तं वर्षभ बरुवीमहि | संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ||
8.21.e: Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath,  In fight with people rich in kine.

8.21.d: जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणो.अभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः | नर्भिर्व्र्त्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चावेरिन्द्र पर णो धियः ||
8.21.e: May we be victors in the singer's battlesong, and meet the wicked, Much invoked!  With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts.

8.21.d: अभ्रात्र्व्यो अना तवमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि | युधेदापित्वमिछसे ||
8.21.e: O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou:  Thou seekest comradeship in war.

8.21.d: नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः | यदा कर्णोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित पितेव हूयसे ||
8.21.e: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine.  What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked.

8.21.d: मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इन्द्र सख्ये तवावतः | नि षदाम सचा सुते ||
8.21.e: O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thine  Sit idly by the poured-out juice.

8.21.d: मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इन्द्र मा ते गर्हामहि | दर्ळ्हा चिदर्यः पर मर्शाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे ||
8.21.e: Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own.  Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain.

8.21.d: इन्द्रो वा घेदियन मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु | तवं वा चित्र दाशुषे ||
8.21.e: Indra or blest Sarasvatī alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou,  O Citra, on the worshipper.

8.21.d: चित्र इद राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु | पर्जन्य इव ततनद धि वर्ष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत ||
8.21.e: Citra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvatī.  He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.

8.22.d: ओ तयमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये | यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः ||
8.22.e: HITHERWARD have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous car  Which ye ascended, Aśvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Sūrya's sake.

8.22.d: पूर्वायुषं सुहवं पुरुस्प्र्हं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम | सचनावन्तं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसम ||
8.22.e: Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might,  Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe.

8.22.d: इह तया पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना | अर्वाचीना सववसे करामहे गन्तारा दशुषो गर्हम ||
8.22.e: These Aśvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent Deities  Hitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper.

8.22.d: युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद वामिषण्यति | अस्मानछा सुमतिर्वां शुभस पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु ||
8.22.e: One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course.  Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us.

8.22.d: रथो यो वां तरिवन्धुरो हिरण्यभीशुरश्विना | परि दयावाप्र्थिवी भूषति शरुतस्तेन नासत्या गतम ||
8.22.e: That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold,  The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nāsatyas, Aśvins, come.

8.22.d: दशस्यन्ता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वर्केण कर्षथः | ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस पती अश्विना पर सतुवीमहि ||
8.22.e: Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky.  As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Aśvins, with our prayer and praise.

8.22.d: उप नो वजिनीवसू यातं रतस्य पथिभिः | येभिस्त्र्क्षिं वर्षणा तरसदस्यवं महे कषत्राय जिन्वथः ||
8.22.e: Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law,  Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Trksi, Trasadasyu's son.

8.22.d: अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नर वर्षण्वसु | आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गर्हे ||
8.22.e: This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth.  Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode.

8.22.d: आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वर्षण्वसू | युञ्जाथां पीवरीरिषः ||
8.22.e: O Aśvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth,  And bring to us abundant food.

8.22.d: याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसम | ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतंयदातुरम ||
8.22.e: The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,—  With those, O Aśvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased.

8.22.d: यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे | वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः ||
8.22.e: When we continually invoke the Aśvins, the resistless, at this time of day,  We lovers of the song, with songs.

8.22.d: ताभिरा यातं वर्षणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यम | इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः करिविं वव्र्धुस्ताभिरा गतम ||
8.22.e: Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,—  Tlirough which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these.

8.22.d: ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वन्दमान उप बरुवे | ता उ नमोभिरीमहे ||
8.22.e: I speak to both of these as such, these Aśvins whom I reverence at this time of day:  With homage we entreat them both.

8.22.d: ताविद दोषा ता उषसि शुभस पती ता यामन रुद्रवर्तनी | मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति खयतम ||
8.22.e: Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice,  Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth.

8.22.d: आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं पराता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी | हुवे पितेव सोभरी ||
8.22.e: For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Aśvins with their car  I call, like Sobhari our sire.

8.22.d: मनोजवसा वर्षणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरुतिभिः | आरात्ताच्चिद भूतमस्मे अवसे पुर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा ||
8.22.e: Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to thejoy, bringing.your swiftly-coming help,  Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.'

8.22.d: आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा | गोमद दस्रा हिरण्यवत ||
8.22.e: Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Aśvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold,  Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice

8.22.d: सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाध्र्ष्टं रक्षस्विना | अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ||
8.22.e: Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Rakṣas foe,  At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.

8.23.d: ईळिष्वा हि परतीव्यं यजस्व जातवेदसम | चरिष्णुधूममग्र्भीतशोचिषम ||
8.23.e: WORSHIP thou Jātavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts,  Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame.

8.23.d: दामानं विश्वचर्षणे.अग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा | उत सतुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानाम ||
8.23.e: Thou, all men's friend, Visvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song,  The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend.

8.23.d: येषामाबाध रग्मिय इषः पर्क्षश्च निग्रभे | उपविदावह्निर्विन्दते वसु ||
8.23.e: Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,—  Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth.

8.23.d: उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद दीदियुषो वयजरम | तपुर्जम्भस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः ||
8.23.e: Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent One  Most bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train.

8.23.d: उदु तिष्ठ सवध्वर सतवानो देव्या कर्पा | अभिख्या भासा बर्हता शुशुक्वनिः ||
8.23.e: Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness,  Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light.

8.23.d: अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक | यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः ||
8.23.e: Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies,  As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts.

8.23.d: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनाम | तमया वाचा गर्णे तमु व सतुषे ||
8.23.e: I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men:  Him with this song I laud and magnify for you.

8.23.d: यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कर्पा सूदयन्त इत | मित्रं न जने सुधितं रतावनि ||
8.23.e: Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form,  Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law.

8.23.d: रतावानं रतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा | उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस पदे ||
8.23.e: Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones!  Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer.

8.23.d: अछा नो अङगिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यन्तु संयतः | होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः ||
8.23.e: May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Aṅgiras,  Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest.

8.23.d: अग्ने तव तये अजरेन्धानासो बर्हद भाः | अश्वा इव वर्षणस्तविषीयवः ||
8.23.e: Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights,  Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength.

8.23.d: स तवं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यम | पराव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा ||
8.23.e: So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength,  And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays.

8.23.d: यद वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विसि | विश्वेदग्निः परति रक्षांसि सेधति ||
8.23.e: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race,  Agni averteth from us all the demon host.

8.23.d: शरुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे सतोमस्य वीर विश्पते | नि मायिनस्तपुष रक्षसो दह ||
8.23.e: O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine,  Burn down the Rākṣasas, enchanters, with thy flame.

8.23.d: न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः | यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः ||
8.23.e: No mortal foe can e’er prevail by arts of magic over him  Who serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts.

8.23.d: वयश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणाद रषिः | महो रयेतमु तवा समिधीमहि ||
8.23.e: Vyaśva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things:  As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth.

8.23.d: उशना कव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत | आयजिं तवा मनवेजातवेदसम ||
8.23.e: Uśanā Kāvya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest:  Thee, Jātavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man.

8.23.d: विश्वे हि तवा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत | शरुष्टी देव परथमो यज्ञियो भुवः ||
8.23.e: All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger:  Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice.

8.23.d: इमं घा वीरो अम्र्तं दूतं कर्ण्वीत मर्त्यः | पावकंक्र्ष्णवर्तनिं विहायसम ||
8.23.e: Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger.  Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black.

8.23.d: तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषम | विशामग्निमजरं परत्नमीड्यम ||
8.23.e: With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame,  Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable.

8.23.d: यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तो.अविधत | भूरि पोषंस धत्ते वीरवद यशः ||
8.23.e: The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial gifts  Obtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame.

8.23.d: परथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम | परति सरुगेति नमसा हविष्मती ||
8.23.e: To Jātavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of all  With homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts.

8.23.d: आभिर्विधेमाग्नये जयेष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत | मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे ||
8.23.e: Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymns  Pay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame.

8.23.d: नूनमर्च विहायसे सतोमेभिः सथूरयूपवत | रषे वैयश्वदम्यायाग्नये ||
8.23.e: Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far,  To Agni of the home, O Ṛṣi, Vyaśva's son.

8.23.d: अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनाम | विप्रा अग्निमवसे परत्नमीळते ||
8.23.e: As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings,  The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid.

8.23.d: महो विश्वानभि षतो.अभि हव्यानि मानुषा | अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि ||
8.23.e: For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all,  Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass.

8.23.d: वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्प्र्हः | सुवीर्यस्य परजावतो यशस्वतः ||
8.23.e: Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave,  With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown.

8.23.d: तवं वरो सुषाम्णे.अग्ने जनाय चोदय | सदा वसो रातिं यविष्ठ शश्वते ||
8.23.e: Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealth  Unto Varosusaman and to all his folk.

8.23.d: तवं हि सुप्रतूरसि तवं नो गोमतीरिषः | महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वर्धि ||
8.23.e: A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to us  Food in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth.

8.23.d: अग्ने तवं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह | रतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा ||
8.23.e: Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuṇa,  Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.

8.24.d: सखाय आ शिषामहि बरह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे | सतुष ऊ षुवो नर्तमाय धर्ष्णवे ||
8.24.e: COMPANIONS, let us learn a prayer to Indra. whom the thunder arms,  To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.

8.24.d: शवस हयसि शरुतो वर्त्रहत्येन वर्त्रहा | मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ||
8.24.e: For thou by slaying Vṛtra art the Vṛtra-slayer, famed for might.  Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.

8.24.d: स न सतवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमम | निरेके चिद यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः ||
8.24.e: As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame,  Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays!

8.24.d: आ निरेकमुत परियमिन्द्र दर्षि जनानाम | धर्षता धर्ष्णो सतवमान आ भर ||
8.24.e: Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men:  Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us.

8.24.d: न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरन्त आमुरः | न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु ||
8.24.e: The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left:  Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight.

8.24.d: आ तवा गोभिरिव वरजं गीर्भिरणोम्यद्रिवः | आ सम कामं जरितुरा मनः पर्ण ||
8.24.e: O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine:  Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise.

8.24.d: विश्वनि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वर्त्रहन्तम | उग्र परणेतरधि षु वसो गहि ||
8.24.e: Chief Vṛtra-slayer, through the hymn of Visvamanas think of all,  All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide.

8.24.d: वयं ते अस्य वर्त्रहन विद्याम शूर नव्यसः | वसो सपार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः ||
8.24.e: May we, O Vṛtra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon, Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked!

8.24.d: इन्द्र यथा हयस्ति ते.अपरीतं नर्तो शवः | अम्र्क्त रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे ||
8.24.e: O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed,  So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked.

8.24.d: आ वर्षस्व महामह महे नर्तम राधसे | दर्ळ्हश्चिद दर्ह्य मघवन मघत्तये ||
8.24.e: Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full.  Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan!

8.24.d: नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन नो जग्मुरशसः | मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन न उतिभिः ||
8.24.e: O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee:  So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now.

8.24.d: नह्यङग नर्तो तवदन्यं विन्दामि राधसे | राये दयुम्नायशवसे च गिर्वणः ||
8.24.e: For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee,  For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song.

8.24.d: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबति सोम्यं मधु | पर राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना ||
8.24.e: For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drink  With bounty and with majesty will he further us.

8.24.d: उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पर्ञ्चन्तमब्रवम | नूनं शरुधि सतुवतो अश्व्यस्य ||
8.24.e: I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability:  Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee.

8.24.d: नह्यङग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत | नकी राया नैवथा न भन्दना ||
8.24.e: Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou:  None certairdy like thee in goodness and in wealth.

8.24.d: एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः | एवा हि वीर सतवते सदाव्र्धः ||
8.24.e: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most:  So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.

8.24.d: इन्द्र सथातर्हरीणां नकिष टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम | उदानंशशवसा न भन्दना ||
8.24.e: Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent,  None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

8.24.d: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि शरवस्यवः | अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वाव्र्धेन्यम ||
8.24.e: We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might  Who must be glorified by constant sacri fice.

8.24.d: एतो नविन्द्रं सतवाम सखायः सतोम्यं नरम | कर्ष्तीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत ||
8.24.e: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud,  Him who with none to aid o’ercomes all tribes of men.

8.24.d: अगोरुधाय गविषे दयुक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः | घर्तात सवादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत ||
8.24.e: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God,  Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath.

8.24.d: यस्यामितानि वीर्या न राधः पर्येतवे | जयोतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा ||
8.24.e: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne’er may be surpassed,  Whose liberality, like light, is over all.

8.24.d: सतुहीन्द्रं वयश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम | अर्यो गयम्मंहमानं वि दाशुषे ||
8.24.e: As Vyaśva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide,  Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.

8.24.d: एवा नूनमुप सतुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम | सुविद्वांसं चर्क्र्त्यं चरणीनाम ||
8.24.e: Now, son of Vyaśva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new,  The very Wise, whom living men must glorify

8.24.d: वेत्था हि निरतीनां वज्रहस्त परिव्र्जम | अहर-अहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ||
8.24.e: Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers,  As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.

8.24.d: तदिन्द्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कर्त्वने | दविता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय ||
8.24.e: O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slay  His foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us.

8.24.d: तमु तवा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे | स तवंनो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः ||
8.24.e: So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain:  For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us.

8.24.d: य रक्षादंहसो मुचद यो वार्यात सप्त सिन्धुषु | वधर्दासस्य तुविन्र्म्ण नीनमः ||
8.24.e: Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Ārya on the Seven Streams:  O valiant Hero, bend the Dāsa's weapon down.

8.24.d: यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिम | वयश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वजिनीवति ||
8.24.e: As to Varosusaman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain,  To Vyaśva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth!

8.24.d: आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा वयश्वानेतु सोमिनः | सथूरं च राधः शतवत सहस्रवत ||
8.24.e: Let Narya's sacrificial meed reach Vyaśva's Soma-bearing sons:  In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward.

8.24.d: यत तवा पर्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाक्र्ते | एषो अपश्रितोवलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति ||
8.24.e: If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou?  Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomati.

8.25.d: ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिय | रतावाना यजसे पुतदक्षसा ||
8.25.e: I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods,  You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified.

8.25.d: मित्रा तना न रथ्या वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः | सनात सुजाता तनया धर्तव्रता ||
8.25.e: So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuṇa,  Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast.

8.25.d: ता माता विश्ववेदसासुर्याय परमहसा | महि जजानादितिरतावरी ||
8.25.e: These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest sway  Aditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth.

8.25.d: महान्ता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा | रतावानाव्र्तमा घोषतो बर्हत ||
8.25.e: Great Varuṇa and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords,  True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree.

8.25.d: नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतु | सर्प्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि कषितः ||
8.25.e: The offspring of a lofty Power, Dakṣa's Two Sons exceeding strong,  Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food.

8.25.d: सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः | नभस्वतीरा वां चरन्तु वर्ष्टयः ||
8.25.e: Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food,  Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven.

8.25.d: अधि या बर्हतो दिवो.अभि यूथेव पश्यतः | रतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता ||
8.25.e: The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below,  Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered.

8.25.d: रतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू | धर्तव्रता कषत्रिया कषत्रमशतुः ||
8.25.e: They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for savran rule:  Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway.

8.25.d: अक्ष्णश्चिद गातुवित्तरनुल्बणेन चक्षसा | नि चिन मिषन्ता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः ||
8.25.e: Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight,  Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive.

8.25.d: उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या | उरुष्यन्तु मरुतो वर्द्धशवसः ||
8.25.e: So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nāsatyas guard us well,  The Martits guard us well,.endowed with mighty strength.

8.25.d: ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः | अरिष्यन्तो निपायुभिः सचेमहि ||
8.25.e: Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night:  With you for our defenders may we go unharmed.

8.25.d: अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यन्तः सुदानवे | शरुधि सवयावन सिन्धो पूर्वचित्तये ||
8.25.e: May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Viṣṇu, the God who slayeth none:  Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark.

8.25.d: तद वार्यं वर्णीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यम | मित्रो यत पान्ति वरुणो यदर्यमा ||
8.25.e: This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far,  Which Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman afford.

8.25.d: उत नः सिन्धुरपां तन मरुतस्तदश्विना | इन्द्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः ||
8.25.e: And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair,  Boon Indra, and boon Viṣṇu have one mind with us.

8.25.d: ते हि षमा वनुषो नरो.अभिमातिं कयस्य चित | तिग्मं नक्षोदः परतिघ्नन्ति भूर्णयः ||
8.25.e: Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe,  As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones.

8.25.d: अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विष्पतिः | तस्य वरतान्यनु वश्चरमसि ||
8.25.e: Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide:  And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws.

8.25.d: अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम | मित्रस्य वरता वरुणस्य दिर्घश्रुत ||
8.25.e: We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy,  The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuṇa.

8.25.d: परि यो रश्मिना दिवो.अन्तान ममे पर्थिव्याः | उभे आ पप्रौरोदसी महित्वा ||
8.25.e: He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth,  And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full,

8.25.d: उदु षय शरणे दिवो जयोतिरयंस्त सूर्यः | अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः ||
8.25.e: Sūrya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky,  Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him.

8.25.d: वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः | ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने ||
8.25.e: With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine,  Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food.

8.25.d: तत सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप बरुवे | भोजेष्वस्मानभ्युच्चरा सदा ||
8.25.e: So unto Sūrya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak.  Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us.

8.25.d: रज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे | रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि ||
8.25.e: From Uksanyayana a bay, from Harayana a white steed,  And from Susaman we obtained a hamessed car.

8.25.d: ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना | उतो नु कर्त्व्यानां नर्वाहसा ||
8.25.e: These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds,  The carriers shall they be of active men of war.

8.25.d: समदभीषू कशावन्ता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती | महो वाजिनावर्वन्ता सचासनम ||
8.25.e: And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip,  And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.

8.26.d: युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सुरिषु | अतुर्तदक्षाव्र्षणा वर्षण्वसू ||
8.26.e: I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men,  Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might!

8.26.d: युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या | अवोभिर्यथो वर्षण वर्षण्वसू ||
8.26.e: Ye to Varosusaman come, Nāsatyas, for this glorious rite.  With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth.

8.26.d: ता वामद्य हवामहे हव्येभिर्वजिनीवसू | पूर्वीरिष इषयन्तावति कषपः ||
8.26.e: So with oblations we invoke you, rich in ample wealth, to-day,  When night hath passed, O ye who send us plenteous food.  O Aśvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us,  And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds.

8.26.d: आ वां वाहिष्ठो अश्विना रथो यातु शरुतो नर | उप सतोमान तुरस्य दर्शथः शरिये ||
8.26.e: Aśvins, who send us precious gifts, even when offended, think of him:  For ye, O Rudras, lead us safe beyond our foes.

8.26.d: जुहुराणा चिदश्विना मन्येथां वर्षण्वसू | युवं हि रुद्रा पर्षथो अति दविषः ||
8.26.e: For, Wonder-Workers, with fleet steeds ye fly completely round this All,  Stirring our thoughts, ye Lords of splendour, honey-hued.

8.26.d: दस्रा हि विश्वमानुषं मक्षूभिः परिदीयथः | धियंजिन्वा मधुवर्णा शुभस पती ||
8.26.e: With all-sustaining opulence, Aśvins, come hitherward to us,  Ye rich and noble Heroes, ne’er to be o’erthrown.

8.26.d: उप नो यातमश्विना राया विश्वपुषा सह | मघवाना सुवीरावनपच्युता ||
8.26.e: To welcome this mine offering, O ye Indra-like Nāsatyas, come  As Gods of best accord this day with other Gods.

8.26.d: आ मे अस्य परतीव्यमिन्द्रनासत्या गतम | देवा देवेभिरद्य सचनस्तमा ||
8.26.e: For we, like Vyaśva, lifting up our voice like oxen, call on you:  With all your loving kindness, Sages, come to us.

8.26.d: वयं हि वां हवामह उक्षण्यन्तो वयश्ववत | सुमतिभिरुप विप्राविहा गतम ||
8.26.e: O Ṛṣi, laud the Aśvins well. Will they not listen to thy call?  Will they not burn the Paṇis who are nearer them?

8.26.d: अश्विना सव रषे सतुहि कुवित ते शरवतो हवम | नेदीयसः कूळयातः पणीन्रुत ||
8.26.e: O Heroes, listen to the son of Vyaśva, and regard me here,  Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, of one accord.

8.26.d: वैयश्वस्य शरुतं नरोतो मे अस्य वेदथः | सजोषसा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ||
8.26.e: Gods whom we yearn for, of your gifts, of what ye bring to us, bestow  By princes' hands on me, ye Mighty, day by day.

8.26.d: युवादत्तस्य धिष्ण्या युवानीतस्य सूरिभिः | अहर-अहर्व्र्षण मह्यं शिक्षतम ||
8.26.e: Him whom your sacrifices clothe, even as a woman with her robe,  The Aśvins help to glory honouring him well.

8.26.d: यो वां यज्ञेभिराव्र्तो.अधिवस्त्र वधूरिव | सपर्यन्त शुभे चक्राते अश्विना ||
8.26.e: Whoso regards your care of men as succour widest in its reach,  About his dwelling go, ye Aśvins, loving us.

8.26.d: यो वामुरुव्यचस्तमं चिकेतति नर्पाय्यम | वर्तिरश्विना परि यातमस्मयू ||
8.26.e: Come to us ye who pour down wealth, come to the home which men must guard:  Like shafts, ye are made meet for sacrifice by song.

8.26.d: अस्मभ्यं सु वर्षण्वसू यातं वर्तिर्न्र्पय्यम | विषुद्रुहेव यज्ञमूहथुर्गिरा ||
8.26.e: Most fetching of all calls, the laud, as envoy, Heroes, called to you  Be it your own, O Aśvin Pair.

8.26.d: वाहिष्ठो वां हवानां सतोमो दूतो हुवन नरा | युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ||
8.26.e: Be ye in yonder sea of heaven, or joying in the home of food,  Listen to me, Immortal Ones.

8.26.d: यददो दिवो अर्णव इषो व मदथो गर्हे | शरुतमिन मे अमर्त्या ||
8.26.e: This river with his lucid flow attracts you, more than all the streams,—  Even Sindhu with his path of gold.

8.26.d: उत सया शवेतयावरी वाहिष्ठा वां नदीनाम | सिन्धुर्हिरण्यवर्तनिः ||
8.26.e: O Aśvins, with that glorious fame come hither, through our brilliant song,  Come ye whose ways are marked with light.

8.26.d: समदेतय सुकीर्त्याश्विना शवेतया धिया | वहेथे शुभ्रयावाना ||
8.26.e: Harness the steeds who draw the car, O Vasu, bring the well-fed pair.  O Vāyu, drink thou of our meath: come unto our drink-offerings.

8.26.d: युक्ष्वा हि तवं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो | आन नो वायो मधु पिबास्माकं सवना गहि ||
8.26.e: Wonderful Vāyu, Lord of Right, thou who art Tvaṣṭar's son-in-law,  Thy saving succour we elect.

8.26.d: तव वायव रतस्पते तवष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत | अवांस्या वर्णीमहे ||
8.26.e: To Tvaṣṭar's son-in-law we pray for wealth whereof he hath control:  For glory we seek vayu, men with juice effused.

8.26.d: तवष्टुर्जामातरं वयमीशानं राय ईमहे | सुतावन्तो वयुं दयुम्ना जनासः ||
8.26.e: From heaven, auspicious Vāyu, come drive hither with thy noble steeds:  Come on thy mighty car with wide-extending seat.

8.26.d: वायो याहि शिवा दिवो वहस्व सु सवश्व्यम | वहस्व महःप्र्थुपक्षसा रथे ||
8.26.e: We call thee to the homes of men, thee wealthiest in noble food,  And liberal as a press-stone with a horse's back.

8.26.d: तवां हि सुप्सरस्तमं नर्षदनेषु हूमहे | गरावाणं नाश्वप्र्ष्ठं मंहना ||
8.26.e: So, glad and joyful in thine heart, do thou, God, Vāyu, first of all  Vouchsafe us water, strength, and thought.

8.26.d: स तवं नो देव मनसा वायो मन्दानो अग्रियः | कर्धि वाजानपो धियः ||
8.26.e: Missing line from Griffith.

8.27.d: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो गरावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे | रचा यामि मरुतो बरह्मणस पतिं देवानवो वरेण्यम ||
8.27.e: CHEIF Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice:  With song I seek the Maruts, Brahmaṇaspati, Gods for help much to be desired.

8.27.d: आ पशुं गासि पर्थिवीं वनस्पतीनुषासा नक्तमोषधीः | विश्वे च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धीनां भूत परावितारः ||
8.27.e: I sing to cattle and to Earth, to trees, to Dawns, to Night, to plants.  O all ye Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, be ye the furtherers of our thoughts.

8.27.d: पर सू न एत्वध्वरो.अग्ना देवेषु पूर्व्यः | आदित्येषु पर वरुणे धर्तव्रते मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ||
8.27.e: Forth go, with Agni, to the Gods our sacrifice of ancient use,  To the Ādityas, Varuṇa whose Law stands fast, and the all-lightening Marut troop.

8.27.d: विश्वे हि षमा मनवे विश्ववेदसो भुवन वर्धे रिशादसः | अरिष्टेभिः पायुभिर्विश्ववेदसो यन्ता नो.अव्र्कं छर्दिः ||
8.27.e: Lords of all wealth, may they be strengtheners of man, destroyers of his enemies.  Lords of all wealth, do ye, with guards which none may harm, preserve our dwelling free from foes.

8.27.d: आ नो अद्य समनसो गन्ता विश्वे सजोषसः | रचा गिरा मरुतो देव्यदिते सदने पस्त्ये महि ||
8.27.e: Come to us with one mind to-day, come to us all with one accord,  Maruts with holy song, and, Goddess Aditi, Mighty One, to our house and home.

8.27.d: अभि परिया मरुतो या वो अश्व्या हव्या मित्र परयाथन | आबर्हिरिन्द्रो वरुणस्तुरा नर आदित्यासो सदन्तु नः ||
8.27.e: Send us delightful things, ye Maruts, on your steeds: come ye, O Mitra, to our gifts.  Let Indra, Varuṇa, and the Ādityas sit, swift Heroes, on our sacred grass.

8.27.d: वयं वो वर्क्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आनुषक | सुतसोमासो वरुण हवामहे मनुष्वदिद्धाग्नयः ||
8.27.e: We who have trimmed the grass for you, and set the banquet in array,  And pressed the Soma, call you, Varuina, like men, with sacrificial fires aflame.

8.27.d: आ पर यात मरुतो विष्णो अश्विना पूषन माकीनया धिया | इन्द्र आ यातु परथमः सनिष्युभिर्व्र्षा यो वर्त्रहा गर्णे ||
8.27.e: O Maruts, Visinu, Aśvins, Pūṣan, haste away with minds turned hitherward to Me.  Let the Strong Indra, famed as Vṛtra's slayer, come first with the winners of the spoil.

8.27.d: वि नो देवासो अद्रुहो.अछिद्रं शर्म यछत | न यद दूराद वसवो नू चिदन्तितो वरूथमादधर्षति ||
8.27.e: Ye Guileless Gods, bestow on us a refuge strong on every side,  A sure protection, Vasus, unassailable from near at hand or from afar.

8.27.d: अस्ति हि वः सजात्यं रिशादसो देवासो अस्त्याप्यम | पर णः पूर्वस्मै सुविताय वोचत मक्षू सुम्नाय नव्यसे ||
8.27.e: Kinship have I with you, and close alliance O ye Gods, destroyers of our foes.  Call us to our prosperity of former days, and soon to new klicity.

8.27.d: इदा हि व उपस्तुतिमिदा वामस्य भक्तये | उप वो विश्ववेदसो नमस्युरानस्र्क्ष्यन्यामिव ||
8.27.e: For now have I sent forth to you, that I may win a fair reward,  Lords of all wealth, with homage, this my song of praise. like a milch-cow that faileth not.

8.27.d: उदु षय वः सविता सुप्रणीतयो.अस्थादूर्ध्वो वरेण्यः | नि दविपादश्चतुष्पादो अर्थिनो.अविश्रन पतयिष्णवः ||
8.27.e: Excellent Savitar hath mounted up on high for you, ye sure and careful Guides.  Bipeds and quadrupeds, with several hopes and aims, and birds have settled to their tasks.

8.27.d: देवं-देवं वो.अवसे देवं-देवमभिष्टये | देवं-देवं हुवेम वाजसातये गर्णन्तो देव्या धिया ||
8.27.e: Singing their praise with God-like thought let us invoke each God for grace,  Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.

8.27.d: देवासो हि षमा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः | ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः ||
8.27.e: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts.  May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing case and ample room.

8.27.d: पर वः शंसाम्यद्रुहः संस्थ उपस्तुतीनाम | न तं धूर्तिर्वरुण मित्र मर्त्यं यो वो धामभ्यो.अविधत ||
8.27.e: I laud you, O ye Guileless Gods, here where we meet to render praise.  None, Varuṇa and Mitra, harins the mortal, man who honours and obeys your laws.

8.27.d: पर स कषयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति | पर परजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस पर्यरिष्टः सर्व एधते ||
8.27.e: He makes his house endure, he gathers plenteous food who pays obedience to your will.  Born in his sons anew he spreads as Law commands, and prospers every way unharmed.

8.27.d: रते स विन्दते युधः सुगेभिर्यात्यध्वनः | अर्यमा मित्रोवरुणः सरातयो यं तरायन्ते सजोषसः ||
8.27.e: E’en without war he gathers wealth, and goes hisway on pleasant paths,  Whom Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman protect, sharing the gift,of one accord.

8.27.d: अज्रे चिदस्मै कर्णुथा नयञ्चनं दुर्गे चिदा सुसरणम | एषा चिदस्मादशनिः परो नु सास्रेधन्ती वि नश्यतु ||
8.27.e: E’en on the plain for him ye make a sloping path, an easy way where road is none:  And far away from him the ineffectual shaft must vanish, shot at him in vain.

8.27.d: यदद्य सूर्य उद्यति परियक्षत्रा रतं दध | यन निम्रुचि परबुधि विश्ववेदसो यद वा मध्यन्दिने दिवः ||
8.27.e: If ye appoint the rite to-day, kind Rulers, when the Sun ascends,  Lords of all wealth, at sunset or at wakingtime, or be it at the noon of day,

8.27.d: यद वाभिपित्वे असुरा रतं यते छर्दिर्येम वि दाशुषे | वयं तद वो वसवो विश्ववेदस उप सथेयाम मध्य आ ||
8.27.e: Or, Asuras, when ye have sheltered the worshipper who goes to sacrifice, at eve  may we, O Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, come then into the midst of You.

8.27.d: यदद्य सूर उदिते यन मध्यन्दिन आतुचि | वामं धत्थ मनवे विश्ववेदसो जुह्वानाय परचेतसे ||
8.27.e: If ye to-day at sunrise, or at noon, or in the gloom of eve,  Lords of all riches, give fair treasure to the man, the wise man who hath sacrificed,

8.27.d: वयं तद वः सम्राज आ वर्णीमहे पुत्रो न बहुपाय्यम | अश्याम तदादित्या जुह्वतो हविर्येन वस्यो.अनशामहै ||
8.27.e: Then we, imperial Rulers, claim of you this boon, your wide protection, as a son.  May we, Ādityas, offering holy gifts, obtain that which shall bring us greater bliss.

8.28.d: ये तरिंशति तरयस परो देवासो बर्हिरासदन | विदन्नहद्वितासनन ||
8.28.e: THE Thirty Gods and Three besides, whose seat hath been the sacred grass,  From time of old have found and gained.

8.28.d: वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा समद्रातिषाचो अग्नयः | पत्नीवन्तो वषट्क्र्ताः ||
8.28.e: Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Agnis, with Consorts, sending boons,  To whom our Vaṣaṭ! is addressed:

8.28.d: ते नो गोपा अपाच्यास्त उदक त इत्था नयक | पुरस्तात सर्वया विशा ||
8.28.e: These are our guardians in the west, and northward here, and in the south,  And on the cast, with all the tribe.

8.28.d: यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसत तदेषां नकिरा मिनत | अरावा चन मर्त्यः ||
8.28.e: Even as the Gods desire so verily shall it be. None minisheth this power of theirs,  No demon, and no mortal

8.28.d: सप्तानां सप्त रष्टयः सप्त दयुम्नान्येषाम | सप्तो अधि शरियो धिरे ||
8.28.e: The Seven carry seven spears; seven are the splendours they possess,  And seven the glories they assume.

8.29.e: ONE is a youth brown, active, manifold he decks the golden one with ornament.
Another, luminous, occupies the place of sacritice, Sage, among the Gods.
One brandishes in his hand an iron knife, firm, in his seat amid the Deities.

8.29.d: वज्रमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आहितं तेन वर्त्राणि जिघ्नते ||
8.29.e: Another holds the thunderbolt, wherewith he slays the Vṛtras, resting in his hand.

8.29.d: तिग्ममेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयुधं शुचिरुग्रो जलाषभेषजः ||
8.29.e: Another bears a pointed weapon: bright is he, and strong, with healing medicines.

8.29.d: पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथा एष वेद निधीनाम ||
8.29.e: Another, thief-like, watches well the ways, and knows the places where the treasures lie.

8.29.d: तरीण्येक उरुगायो वि चक्रमे यत्र देवासो मदन्ति ||
8.29.e: Another with his mighty stride hath made his three steps thither where the Gods rejoice.

8.29.d: विभिर्द्वा चरत एकया सह पर परवासेव वसतः ||
8.29.e: Two with one Dame ride on with winged steeds, and journey forth like travellers on their way.

8.29.d: सदो दवा चक्राते उपमा दिवि सम्राजा सर्पिरासुती ||
8.29.e: Two, highest, in the heavens have set their seat, worshipped with holy oil, imperial Kings.

8.29.d: अर्चन्त एके महि साम मन्वत तेन सूर्यमरोचयन ||
8.29.e: Some, singing lauds, conceived the Sāma-hymn, great hymn whereby they caused the Sun to shine.

8.30.d: नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः | विश्वे सतोमहान्त इत ||
8.30.e: NOT one of you, ye Gods, is small, none of you is a feeble child:  All of you, verily, are great.

8.30.d: इति सतुतासो असथा रिशादसो ये सथ तरयश्च तरिंशच्च | मनोर्देवा यज्ञियासः ||
8.30.e: Thus be ye lauded, ye destroyers of the foe, ye Three-and-Thirty Deities,  The Gods of man, the Holy Ones.

8.30.d: ते नस्त्राध्वं ते.अवत त उ नो अधि वोचत | मा नः पथः पित्र्यान मानवादधि दूरं नैष्ट परावतः ||
8.30.e: As such defend and succour us, with benedictions speak to us:  Lead us not from our fathers' and from Manu's path into the distance far away.

8.30.d: ये देवास इह सथन विश्वे वैश्वानरा उत | अस्मभ्यं शर्म सप्रथो गवे.अश्वाय यछत ||
8.30.e: Ye Deities who stay with us, and all ye Gods of all mankind,  Give us your wide protection, give shelter for cattle and for steed.

8.31.d: यो यजाति यजात इत सुनवच्च पचाति च | बरह्मेदिन्द्रस्यचाकनत ||
8.31.e: THAT Brahman pleases Indra well, who worships, sacrifices, pours Libation, and prepares the meal.

8.31.d: पुरोळाशं यो अस्मै सोमं ररत आशिरम | पादित तं शक्रो अंहसः ||
8.31.e: Śakra protects from woe the man who gives him sacrificial cake.  And offers Soma blent with milk.

8.31.d: तस्य दयुमानसद रथो देवजूतः स शूशुवत | विश्वा वन्वन्नमित्रिया ||
8.31.e: His chariot shall be glorious, sped by Gods, and mighty shall he be,  Subduing all hostilities.

8.31.d: अस्य परजावती गर्हे.असश्चन्ती दिवे-दिवे | इळा धेनुमती दुहे ||
8.31.e: Each day that passes, in his house flows his libation, rich in milk,  Exhaustless, bringing progeny.

8.31.d: या दम्पती समनसा सुनुत आ च धावतः | देवासो नित्ययाशिरा ||
8.31.e: O Gods, with constant draught of milk, husband and wife with one accord  Press out and wash the Soma juice.

8.31.d: परति पराशव्यानितः सम्यञ्चा बर्हिराशाते | न ता वाजेषु वायतः ||
8.31.e: They gain sufficient food: they come united to the sacred grass,  And never do they fail in strength.

8.31.d: न देवानामपि हनुतः सुमतिं न जुगुक्षतः | शरवो बर्हद विवासतः ||
8.31.e: Never do they deny or seek to hide the favour of the Gods:  They win high glory for themselves.

8.31.d: पुत्रिणा ता कुमारिणा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतः | उभा हिरण्यपेशसा ||
8.31.e: With sons and daughters by their side they reach their full extent of life,  Both decked with ornaments of gold.

8.31.d: वीतिहोत्रा कर्तद्वसू दशस्यन्ताम्र्ताय कम | समुधो रोमशं हतो देवेषू कर्णुतो दुवः ||
8.31.e: Serving the Immortal One with gifts of sacrificial meal and wealth,  They satisfy the claims of love and pay due honour to the Gods.

8.31.d: आ शर्म पर्वतानां वर्णीमहे नदीनाम | आ विष्णोः सचाभुवः ||
8.31.e: We claim protection from the Hills, we claim protection of the Floods,  Of him who stands by Viṣṇu's side.

8.31.d: ऐतु पूषा रयिर्भगः सवस्ति सर्वधातमः | उरुरध्वा सवस्तये ||
8.31.e: May Pūṣan come, and Bhaga, Lord of wealth, All-bounteous, for our weal  Broad be the path that leads to bliss:
Aramati, and, free from foes, Visva with spirit of a God,  And the Ādityas’ peerless might.

8.31.d: यथा नो मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सन्ति गोपाः | सुगा रतस्यपन्थाः ||
8.31.e: Seeing that Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuṇa are guarding us,  The paths of Law are fair to tread.

8.31.d: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं गिरा देवमीळे वसूनाम | सपर्यन्तःपुरुप्रियं मित्रं न कषेत्रसाधसम ||
8.31.e: I glorify with song, for wealth, Agni the God, the first of you.  We honour as a well-loved Friend the God who prospereth our fields.

8.31.d: मक्षू देववतो रथः शूरो वा पर्त्सु कासु चित | देवानां य इन मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत ||
8.31.e: As in all frays the hero, so swift moves his car whom Gods attend.  The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

8.31.d: न यजमान रिष्यसि न सुन्वान न देवयो | देवानां य इन मनो ... ||
8.31.e: Ne’er are ye injured, worshipper, presser of juice, or pious man.  The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

8.31.d: नकिष टं कर्मणा नशन न पर योषन न योषति | देवानां य इन मनो ... ||
8.31.e: None in his action equals him, none holds him far or keeps him off.  The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

8.31.d: असदत्र सुवीर्यमुत तयदाश्वश्व्यम | देवानां य इन्मनो ... ||
8.31.e: Such strength of heroes shall be his, such mastery of fleet-foot steeds.  The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

8.32.d: पर कर्तान्य रजीषिणः कण्वा इन्द्रस्य गाथया | मदे सोमस्य वोचत ||
8.32.e: KANVAS, tell forth with song the deeds of Indra, the Impetuous,  Wrought in the Soma's wild delight.

8.32.d: यः सर्बिन्दमनर्शनिं पिप्रुं दासमहीशुवम | वधीदुग्रो रिणन्नपः ||
8.32.e: Strong God, he slew Anarsani, Srbinda, Pipru, and the fiend,  Ahīśuva, and loosed the floods.

8.32.d: नयर्बुदस्य विष्टपं वर्ष्माणं बर्हतस्तिर | कर्षे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम ||
8.32.e: Thou broughtest down the dwelling-place, the height of lofty Arbuda.  That exploit, Indra, must be famed.

8.32.d: परति शरुताय वो धर्षत तूर्णाशं न गिरेरधि | हुवेसुशिप्रमूतये ||
8.32.e: Bold, to your famous Soma I call the fair-visored God for aid,  Down like a torrent from the hill.

8.32.d: स गोरश्वस्य वि वरजं मन्दानः सोम्येभ्यः | पुरं नशूर दर्षसि ||
8.32.e: Rejoicing in the Soma-draughts, Hero, burst open, like a fort,  The stall of horses and of kine.

8.32.d: यदि मे रारणः सुत उक्थे वा दधसे चनः | आरादुपस्वधा गहि ||
8.32.e: If my libation gladdens, if thou takest pleasure in my laud,  Come with thy Godhead from afar.

8.32.d: वयं घा ते अपि षमसि सतोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः | तवं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ||
8.32.e: O Indra, Lover of the Song, the singers of thy praise are we:  O Soma-drinker, quicken us.

8.32.d: उत नः पितुमा भर संरराणो अविक्षितम | मघवन भूरि ते वसु ||
8.32.e: And, taking thy delight with us bring us still undiminished food:  Great is thy wealth, O Maghavan.

8.32.d: उत नो गोमतस कर्धि हिरण्यवतो अश्विनः | इळाभिः सं रभेमहि ||
8.32.e: Make thou us rich in herds of kine, in steeds, in gold: let us exert  Our strength in sacrificial gifts.

8.32.d: बर्बदुक्थं हवामहे सर्प्रकरस्नमूतये | साधु कर्ण्वन्तमवसे ||
8.32.e: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, to whom high laud is due.  Who worketh well to succour us.

8.32.d: यः संस्थे चिच्छतक्रतुरादीं कर्णोति वर्त्रहा | जरित्र्भ्यः पुरूवसुः ||
8.32.e: He, Śatakratu, even in fight acts as a Vṛtra-slayer s,till:  He gives his worshippers much wealth.

8.32.d: स नः शक्रश्चिदा शकद दानवानन्तराभरः | इन्द्रोविश्वाभिरूतिभिः ||
8.32.e: May he, this A;akra, strengthen us, Boon God who satisfies our needs,  Indra, with all lhis saving helps.

8.32.d: यो रायो.अवनिर्महान सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा | तमिन्द्रमभि गायत ||
8.32.e: To him, the mighty stream of wealth, the Soma-presser's rescuing Friend,  To Indra sing your song of praise;

8.32.d: आयन्तारं महि सथिरं पर्तनासु शरवोजितम | भूरेरीशानमोजसा ||
8.32.e: Who bringeth what is great and firm, who winneth glory in his wars,  Lord of vast wealth through power and might.

8.32.d: नकिरस्य शचीनां नियन्ता सून्र्तानाम | नकिर्वक्ता नदादिति ||
8.32.e: There liveth none to cheek or stay his energies and gracious deeds:  None who can say, He giveth not.

8.32.d: न नूनं बरह्मणां रणं पराशूनामस्ति सुन्वताम | न सोमो अप्रता पपे ||
8.32.e: No debt is due by Brahmans now, by active men who press the juice:  Well hath each Soma-draught been paid.

8.32.d: पन्य इदुप गायत पन्य उक्थानि शंसत | बरह्मा कर्णोतपन्य इत ||
8.32.e: Sing ye to him who must be praised, say lauds to him who must be praised,  Bring prayer to him who must be praised.

8.32.d: पन्य आ दर्दिरच्छता सहस्रा वाज्यव्र्तः | इन्द्रो यो यज्वनो वर्धः ||
8.32.e: May be, unchecked, strong, meet for praise, bring hundreds, thousands forth to light,  Indra who aids the worshipper.

8.32.d: वि षू चर सवधा अनु कर्ष्टीनामन्वाहुवः | इन्द्र पिब सुतानाम ||
8.32.e: Go with thy God-like nature forth, go where the folk are calling thee:  Drink, Indra, of the drops we pour.

8.32.d: पिब सवधैनवानामुत यस्तुग्र्ये सचा | उतायमिन्द्र यस्तव ||
8.32.e: Drink milky draughts which are thine own, this too which was with Tugrya once,  This is it, Indra, that is thine.

8.32.d: अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपारणे | इमं रातंसुतं पिब ||
8.32.e: Pass him who psours libations out in angry mood or after sin:  Here drink the juice we offer thee.

8.32.d: इहि तिस्रः परावत इहि पञ्च जनानति | धेना इन्द्रावचाकशत ||
8.32.e: Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way,  O Indra, noticing our voice.

8.32.d: सूर्यो रश्मिं यथा सर्जा तवा यछन्तु मे गिरः | निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक ||
8.32.e: Send forth thy ray like Sūrya: let my songs attract thee hitherward,  Like waters gathering to the vale.

8.32.d: अध्वर्यवा तु हि षिञ्च सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे | भरासुतस्य पीतये ||
8.32.e: Now to the Hero fair of cheek, Adhvaryu, pour the Soma forth:  Bring of the juice that he may drink

8.32.d: य उद्नः फलिगं भिनन नयक सिन्धून्रवास्र्जत | यो गोषुपक्वं धारयत ||
8.32.e: Who cleft the water-cloud in twain, loosed rivers for their downward flow,  And set the ripe milk in the kine.

8.32.d: अहन वर्त्रं रचीषम और्णवाभमहीशुवम | हिमेनाविध्यदर्बुदम ||
8.32.e: He, meet for praise, slew Vṛtra, slew Ahīśuva, Urnavabha's son,  And pierced th:rough Arbuda with frost.

8.32.d: पर व उग्राय निष्टुरे.अषाळ्हाय परसक्षिणे | देवत्तं बरह्म गायत ||
8.32.e: To him your matchless Mighty One, unconquerable Conqueror,  Sing forth the prayer which Gods have given:

8.32.d: यो विश्वान्यभि वरता सोमस्य मदे अन्धसः | इन्द्रो देवेषु चेतति ||
8.32.e: Indra, who in the wild delight of Soma juice considers here  All holy Laws among the Gods.

8.32.d: इह तया सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या | वोळ्हामभि परयो हितम ||
8.32.e: Hither let these thy Bays who share thy banquet, Steeds with golden manes,  Convey thee to the feast prepared.

8.32.d: अर्वाञ्चं तवा पुरुष्टुत परियमेधस्तुता हरी | सोमपेयायवक्षतः ||
8.32.e: Hither, O thou whom many laud, the Bays whom Priyamedha praised,  Shall bring thee to the Soma-draught.

8.33.d: वयं घ तवा सुतावन्त आपो न वर्क्तबर्हिषः | पवित्रस्यप्रस्रवणेषु वर्त्रहन परि सतोतार आसते ||
8.33.e: WE compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed.  Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vṛtra-slayer, sit.

8.33.d: सवरन्ति तवा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः | कदा सुतं तर्षाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र सवब्दीव वंसगः ||
8.33.e: Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place:  When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

8.33.d: कण्वेभिर्ध्र्ष्णवा धर्षद वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम | पिशङगरूपं मघवन विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ||
8.33.e: Boldly, Bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kaṇvas' sake.  O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store ol kine.

8.33.d: पाहि गायान्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे | यः सम्मिश्लोहर्योर्यः सुते सचा वज्री रथो हिरण्ययः ||
8.33.e: Medhyātithi, to Indra sing, drink of the juice to make thee glad.  Close-knit to his Bay Steeds, bolt-armed, beside the juice is he: his chariot is of gold.

8.33.d: यः सुषव्यः सुदक्षिण इनो यः सुक्रतुर्ग्र्णे | य आकरः सहस्रा यः शतामघ इन्द्रो यः पूर्भिदारितः ||
8.33.e: He Who is praised as strong of hand both right and left, most wise and hold:  Indra who, rich in hundreds, gathers thousands up, honoured as breaker-down of forts.

8.33.d: यो धर्षितो यो.अव्र्तो यो अस्ति शमश्रुषु शरितः | विभूतद्युम्नश्च्यवनः पुरुष्टुतः करत्वा गौरिव शाकिनः ||
8.33.e: The bold of heart whom none provokes, who stands in bearded confidence;  Much-lauded, very glorious, overthrowing foes, strong Helper, like a bull with might.

8.33.d: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद वयो दधे | अयं यःपुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ||
8.33.e: Who knows what vital ower he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice?  This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

8.33.d: दाना मर्गो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे | नकिष टवा नि यमदा सुते गमो महांश्चरस्योजसा ||
8.33.e: As a wild elephant rushes on this way and that way, mad with heat,'  None may compel thee, yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.

8.33.d: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्ट्र्त सथिरो रणाय संस्क्र्तः | यदि सतोतुर्मघवा शर्णवद धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत ||
8.33.e: When he, the Mighty, ne’er o’erthrown, steadfast, made ready for the fight,  When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

8.33.d: सत्यमित्था वर्षेदसि वर्षजूतिर्नो.अव्र्तः | वर्षा हयुग्र शर्ण्विषे परावति वर्षो अर्वावति शरुतः ||
8.33.e: Yea, verily, thou art a Bull, with a bull's rush. whom none may stay:  Thou Mighty One, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.

8.33.d: वर्षणस्ते अभीशवो वर्षा कशा हिरण्ययी | वर्षा रथो मघवन वर्षणा हरी वर्षा तवं सतक्रतो ||
8.33.e: Thy reins are very bulls in strength, bulls' strength is in thy golden whip.  Thy car, O Maghavan, thy Bays are strong as bulls: thou, Śatakratu, art a Bull.

8.33.d: वर्षा सोता सुनोतु ते वर्षन्न्र्जीपिन्ना भर | वर्षा दधन्वे वर्षणं नदीष्वा तुभ्यं सथातर्हरीणाम ||
8.33.e: Let the strong presser press for thee. Bring hither, thou straight-rushing Bull.  The mighty makes the mighty run in flowing streams for thee whom thy Bay Horses bear.

8.33.d: एन्द्र याहि पीतये मधु शविष्ठ सोम्यम | नायमछा मघवा शर्णवद गिरो बरह्मोक्था च सुक्रतुः ||
8.33.e: Come, thou most potent Indra, come to drink the savoury Soma juice.  Maghavan, very wise, will quickly come to hear the songs, the prayer, the hymns of praise.

8.33.d: वहन्तु तवा रथेष्ठामा हरयो रथयुजः | तिरश्चिदर्यं सवनानि वर्त्रहन्नन्येषां या शतक्रतो ||
8.33.e: When thou hast mounted on thy car let thy yoked Bay Steeds carry thee,  Past other men's libations, Lord of Hundred Powers, thee, Vṛtra-slayer, thee our Friend.

8.33.d: अस्माकमद्यान्तमं सतोमं धिष्व महामह | अस्माकं ते सवना सन्तु शन्तमा मदाय दयुक्ष सोमपाः ||
8.33.e: O thou Most Lofty One, accept our laud as nearest to thine heart.  May our libations be most sweet to make thee glad, O Soma-drinker, Heavenly Lord.

8.33.d: नहि षस्तव नो मम शास्त्रे अन्यस्य रण्यति | यो अस्मान्वीर आनयत ||
8.33.e: Neither in thy decree nor mine, but in another's he delights,—  The man who brought us unto this.

8.33.d: इन्द्रश्चिद घा तदब्रवीत सत्रिया अशास्यं मनः | उतो अह करतुं रघुम ||
8.33.e: Indra himself hath said, The mind of woman brooks not discipline,  Her intellect hath little weight.

8.33.d: सप्ती चिद घा मदच्युता मिथुना वहतो रथम | एवेद धूर्व्र्ष्ण उत्तरा ||
8.33.e: His pair of horses, rushing on in their wild transport, draw his car:  High-lifted is the stallion's yoke.

8.33.d: अधः पश्यस्व मोपरि सन्तरां पादकौ हर | मा ते कषप्लकौ दर्शन सत्री हि बरह्मा बभूविथ ||
8.33.e: Cast down thine eyes and look not up. More closely set thy feet. Let none  See what thy garment veils, for thou, a Brahman, hast become a dame.

8.34.d: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम | दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ||
8.34.e: Come hither, Indra, with thy Bays, come thou to Kaṇva's eulogy.  Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

8.34.d: आ तवा गरावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण यछतु | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: May the stone draw thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice.  Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

8.34.d: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वर्कः | दिवो अमुष्य... ||
8.34.e: The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep.  Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

8.34.d: आ तवा कण्वा इहावसे हवन्ते वाजसातये | दिवो अमुष्य .. . ||
8.34.e: The Kaṇvas call thee hitherward for succour and to win the spoil.  Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

8.34.d: दधामि ते सुतानां वर्ष्णे न पूर्वपाय्यम | दिवो अमुष्य... ||
8.34.e: I set for thee, as for the Strong, the first draught of the juices shed.

8.34.d: समत्पुरन्धिर्न आ गहि विश्वतोधीर्न ऊतये | दिवो अमुष्य... ||
8.34.e: Come with abundant blessings, come with perfect care to succour us.

8.34.d: आ नो याहि महेमते सहस्रोते शतामघ | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: Come, Lord of lofty thought, who hast infinite wealth and countless aids.

8.34.d: आ तवा होता मनुर्हितो देवत्रा वक्षदीड्यः | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: Adorable mid Gods, the Priest good to mankind shall bring thee near.

8.34.d: आ तवा मदच्युता हरी शयेनं पक्षेव वक्षतः | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: As wings the falcon, so thy Bays rushing in joy shall carry thee.

8.34.d: आ याह्यर्य आ परि सवाहा सोमस्य पीतये | दिवो अमुष्य... ||
8.34.e: Come from the enemy to us, to svaha and the Soma-draught.

8.34.d: आ नो याह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: Come hither with thine car inclined to hear, take pleasure in our lauds.

8.34.d: सरूपैरा सु नो गहि सम्भ्र्तैः सम्भ्र्ताश्वः | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: Lord of well-nourished Horses, come with well-fed Steeds alike in hue.

8.34.d: आ याहि पर्वतेभ्यः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपः | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: Come hither from the mountains, come from regions of the sea of air.

8.34.d: आ नो गव्यान्यश्व्या सहस्रा शूर दर्द्र्हि | दिवो अमुष्य .. . ||
8.34.e: Disclose to us O Hero, wealth in thousands both of kine and steeds.

8.34.d: आ नः सहस्रशो भरायुतानि शतानि च | दिवो अमुष्य ... ||
8.34.e: Bring riches hitherward to us in hundreds, thousands, myriads.  Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

8.34.d: आ यदिन्द्रश्च दद्वहे सहस्रं वसुरोचिषः | ओजिष्ठमश्व्यं पशुम ||
8.34.e: The thousand steeds, the mightiest troop, which we and Indra have received  From Vasurocis as a gift,

8.34.d: य रज्रा वातरंहसो.अरुषासो रघुष्यदः | भराजन्ते सूर्या इव ||
8.34.e: The brown that match the wind in speed, and bright bay coursers fleet of foot,  Like Suns, resplendent are they all.

8.34.d: पारावतस्य रातिषु दरवच्चक्रेष्वाशुषु | तिष्ठं वनस्य मध्य आ ||
8.34.e: Mid the Pargvata's rich gifts, swift steeds whose wheels run rapidly,  I seemed to stand amid a wood.

8.35.d: अग्निनेन्द्रेण वरुणेन विष्णुनादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ||
8.35.e: WITH Agni and with Indra, Viṣṇu. Varuṇa, with the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, closely leagued;  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, drink the Soma juice.

8.35.d: विश्वाभिर्धीभिर्भुवनेन वाजिना दिवा पर्थिव्याद्रिभिः सचाभुवा | सजोषसा उषसा ... ||
8.35.e: With all the Holy Thoughts, all being Mighty Ones! in close alliance wil the Mountains, Heaven, and Earth;  Accordant. of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, drink the Soma juice.

8.35.d: विश्वैर्देवैस्त्रिभिरेकादशैरिहाद्भिर्मरुद्भिर्भ्र्गुभिः सचाभुवा | सजोषसा उषसा ... ||
8.35.e: With all the Deities, three times eleven, here, in close alliance with the Maruts, Bhṛgus, Floods;  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, drink the Soma juice.

8.35.d: जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गछतम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ||
8.35.e: Accept the sacrifice, attend to this my call: come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, bring us strengthening food.

8.35.d: सतोमं जुषेथां युवशेव कन्यनां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गछतम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येन चेषं ... ||
8.35.e: Accept our praise-song as a youth accepts a maid. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, bring us strengthening food.

8.35.d: गिरो जुषेथामध्वरं जुषेथां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गछतम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं ... ||
8.35.e: Accept the songs we sing, accept the solemn rite. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, bring us strengthening food.

8.35.d: हारिद्रवेव पतथो वनेदुप सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गछथः | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च तरिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ||
8.35.e: Ye fly as starlings fly unto the forest trees; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aśvins, to our home.

8.35.d: हंसाविव पतथो अध्वगाविव सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गछथः | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च तरिर... ||
8.35.e: Ye fly like swans, like those who travel on their way; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aśvins, to our home.

8.35.d: शयेनाविव पतथो हव्यदातये सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गछथः | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च तरिर... ||
8.35.e: Ye fly to our oblation like a pair of hawks; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aśvins, to our home.

8.35.d: पिबतं च तर्प्णुतं चा च गछतं परजां च धत्तं दरविणं च धत्तम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ||
8.35.e: Come hitherward and drink and satisfy yourselves, bestow upon us progeny and affluence.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, grant us vigorous strength.

8.35.d: जयतं च पर सतुतं च पर चावतं परजां च धत्तं दरविणं च धत्तम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं ... ||
8.35.e: Conquer your foes, protect us, praise your worshippers; bestow upon us progeny and affluence.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, grant us vigorous strength.

8.35.d: हतं च शत्रून यततं च मित्रिणः परजां च धत्तं दरविणं च धत्तम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं ... ||
8.35.e: Slay enemies, animate men whom ye befriend; bestow upon us progeny and affluence.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, grant us vigorous strength.

8.35.d: मित्रावरुणवन्ता उत धर्मवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गछथो हवम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ||
8.35.e: With Mitra, Varuṇa, Dharma, and the Maruts in your company approach unto your praiser's call.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, and with the Ādityas, Aśvins! come.

8.35.d: अङगिरस्वन्ता उत विष्णुवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गछथो हवम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर... ||
8.35.e: With Viṣṇu and the Aṅgirases attending you, and with the Maruts come unto your praiser's call.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, and with the Ādityas, Aśvins! come.

8.35.d: रभुमन्ता वर्षणा वाजवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गछथो हवम | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर... ||
8.35.e: With Ṛbhus and With Vājas. O ye Mighty Ones, leagued with the Maruts come ye to your praiser's call.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, and with the Ādityas, Aśvins! come.

8.35.d: बरह्म जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं धियो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ||
8.35.e: Give spirit to our prayer and animate our thoughts; slay ye the Rākṣasas and drive away disease.  Accordant, of One mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, -the presser's Soma, Aśvins drink.

8.35.d: कषत्रं जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं नॄन हतं रक्षाण्सि सेधतममीवाः | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं ... ||
8.35.e: Strengthen the Ruling Power, strengthen the men of war; slay ye the Rākṣasas and drive away disease.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Aśvins drink.

8.35.d: धेनूर्जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं विशो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं ... ||
8.35.e: Give strength unto the milch-kine, give the people strength, slay ye the Rākṣasas and drive away disease.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Aśvins drink.

8.35.d: अत्रेरिव शर्णुतं पूर्व्यस्तुतिं शयावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येन चाश्विना तिरोह्न्यम ||
8.35.e: As ye heard Atri's earliest eulogy, so hear Śyāvāśva, Soma-presser, ye who reel in joy.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aśvins, three days old.

8.35.d: सर्गानिव सर्जतं सुष्टुतीरुप शयावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना ||
8.35.e: Further like running streams Śyāvāśva's eulogies who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aśvins, three days old.

8.35.d: रश्मीन्रिव यछतमध्वरानुप शयावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता | सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना ... ||
8.35.e: Seize, as ye grasp the reins, Śyāvāśva's solemn rites who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy.  Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aśvins, three days old.

8.35.d: अर्वाग रथं नि यछतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु | आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ||
8.35.e: Drive down your chariot hitherward drink ye the Soma's savoury juice.  Approach, ye Aśvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

8.35.d: नमोवाके परस्थिते अध्वरे नरा विवक्षणस्य पीतये | आ यातं ... ||
8.35.e: When sacrifice which tells our reverence hath begun. Heroes! to drink the gushing juice,  Approach, ye Aśvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

8.35.d: सवाहाक्र्तस्य तर्म्पतं सुतस्य देवावन्धसः | आ यातं ... ||
8.35.e: Sate you with consecrated drink, with juice effused, ye Deities.  Approach, ye Aśvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

8.36.d: अवितासि सुन्वतो वर्क्तबर्हिषः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो | यं ते भागमधारयन विश्वाः सेहानः पर्तना उरु जरयः समप्सुजिन मरुत्वानिन्द्र सत्पते ||
8.36.e: THOU helpest him whose grass is trimmed, who sheds the juice, O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.  The share which they have fixed for thee, thou, Indra, Victor o’er all hosts and space, begirt with Maruts, Lord of Heroes, winner of the floods.

8.36.d: पराव सतोतारं मघवन्नव तवां पिबा सोमं मदाय कंशतक्रतो | यं ते भागं ... ||
8.36.e: Maghavan, help thy worshipper: let him help thee. O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.  The share which they have fixed for thee, etc.

8.36.d: ऊर्जा देवानवस्योजसा तवां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो | यं ते भागं ... ||
8.36.e: Thou aidest Gods with food, and that with might aids thee,  O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

8.36.d: जनिता दिवो जनिता पर्थिव्याः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो | यं ते भागं ... ||
8.36.e: Creator of the heaven, creator of the earth, O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

8.36.d: जनिताश्वानां जनिता गवामसि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो | यं ते भागं ... ||
8.36.e: Father of cattle, father of all steeds art thou. O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

8.36.d: अत्रीणां सतोममद्रिवो महस कर्धि पिबा सोमं मदाय कंशतक्रतो | यं ते भागं ... ||
8.36.e: Stone-hurler, glorify the Atris' hymn of praise. O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

8.36.d: शयावाश्वस्य सुन्वतस्तथा शर्णु यथाश्र्णोरत्रेः कर्माणि कर्ण्वतः | पर तरसदस्युमाविथ तवमेक इन नर्षाह्य इन्द्र बरह्माणि वर्धयन ||
8.36.e: Hear thou Śyāvāśva while he pours to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites.  Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his prayers.

8.37.d: परेदं बरह्म वर्त्रतूर्येष्वाविथ पर सुन्वतः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | माध्यन्दिनस्य सवनस्य वर्त्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ||
8.37.e: THIS prayer, and those who shed the juice, in wars with Vṛtra thou holpest, Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy succours.  O Vṛtra-slayer, from libation poured at noon, drink of the Soma juice, thou blameless Thunderer.

8.37.d: सेहान उग्र पर्तना अभि दरुहः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | माध्यन्दिनस्य ... ||
8.37.e: Thou mighty Conqueror of hostile armaments, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

8.37.d: एकराळ अस्य भुवनस्य राजसि शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | माध्यन्दिनस्य ... ||
8.37.e: Sole Ruler, thou art Sovran of this world of life, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

8.37.d: सस्थावाना यवयसि तवमेक इच्छचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | माध्यन्दिनस्य ... ||
8.37.e: Thou only sunderest these two consistent worlds, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

8.37.d: कषेमस्य च परयुजश्च तवमीशिषे शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | माध्यन्दिनस्य ... ||
8.37.e: Thou art the Lord supreme o’er rest and energy, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

8.37.d: कषत्राय तवमवसि न तवमाविथ शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | माध्यन्दिनस्य ... ||
8.37.e: Thou helpest one to power, and one thou hast not helped, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving aid.

8.37.d: शयावाश्वस्य रेभतस्तथा शर्णु यथाश्र्णोरत्रेः कर्माणि कर्ण्वतः | पर तरसदस्युमाविथ तवमेक इन नर्षाह्य इन्द्र कषत्राणि वर्धयन ||
8.37.e: Hear thou Śyāvāśva while he sings to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites.  Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his powers.

8.38.d: यज्ञस्य हि सथ रत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु | इन्द्राग्नीतस्य बोधतम ||
8.38.e: YE Twain are Priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works:  Indra and Agni, mark this well.

8.38.d: तोशासा रथयावाना वर्त्रहणापराजिता | इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम ||
8.38.e: Ye bounteous riders on the car, ye Vṛtra-slayers unsubdued:  Indra and Agni, mark this well.

8.38.d: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः | इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम ||
8.38.e: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight:  Indra, and Agni, mark this well.

8.38.d: जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये सुतं सोमं सधस्तुती | इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ||
8.38.e: Accept our sacrifice for weal, sharers of praise! the Soma shed:  Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.

8.38.d: इमा जुषेथां सवना येभिर्हव्यान्यूहथुः | इन्द्राग्नीा गतं नरा ||
8.38.e: Be pleased with these libations which attract you to our sacred gifts  Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.

8.38.d: इमां गायत्रवर्तनिं जुषेथां सुष्टुतिं मम | इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ||
8.38.e: Accept this eulogy of mine whose model is the Gāyatrī:  Indra and Agni, Heroes, Come.
Come with the early-faring Gods, ye who are Lords of genuine wealth:  Indra-Agni, to the Soma-draught
Hear ye the call of Atris, hear Śyāvāśva as he sheds the juice:  Indra-Agni to the Soma-draught

8.38.d: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः | इन्द्रग्नी सोमपीतये ||
8.38.e: Thus have I called you to our aid as sages called on you of old:  Indra-Agni to the Soma draught!

8.38.d: आहं सरस्वतीवतोरिन्द्राग्न्योरवो वर्णे | याभ्यां गायत्रं रच्यते ||
8.38.e: Indra's and Agni's grace I claim, Sarasvatī's associates  To whom this psalm of praise is sung.

8.39.d: अग्निमस्तोष्य रग्मियमग्निमीळा यजध्यै | अग्निर्देवाननक्तु न उभे हि विदथे कविरन्तश्चरति दूत्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: THE glorious Agni have I praised, and worshipped with. the sacred food.  May Agni deck the Gods for us. Between both gathering-places he goes on his embassy, the Sage. May all the others die away.

8.39.d: नयग्ने नव्यसा वचस्तनूषु शंसमेषाम | नयराती रराव्णां विश्वा अर्यो अरातीरितो युछन्त्वामुरो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni, burn down the word within their bodies through our newest speech,  All hatreds of the godless, all the wicked man's malignities. Away let the destroyers go. May all the others die away.

8.39.d: अग्ने मन्मानि तुभ्यं कं घर्तं न जुह्व आसनि | स देवेषु पर चिकिद्धि तवं हयसि पूर्व्यः शिवो दूतो विवस्वतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni, I offer hymns to thee, like holy oil within thy mouth.  Acknowledge them. among the Gods, for thou art the most excellent, the worshipper's blissful messenger. Let all the others die away.

8.39.d: तत-तदग्निर्वयो दधे यथा-यथा कर्पण्यति | ऊर्जाहुतिर्वसूनां शं च योश्च मयो दधे विश्वस्यै देवहूत्यै नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni bestows all vital power even as each man supplicates.  He brings the Vasus strengthening gifts, and grants delight, in rest and stir, for every calling on the Gods. Let all the others die away.

8.39.d: स चिकेत सहीयसाग्निश्चित्रेण कर्मणा | स होता शश्वतीनां दक्षिणाभिरभीव्र्त इनोति च परतीव्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni hath made himself renowned by wonderful victorious act.  He is the Priest of all the tribes, chosen with sacrificial meeds. He urges Deities to receive. Let all the others die away.

8.39.d: अग्निर्जाता देवानामग्निर्वेद मर्तानामपीच्यम | अग्निःस दरविणोदा अग्निर्द्वारा वयूर्णुते सवाहुतो नवीयसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni knows all that springs from Gods, he knows the mystery of men.  Giver of wealth is Agni, he uncloses both the doors to us when worshipped with our newest gift. Let all the others die away.

8.39.d: अग्निर्देवेषु संवसुः स विक्षु यज्ञियास्वा | स मुदा काव्या पुरु विश्वं भूमेव पुष्यति देवो देवेषु यज्ञियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni inhabiteth with Gods and men who offer sacrifice.  He cherisheth with great delight much wisdom, as all things that be, God among Gods adorable. May all the others die away.

8.39.d: यो अग्निः सप्तमानुषः शरितो विश्वेषु सिन्धुषु | तमागन्म तरिपस्त्यं मन्धातुर्दस्युहन्तममग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं नभन्तां अन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni who liveth in all streams, Lord of the Sevenfold Race of men,  Him dweller in three homes we seek, best slayer of the Dasyus for Mandhātar, first in sacrifice. Let all the others die away.

8.39.d: अग्निस्त्रीणि तरिधातून्या कषेति विदथा कविः स तरीन्रेकादशानिह यक्षच्च पिप्रयच्च नो विप्रो दूतः परिष्क्र्तो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Agni the Wise inhabiteth three gathering-places, triply formed.  Decked as our envoy let the Sage bring hither and conciliate the Thrice Eleven Deities. Let all the others die away.

8.39.d: तवं नो अग्न आयुषु तवं देवेषु पूर्व्य वस्व एक इरज्यसि | तवामापः परिस्रुतः परि यन्ति सवसेतवो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.39.e: Our Agni, thou art first among the Gods, and first mid living men.  Thou only rulest over wealth. Round about thee, as natural dams, circumfluous the waters run. Let all the others die away.

8.40.d: इन्द्राग्नी युवं सु नः सहन्ता दासथो रयिम | येन दर्ळ्हा समत्स्वा वीळु चित साहिषीमह्यग्निर्वनेव वात इन नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: INDRA and Agni, surely ye as Conquerors will give us wealth,  Whereby in fight we may o’ercome that which is strong and firmly fixed, as Agni burns the woods with wind. Let all the others die away.

8.40.d: नहि वां वव्रयामहे.अथेन्द्रमिद यजामहे शविष्ठं नर्णां नरम | स नः कदा चिदर्वता गमदा वाजसातयेगमदा मेधसातये नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: We set no snares to tangle you; Indra we worship and adore, Hero of heroes mightiest.  Once may he come unto us with his Steed, come unto us to win us strength, and to complete the sacrifice.

8.40.d: ता हि मध्यं भराणामिन्द्राग्नी अधिक्षितः | ता उ कवित्वना कवी पर्छ्यमाना सखीयते सं धीतमश्नुतं नरा नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: For, famous Indra-Agni, ye are dwellers in the midst of frays.  Sages in wisdom, ye are knit to him who seeketh you as friends. Heroes, bestow on him his wish.

8.40.d: अभ्यर्च नभाकवदिन्द्राग्नी यजसा गिरा | ययोर्विश्वमिदं जगदियं दयौः पर्थिवी मह्युपस्थे बिभ्र्तो वसु नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: Nabhāka-like, with sacred song Indra's and Agni's praise I sing,  Theirs to whom all this world belongs, this heaven and this mighty earth which bear rich treasure in their lap.

8.40.d: पर बरह्माणि नभाकवदिन्द्राग्निभ्यामिरज्यत | या सप्तबुध्नमर्णवं जिह्मबारमपोर्णुत इन्द्र ईशान ओजसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: To Indra and to Agni send your prayers, as was Nabhāka's wont,—  Who oped with sideway opening the sea with its foundations seven—Indra all powerful in his might.

8.40.d: अपि वर्श्च पुराणवद वरततेरिव गुष्पितमोजो दासस्य दम्भय | वयं तदस्य सम्भ्र्तं वस्विन्द्रेण वि भजेमहि नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant,  Demolish thou the Dāsa's might. May we with Indra's help divide the treasure he hath gathered up.

8.40.d: यदिन्द्राग्नी जना इमे विह्वयन्ते तना गिरा | अस्माकेभिर्न्र्भिर्वयं सासह्याम पर्तन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: What time with this same song these men call Indra-Agni sundry ways,  May we with our own heroes quell those who provoke us to the fight, and conquer those who strive with us.

8.40.d: या नु शवेताववो दिव उच्चरात उप दयुभिः | इन्द्राग्न्योरनु वरतमुहाना यन्ति सिन्धवो यान सीं बन्धादमुञ्चतां नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: The Two refulgent with their beams rise and come downward from the sky.  By Indra's and by Agni's hest, flowing away, the rivers, run which they released from their restraint.

8.40.d: पूर्वीष ट इन्द्रोपमातयः पूर्वीरुत परशस्तयः सूनोहिन्वस्य हरिवः | वस्वो वीरस्याप्र्चो या नु साधन्त नो धियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: O Indra, many are thine aids, many thy ways of guiding us,  Lord of the Bay Steeds, Hinva's Son. To a Good Hero come our prayers, which soon shall have accomplishment.

8.40.d: तं शिशीता सुव्र्क्तिभिस्त्वेषं सत्वानं रग्मियम | उतो नुचिद य ओजसा शुष्णस्याण्डानि भेदति जेषत सवर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: Inspire him with your holy hymns, the Hero bright and glorious,  Him who with might demolisheth even the brood of Śuṣṇa, and winneth for us the heavenly streams.

8.40.d: तं शिशीता सवध्वरं सत्यं सत्वानं रत्वियम | उतो नुचिद य ओहत आण्डा शुष्णस्य भेदत्यजैः सवर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.40.e: Inspire him worshipped with fair rites, the glorious Hero truly brave.  He brake in pieces Śuṣṇa's brood who still expected not the stroke, and won for us the heavenly streams. Let all the others die away.

8.40.d: एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यां पित्र्वन नवीयो मन्धात्र्वदङगिरस्वदवाचि | तरिधातुना शर्मणा पातमस्मान वयं सयाम पतयो रयीणाम ||
8.40.e: Thus have we sung anew to Indra-Agni, as sang our sires, Aṅgirases, and Mandhātar.  Guard us with triple shelter and preserve us: may we be masters of a store of riches.

8.41.d: अस्मा ऊ षु परभूतये वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यो.अर्चा विदुष्टरेभ्यः | यो धीता मानुषाणां पश्वो गा इव रक्षति नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: To make this Varuṇa come forth sing thou a song unto the band of Maruts wiser than thyself,—  This Varuṇa who guardeth well the thoughts of men like herds of kine.  Let all the others die away.

8.41.d: तमू षु समना गिरा पितॄणां च मन्मभिः नाभाकस्यप्रशस्तिभिर्यः सिन्धूनामुपोदये सप्तस्वसा स मध्यमो नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: Him altogether praise I with the song and hymns our fathers sang, and with Nabhāka's eulogies,—  Him dwelling at the rivers’ source, surrounded by his Sisters Seven.

8.41.d: स कषपः परि षस्वजे नयुस्रो मायया दधे स विश्वं परि दर्शतः | तस्य वेनीरनु वरतमुषस्तिस्रो अवर्धयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: The nights he hath encompassed, and stablished the morns with magic art visible over all is he.  His dear Ones, following his Law, have prospered the Three Dawns for him.

8.41.d: यः ककुभो निधारयः पर्थिव्यामधि दर्शतः | स माता पूर्व्यं पदं तद वरुणस्य सप्त्यं स हि गोपा इवेर्योनभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: He, visible o’er all the earth, stablished the quarters of the sky:  He measured out the eastern place, that is the fold of Varuṇa: like a strong herdsman is the God.

8.41.d: यो धर्ता भुवनानां य उस्राणामपीच्या वेद नामानिगुह्या | स कविः काव्या पुरु रूपं दयौरिव पुष्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: He who supports the worlds of life, he who well knows the hidden names mysterious of the morning beams,  He cherishes much wisdom, Sage, as heaven brings forth each varied form.

8.41.d: यस्मिन विश्वानि काव्या चक्रे नाभिरिव शरिता | तरितं जूती सपर्यत वरजे गावो न संयुजे युजे अश्वानयुक्षत नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: In whom all wisdom centres, as the nave is set within the wheel.  Haste ye to honour Trita, as kine haste to gather in the fold, even as they muster steeds to yoke.

8.41.d: य आस्वत्क आशये विश्वा जातान्येषाम | परि धामानि मर्म्र्शद वरुणस्य पुरो गये विश्वे देवा अनु वरतं नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: He wraps these regions as a robe; he contemplates the tribes of Gods and all the works of mortal men.  Before the home of Varuṇa all the Gods follow his decree.

8.41.d: स समुद्रो अपीच्यस्तुरो दयामिव रोहति नि यदासु यजुर्दधे | स माया अर्चिना पदास्त्र्णान नाकमारुहन नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: He is an Ocean far-removed, yet through the heaven to him ascends the worship which these realms possess.  With his bright foot he overthrew their magic, and went up to heaven.

8.41.d: यस्य शवेता विचक्षणा तिस्रो भूमीरधिक्षितः | तरिरुत्तराणि पप्रतुर्वरुणस्य धरुवं सदः स सप्तानामिरज्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: Ruler, whose bright far-seeing rays, pervading all three earths, have filled the three superior realms of heaven.  Firm is the seat of Varuṇa: over the Seven he rules as King.

8.41.d: यः शवेतानधिनिर्णिजश्चक्रे कर्ष्णाननु वरता | स धाम पूर्व्यं ममे य सकम्भेन वि रोदसी अजो न दयामधारयन नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.41.e: Who, after his decree, o’erspread the Dark Ones with a robe of light;  Who measured out the ancient seat, who pillared both the worlds apart as the Unborn supported heaven. Let all the others die away.

8.42.d: अस्तभ्नाद दयामसुरो विश्ववेदा अमिमीत वरिमाणं पर्थिव्याः | आसीदद विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राड विश्वेत तानि वरुणस्य वरतानि ||
8.42.e: LORD of all wealth, the Asura propped the heavens, and measured out the broad earth's wide expanses.  He, King supreme, approached all living creatures. All these are Varuṇa's holy operations.

8.42.d: एवा वन्दस्व वरुणं बर्हन्तं नमस्या धीरमम्र्तस्य गोपाम | स नः शर्म तरिवरूथं वि यंसत पातं नो दयावाप्र्थिवी उपस्थे ||
