8.42.e: So humbly worship Varuṇa the Mighty revere the wise Guard of World Immortal.  May he vouchsafe us triply-barred protection. O Earth and Heaven, within your lap preserve us.

8.42.d: इमां धियं शिक्षमाणस्य देव करतुं दक्षं वरुण सं शिशाधि | ययाति विश्वा दुरिता तरेम सुतर्माणमधि नावं रुहेम ||
8.42.e: Sharpen this song of him who strives his utmost, sharpen, God Varuṇa, his strength and insight;  May we ascend the ship that bears us safely, whereby we may pass over all misfortune.

8.42.d: आ वां गरावाणो अश्विना धीभिर्विप्रा अचुच्यवुः | नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.42.e: Aśvins, with songs the singer stones have made you hasten hitherward,  Nāsatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

8.42.d: यथा वामत्रिरश्विना गीर्भिर्विप्रो अजोहवीत | नासत्यासोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.42.e: As the sage Atri with his hymns, O Aśvins, called you eagerly,  Nāsatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

8.42.d: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः | नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ||
8.42.e: So have I called you to our aid, even as the wise have called of old,  Nāsatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

8.43.d: इमे विप्रस्य वेधसो.अग्नेरस्त्र्तयज्वनः | गिरः सतोमास ईरते ||
8.43.e: THESE songs of mine go forth as lauds of Agni, the disposing Sage,  Whose worshipper is ne’er o’erthrown.

8.43.d: अस्मै ते परतिहर्यते जातवेदो विचर्षणे | अग्ने जनामि सुष्टुतिम ||
8.43.e: Wise Agni Jātavedas, I beget a song of praise for thee.  Who willingly receivest it.

8.43.d: आरोका इव घेदह तिग्मा अग्ने तव तविषः | दद्भिर्वनानि बप्सति ||
8.43.e: Thy sharpened flames, O Agni, like the gleams of light that glitter through,  Devour the forests with their teeth.

8.43.d: हरयो धूमकेतवो वातजूता उप दयवि | यतन्ते वर्थगग्नयः ||
8.43.e: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven  Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.

8.43.d: एते तये वर्थगग्नय इद्धासः समद्र्क्षत | उषसामिव केतवः ||
8.43.e: These lightly kindled fiery flames are all around made visible,  Even as the gleanings of the Dawns.

8.43.d: कर्ष्णा रजांसि पत्सुतः परयाणे जातवेदसः | अग्निर्यद रोधति कषमि ||
8.43.e: As Jātavedas speeds along, the dust is black beneath his feet,  When Agni spreads upon the earth.

8.43.d: धासिं कर्ण्वान ओषधीर्बप्सदग्निर्न वायति | पुनर्यन तरुणीरपि ||
8.43.e: Making the plants his nourishment, Agni devours and wearies not,  Seeking the tender shrubs again.

8.43.d: जिह्वाभिरह नन्नमदर्चिषा जञ्जणाभवन | अग्निर्वनेषु रोचते ||
8.43.e: Bending him down with all his tongues, he flickers with his fiery glow  Splendid is Agni in the woods.

8.43.d: अप्स्वग्ने सधिष टव सौशधीरनु रुध्यसे | गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः ||
8.43.e: Agni, thine home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way,  And as their Child art born anew.

8.43.d: उदग्ने तव तद घर्तादर्ची रोचत आहुतम | निंसानं जुह्वो मुखे ||
8.43.e: Worshipped with offerings shines thy flame, O Agni, from the sacred oil,  With kisses on the ladle's mouth.

8.43.d: उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमप्र्ष्ठाय वेधसे | सतोमैर्विधेमाग्नये ||
8.43.e: Let us serve Agni with our hymns, Disposer, fed on ox and cow,  Who bears the Soma on his back.

8.43.d: उत तवा नमसा वयं होतर्वरेण्यक्रतो | अग्ने समिद्भिरीमहे ||
8.43.e: Yea, thee, O Agni, do we seek with homage and with fuel, Priest  Whose wisdom is most excellent.

8.43.d: उत तवा भर्गुवच्छुचे मनुष्वदग्न आहुत | अङगिरस्वद धवामहे ||
8.43.e: O worshipped with oblations, pure Agni, we call on thee as erst,  Did Bhṛgu, Manus, Aṅgiras.

8.43.d: तवं हयग्ने अग्निना विप्रो विप्रेण सन सता | सखा सख्या समिध्यसे ||
8.43.e: For thou, O Agni, by the fire, Sage by the Sage, Good by the Good,  Friend by the Friend, art lighted up.

8.43.d: स तवं विप्राय दाशुषे रयिं देहि सहस्रिणम | अग्ने वीरवतीमिषम ||
8.43.e: So wealth in thousands, food with store of heroes give thou to the sage,  O Agni, to the worshipper.

8.43.d: अग्ने भरातः सहस्क्र्त रोहिदश्व शुचिव्रत | इमं सतोमंजुषस्व मे ||
8.43.e: O Agni, Brother, made by strength, Lord of red steeds and brilliant sway,  Take pleasure in this laud of mine.

8.43.d: उत तवाग्ने मम सतुतो वाश्राय परतिहर्यते | गोष्ठं गाव इवाशत ||
8.43.e: My praises, Agni, go to thee, as the cows seek the stall to meet,  The lowing calf that longs for milk.

8.43.d: तुभ्यं ता अङगिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पर्थक | अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ||
8.43.e: Agni, best Aṅgiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes,  Apart, have turned as to their wish.

8.43.d: अग्निं धीभिर्मनीषिणो मेधिरासो विपश्चितः | अद्मसद्याय हिन्विरे ||
8.43.e: The sages skilled in holy song and thinkers with their thoughts have urged  Agni to share the sacred feast.

8.43.d: तं तवामज्मेषु वाजिनं तन्वाना अग्ने अध्वरम | वह्निंहोतारमीळते ||
8.43.e: So, Agni, unto thee the Priest, Invoker, strong in forays, pray  Those who spin out the sacrifice.

8.43.d: पुरुत्रा हि सद्रंं असि विशो विश्वा अनु परभुः | समत्सुत्वा हवामहे ||
8.43.e: In many a place, the same in look art thou, a Prince o’er all the tribes  In battles we invoke thine aid.

8.43.d: तमीळिष्व य आहुतो.अग्निर्विभ्राजते घर्तैः | इमं नःश्र्णवद धवम ||
8.43.e: Pray thou to Agni, pray to him who blazes served with sacred oil:  Let him give ear to this our call.

8.43.d: तं तवा वयं हवामहे शर्ण्वन्तं जातवेदसम | अग्ने घनन्तमप दविषः ||
8.43.e: We call on thee as such, as one who hears, as Jātavedas, one,  Agni! who beats away our foes.

8.43.d: विशां राजानमद्भुतमध्यक्षं धर्मणामिमम | अग्निमीळे स उ शरवत ||
8.43.e: I pray to Agni, King of men, the Wonderful, the President  Of holy Laws: may he give ear.

8.43.d: अग्निं विश्वायुवेपसं मर्यं न वाजिनं हितम | सप्तिं न वाजयामसि ||
8.43.e: Him like a bridegroom, him who stirs all people, like a noble horse,  Like a fleet steed, we instigate.

8.43.d: घनन मर्ध्राण्यप दविषो दहन रक्षांसि विश्वहा | अग्नेतिग्मेन दीदिहि ||
8.43.e: Slaying things deadly, burning up foes, Rākṣasas, on every side,  Shine, Agni, with thy sharpened flame.

8.43.d: यं तवा जनास इन्धते मनुष्वदङगिरस्तम | अग्ने स बोधिमे वचः ||
8.43.e: Thou whom the people kindle even as Manus did, best Aṅgiras!  O Agni, mark thou this my speech.

8.43.d: यदग्ने दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्क्र्त | तं तवा गीर्भिर्हवामहे ||
8.43.e: O Agni, made by strength! be thou born in the heavens or born in floods,  As such we call on thee with songs.

8.43.d: तुभ्यं घेत ते जना इमे विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पर्थक | धासिं हिन्वन्त्यत्तवे ||
8.43.e: Yea, all the people, all the folk who have good dwellings, each apart,  Send food for thee to eat thereof.

8.43.d: ते घेदग्ने सवाध्यो.अहा विश्वा नर्चक्षसः | तरन्तः सयाम दुर्गहा ||
8.43.e: O Agni, so may we, devout, gazed at by men, throughout our days,  Pass lightly over all distress.

8.43.d: अग्निं मन्द्रं पुरुप्रियं शीरं पावकशोचिषम | हर्द्भिर्मन्द्रेभिरीमहे ||
8.43.e: We venerate with cheerful hearts the cheerful Agni, dear to all,  Burning, with purifying flame.

8.43.d: स तवमग्ने विभावसुः सर्जन सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः | शर्धन तमांसि जिघ्नसे ||
8.43.e: So thou, O Agni rich in light, beaming like Sūrya with thy rays  Boldly demolishest the gloom,

8.43.d: तत ते सहस्व ईमहे दात्रं यन नोपदस्यति | तवदग्ने वार्यं वसु ||
8.43.e: We pray to thee for this thy gift, Victor the gift that faileth not,  O Agni, choicest wealth from thee.

8.44.d: समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत घर्तैर्बोधयतातिथिम | आस्मिन हव्याजुहोतन ||
8.44.e: PAY service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil:  In him present your offerings.

8.44.d: अग्ने सतोमं जुषस्व मे वर्धस्वानेन मन्मना | परति सूक्तानि हर्य नः ||
8.44.e: Agni, do thou accept my laud, be magnified by this my song:  Welcome my sweetly-spoken words.

8.44.d: अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे हव्यवाहमुप बरुवे | देवाना सादयादिह ||
8.44.e: Agni, envoy, I place in front; the oblation-bearer I address:  Here let him seat the Deities.

8.44.d: उत ते बर्हन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः | अग्ने शुक्रासीरते ||
8.44.e: Agni, the lofty flames of thee enkindled have gone up on high,  Thy bright flames, thou Refulgent One.

8.44.d: उप तवा जुह्वो मम घर्ताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत | अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः ||
8.44.e: Beloved! let my ladles full of sacred oil come near to thee:  Agni, accept our offerings.

8.44.d: मन्द्रं होतारं रत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम | अग्निमीळे स उ शरवत ||
8.44.e: I worship Agni—may he hear!—the cheerful, the Invoker, Priest,  Of varied splendour, rich in light.

8.44.d: परत्नं होतारमीड्यं जुष्टमग्निं कविक्रतुम | अध्वराणामभिश्रियम ||
8.44.e: Ancient Invoker, meet for praise, beloved Agni, wise and strong,  The visitant of solemn rites.

8.44.d: जुषानो अङगिरस्तमेमा हव्यान्यानुषक | अग्ने यज्ञं नयर्तुथा ||
8.44.e: Agni, best Aṅgiras, accept straightway these offerings, and guide  The seasonable sacrifice.

8.44.d: समिधान उ सन्त्य शुक्रशोच इहा वह | चिकित्वान दैव्यं जनम ||
8.44.e: Excellent God, with brilliant flames, enkindled bring thou hitherward,  Knowing the way, the Heavenly Host.

8.44.d: विप्रं होतारमद्रुहं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम | यज्ञानां केतुमीमहे ||
8.44.e: Him, Sage and Herald, void of guile, ensign of sacrifices, him  Smoke-bannered, rich in light, we seek.

8.44.d: अग्ने नि पाहि नस्त्वं परति षम देव रीषतः | भिन्धि दवेषः सहस्क्र्त ||
8.44.e: O Agni, be our Guardian thou, God, against those who injure us:  Destroy our foes, thou Son of Strength.

8.44.d: अग्निः परत्नेन मन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वं सवाम | कविर्विप्रेण वाव्र्धे ||
8.44.e: Making his body beautiful, Agni the Sage hath waxen by  The singer and his ancient hymn.

8.44.d: ऊर्जो नपातमा हुवे.अग्निं पावकशोचिषम | अस्मिन यज्ञे सवध्वरे ||
8.44.e: I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni with purifying flame,  At this well-ordered sacrifice.

8.44.d: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण सोचिषा | देवैरा सत्सिबर्हिषि ||
8.44.e: So Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour, seat thyself  With Gods upon our sacred grass.

8.44.d: यो अग्निं तन्वो दमे देवं मर्तः सपर्यति | तस्मा इद दीदयद वसु ||
8.44.e: The mortal man who serves the God Agni within his own abode,  For him he causes wealth to shine.

8.44.d: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत पतिः पर्थिव्या अयम | अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति ||
8.44.e: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he:  He quickeneth the waters’ seed.

8.44.d: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भराजन्त ईरते | तव जयोतींष्यर्चयः ||
8.44.e: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high,  Thy lustres, fair effulgences.

8.44.d: ईषिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने सवर्पतिः | सतोता सयां तव शर्मणि ||
8.44.e: For, Agni, thou as Lord of Light rulest o’er choicest gifts: may I,  Thy singer, find defence in thee.

8.44.d: तवामग्ने मनीषिणस्त्वां हिन्वन्ति चित्तिभिः | तवां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ||
8.44.e: O Agni, they who understand stir thee to action with their thoughts:  So let our songs enhance thy might.

8.44.d: अदब्धस्य सवधावतो दूतस्य रेभतः सदा | अग्नेः सख्यं वर्णीमहे ||
8.44.e: We ever claim the friendship of Agni, the singing messenger,  Of God-like nature, void of guile.

8.44.d: अग्निः शुचिव्रततमः शुचिर्विप्रः शुचिः कविः | शुचीरोचत आहुतः ||
8.44.e: Agni who bears most holy sway, the holy Singer, holy Sage,  Shines holy when we worship him.

8.44.d: उत तवा धीतयो मम गिरो वर्धन्तु विश्वहा | अग्ने सख्यस्य बोधि नः ||
8.44.e: Yea, let my meditations, let my songs exalt thee evermore.  Think, Agni, of our friendly bond,

8.44.d: यदग्ने सयामहं तवं तवं वा घा सया अहम | सयुष टे सत्या इहाशिषः ||
8.44.e: If I were thou and thou wert I, O Agni, every prayer of thine  Should have its due fulfilment here.

8.44.d: वसुर्वसुपतिर्हि कमस्यग्ने विभावसुः | सयाम ते सुमतावपि ||
8.44.e: For Excellent and Lord of wealth. art thou O Agni, rich in light:  May we enjoy thy favouring grace.

8.44.d: अग्ने धर्तव्रताय ते समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः | गिरो वाश्रासीरते ||
8.44.e: Agni, to thee whose laws stand fast our resonant songs of praise speed forth,  As rivers hasten to the sea.

8.44.d: युवानं विश्पतिं कविं विश्वादं पुरुवेपसम | अग्निं शुम्भामि मन्मभिः ||
8.44.e: Agni, the Youthful Lord of men, who stirreth much and eateth all,  The Sage, I glorify with hymns.

8.44.d: यज्ञानां रथ्ये वयं तिग्मजम्भाय वीळवे | सतोमैरिषेमाग्नये ||
8.44.e: To Agni let us haste with lauds, the Guide of sacrificial rites,  Armed with sharp teeth, the Mighty One.

8.44.d: अयमग्ने तवे अपि जरिता भूतु सन्त्य | तस्मै पावक मर्ळय ||
8.44.e: And let this man, good Agni, be with thee the singer of thy praise:  Be gracious, Holy One, to him.

8.44.d: धीरो हयस्यद्मसद विप्रो न जाग्र्विः सदा | अग्ने दीदयसि दयवि ||
8.44.e: For thou art sharer of our feast, wise, ever watchful as a Sage:  Agni, thou shinest in the sky.

8.44.d: पुराग्ने दुरितेभ्यः पुरा मर्ध्रेभ्यः कवे | पर ण आयुर्वसो तिर ||
8.44.e: O Agni, Sage, before our foes, before misfortunes fall on us,  Excellent Lord, prolong our lives.

8.45.d: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते सत्र्णन्ति बर्हिरानुषक | येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ||
8.45.e: HITHERWARD! they who light flame and straightway trim the sacred grass.  Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

8.45.d: बर्हन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्तं पर्थुः सवरुः | येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ||
8.45.e: High is their fuel, great their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake,  Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

8.45.d: अयुद्ध इद युधा वर्तं शूर आजति सत्वभिः | येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ||
8.45.e: Unequalled  in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs.  Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

8.45.d: आ बुन्दं वर्त्रहा ददे जातः पर्छद वि मातरम | क उग्राः के ह शर्ण्विरे ||
8.45.e: The new-born Vṛtra-slayer asked his Mother, as he seized his shaft,  Who are the fierce? Who are renowned?

8.45.d: परति तवा शवसी वदद गिरावप्सो न योधिषत | यस्ते शत्रुत्वमाचके ||
8.45.e: Śavasī answered, He who seeks thine enmity will battle like  A stately elephant on a hill.

8.45.d: उत तवं मघवञ्छ्र्णु यस्ते वष्टि ववक्षि तत | यद वीळयासि वीळु तत ||
8.45.e: And hear, O Maghavan; to him who craves of thee thou grantest all  Whate’er thou makest firm is firm.

8.45.d: यदाजिं यात्याजिक्र्दिन्द्रः सवश्वयुरुप | रथीतमो रथीनाम ||
8.45.e: What time the Warrior Indra goes to battle, borne by noble steeds,  Best of all charioteers is he.

8.45.d: वि षु विश्वा अभियुजो वज्रिन विष्वग यथा वर्ह | भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः ||
8.45.e: Repel, O Thunder-armed, in all directions all attacks on us:  And be our own most glorious God.

8.45.d: अस्माकं सु रथं पुर इन्द्रः कर्णोतु सातये | न यं धूर्वन्ति धूर्तयः ||
8.45.e: May Indra set our car in front, in foremost Place to win the spoil,  He whom the wicked injure not.

8.45.d: वर्ज्याम ते परि दविषो.अरं ते शक्र दावने | गमेमेदिन्द्रगोमतः ||
8.45.e: Thine enmity may we escape, and, Śakra, for thy bounty, rich  In kine, may we come near to thee

8.45.d: शनैश्चिद यन्तो अद्रिवो.अश्वावन्तः शतग्विनः | विवक्षणा अनेहसः ||
8.45.e: Softly approaching, Thunder-armed wealthy by hundreds, rich in steeds,  Unrivalled, ready with our gifts.

8.45.d: ऊर्ध्वा हि ते दिवे-दिवे सहस्रा सून्र्ता शता | जरित्रिभ्योविमंहते ||
8.45.e: For thine exalted excellence gives to thy worshippers each day  Hundreds and thousands of thy boons.

8.45.d: विद्मा हि तवा धनंजयमिन्द्र दर्ळ्हा चिदारुजम | आदारिणं यथा गयम ||
8.45.e: Indra, we know thee breaker-down even of strong forts, winner of spoil,  As one who conquers wealth for us.

8.45.d: ककुहं चित तवा कवे मन्दन्तु धर्ष्णविन्दवः | आ तवा पणिं यदीमहे ||
8.45.e: Though thou art highest, Sage and Bold! let the drops cheer thee when we come  To thee as to a trafficker.

8.45.d: यस्ते रेवानदाशुरिः परममर्ष मघत्तये | तस्य नो वेद आ भर ||
8.45.e: Bring unto us the treasure of the opulent man who, loth to give,  Hath slighted thee for gain of wealth.

8.45.d: इम उ तवा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः | पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम ||
8.45.e: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee,  As men with fodder to the herd.

8.45.d: उत तवाबधिरं वयं शरुत्कर्णं सन्तमूतये | दूरादिह हवामहे ||
8.45.e: And thee who art not deaf, whose cars are quick to listen, for our aid,  We call to us from far away.

8.45.d: यच्छुश्रूया इमं हवं दुर्मर्षं चक्रिया उत | भवेरापिर्नो अन्तमः ||
8.45.e: When thou hast listened, make our call one which thou never wilt forget,  And be our very nearest Friend.

8.45.d: यच्चिद धि ते अपि वयथिर्जगन्वांसो अमन्महि | गोदा इदिन्द्र बोधि नः ||
8.45.e: When even now, when we have been in trouble, we have thought of thee,  O Indra, give us gifts of kine.

8.45.d: आ तवा रम्भं न जिव्रयो ररभ्मा शवसस पते | उश्मसि तवा सधस्थ आ ||
8.45.e: O Lord of Strength, we rest on thee, as old men rest upon a staff:  We long to have. thee dwell with us.

8.45.d: सतोत्रमिन्द्राय गायत पुरुन्र्म्णाय सत्वने | नकिर्यं वर्ण्वते युधि ||
8.45.e: To Indra sing a song of praise, Hero of mighty valour, him  Whom no one challenges to war.

8.45.d: अभि तवा वर्षभा सुते सुतं सर्जामि पीतये | तर्म्पा वयश्नुही मदम ||
8.45.e: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink:  Sate thee and finish thy carouse.

8.45.d: मा तवा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन | माकीं बरह्मद्विषो वनः ||
8.45.e: Let not the fools, or those who mock beguile thee when they seek thine aid  Love not the enemies of prayer.

8.45.d: इह तवा गोपरीणसा महे मन्दन्तु राधसे | सरो गौरो यथा पिब ||
8.45.e: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence:  Drink as the wild-bull drinks the lake.

8.45.d: या वर्त्रहा परावति सना नवा च चुच्युवे | ता संसत्सुप्र वोचत ||
8.45.e: Proclaim in our assemblies what deeds, new and ancient, far away,  The Vṛtra-slayer hath achieved.

8.45.d: अपिबत कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे | अत्रादेदिष्ट पौंस्यम ||
8.45.e: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadrū's Soma juice:  There he displayed his manly might.

8.45.d: सत्यं तत तुर्वशे यदौ विदानो अह्नवाय्यम | वयानट तुर्वणे शमि ||
8.45.e: True undeniable strength he found in Yadu and in Turvaśa,  And conquered through the sacrifice.

8.45.d: तरणिं वो जनानां तरदं वाजस्य गोमतः | समानमु पर शंसिषम ||
8.45.e: Him have I magnified, our Lord in, common, Guardian of your folk,  Discloser of great wealth in kine;

8.45.d: रभुक्षणं न वर्तव उक्थेषु तुग्र्याव्र्धम | इन्द्रं सोमेसचा सुते ||
8.45.e: Ṛbhukṣan, not to be restrained, who strengthened Tugra's son in lauds,  Indra beside the flowing juice;

8.45.d: यः कर्न्तदिद वि योन्यं तरिशोकाय गिरिं पर्थुम | गोभ्यो गातुं निरेतवे ||
8.45.e: Who for Triśoka clave the hill that formed a wide receptacle,  So that the cows might issue forth.

8.45.d: यद दधिषे मनस्यसि मन्दानः परेदियक्षसि | मा तत करिन्द्र मर्ळय ||
8.45.e: Whate’er thy plan or purpose be, whate’er, in transport, thou wouldst do,  Do it not, Indra, but be kind.

8.45.d: दभ्रं चिद धि तवावतः कर्तं शर्ण्वे अधि कषमि | जिगात्विन्द्र ते मनः ||
8.45.e: But little hath been heard of done upon the earth by one like thee i  Let thine heart, Indra, turn to us.

8.45.d: तवेदु ताः सुकीर्तयो.असन्नुत परशस्तयः | यदिन्द्र मर्ळयासि नः ||
8.45.e: Thine then shall be this high renown, thine shall these lofty praises be,  When, Indra, thou art kind to us.

8.45.d: मा न एकस्मिन्नागसि मा दवयोरुत तरिषु | वधीर्मा शूर भूरिषु ||
8.45.e: Not for one trespass, not for two, O Hero, slay us, nor for three,  Nor yet for many trespasses.

8.45.d: बिभया हि तवावत उग्रादभिप्रभङगिणः | दस्मादहम्र्तीषहः ||
8.45.e: I fear one powerful like thee, the crusher-down of enemies,  Mighty, repelling all attacks.

8.45.d: मा सख्युः शूनमा विदे मा पुत्रस्य परभूवसो | आव्र्त्वद भूतु ते मनः ||
8.45.e: O wealthy God, ne’er may I live to see my friend or son in need:  Hitherward let thy heart be turned.

8.45.d: को नु मर्या अमिथितः सखा सखायमब्रवीत | जहा को अस्मदीषते ||
8.45.e: What friend, O people, unprovoked, hath ever said unto a friend,  He turns and leaves us in distress?

8.45.d: एवारे वर्षभा सुते.असिन्वन भूर्यावयः | शवघ्नीव निवता चरन ||
8.45.e: Hero, insatiate enjoy this Soma juice so near to thee,  Even as a hunter rushing down.

8.45.d: आ त एता वचोयुजा हरी गर्भ्णे सुमद्रथा | यदीं बरह्मभ्य इद ददः ||
8.45.e: Hither I draw those Bays of thine yoked  by our hymn, with splendid car,  That thou mayst give unto the priests.

8.45.d: भिन्धि विश्वा अप दविषः परि बाधो जही मर्धः | वसुस्पार्हं तदा भर ||
8.45.e: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around,  And bring the wealth for which we long:

8.45.d: यद वीळाविन्द्र यत सथिरे यत पर्शाने पराभ्र्तम | वसुस्पार्हं तदा भर ||
8.45.e: O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipitous:  Bring us the wealth for which we long

8.45.d: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति | वसु सपार्हं तदा भर ||
8.45.e: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thee:  Bring us the wealth for which we long.

8.46.d: तवावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र परणेतः समसि सथातर्हरीणाम ||
8.46.e: WE, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our Guide, depend on one like thee,  Thou driver of the Tawny Steeds.

8.46.d: तवां हि सत्यमद्रिवो विद्म दातारमिषाम | विद्म दातारं रयीणाम ||
8.46.e: For, Hurler of the Bolt, we know thee true, the giver of our food,  We know the giver of our wealth.

8.46.d: आ यस्य ते महिमानं शतमूते शतक्रतो | गीर्भिर्ग्र्णन्ति कारवः ||
8.46.e: O thou whose majesty the bards celebrate with their songs, thou Lord,  Of hundred powers and hundred aids.

8.46.d: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा | मित्रः पान्त्यद्रुहः ||
8.46.e: Fair guidance hath the mortal man whom Aryaman, the Marut host,  And Mitra, void of guile, protect.

8.46.d: दधानो गोमदश्ववद सुवीर्यमादित्यजूत एधते | सदा राया पुरुस्प्र्हा ||
8.46.e: Kine, steeds, and hero strength he gains, and prospers, by the Ādityas sped,  Ever in wealth which all desire.

8.46.d: तमिन्द्रं दानमीमहे शवसानमभीर्वम | ईशानं राय ईमहे ||
8.46.e: We pray to Indra for his gift, to him the Fearless and the Strong,  We pray to him the Lord of wealth.

8.46.d: तस्मिन हि सन्त्यूतयो विश्वा अभीरवः सचा | तमा वहन्तु सप्तयः पुरूवसुं मदाय हरयः सुतम ||
8.46.e: For verily combined in him are all the fearless powers of aid.  Him, rich in wealth, let swift Steeds bring to us, his Bays, to Soma juice for his carouse:

8.46.d: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यो य इन्द्र वर्त्रहन्तमः | य आददिः सवर्न्र्भिर्यः पर्तनासु दुष्टरः ||
8.46.e: Yea, that most excellent carouse, Indra, which slays most enemies,  With Heroes wins the light of heaven, and is invincible in war:

8.46.d: यो दुष्टरो विश्ववार शरवाय्यो वाजेष्वस्ति तरुता | सनः शविष्ठ सवना वसो गहि गमेम गोमति वरजे ||
8.46.e: Which merits fame, all-bountiful! and, unsubdued, hath victory in deeds of might.  So come to our libations, Strongest! Excellent! May we obtain a stall of kine.

8.46.d: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया | वरिवस्य महामह ||
8.46.e: Responding to our wish for cows, for steeds, and chariots, as of old,  Be gracious, Greatest of the Great

8.46.d: नहि ते शूर राधसो.अन्तं विन्दामि सत्रा | दशस्या नो मघवन नू चिदद्रिवो धियो वाजेभिराविथ ||
8.46.e: For, Hero, nowhere can I find the bounds of thy munificence.  Still do thou favour us, O Bolt-armed Maghavan: with strength hast thou rewarded hymns.

8.46.d: य रष्वः शरावयत्सखा विश्वेत स वेद जनिमा पुरुष्टुतः | तं विश्वे मानुषा युगेन्द्रं हवन्ते तविषं यतस्रुचः ||
8.46.e: High, glorifier of his friend, he knows all generations, he whom many praise.  All races of mankind with ladies lifted up invoke that Mighty Indra's aid.

8.46.d: स नो वाजेष्वविता पुरूवसुः पुरःस्थाता मघवा वर्त्रहा भुवत ||
8.46.e: Be he our Champion and Protector in great deeds, rich in all wealth, the Vṛtra-slayer, Maghavan.

8.46.d: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम | इन्द्रं नाम शरुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा ||
8.46.e: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your Hero with high laud, to him the Wise,  To Indra, glorious in his name, the Mighty One, even as the hymn alloweth it.

8.46.d: ददी रेक्णस्तन्वे ददिर्वसु ददिर्वाजेषु पुरुहूत वाजिनम | नूनमथ ||
8.46.e: Thou givest wealth to me myself, thou givest treasure, Excellent! and the strong steed,  O Much-invoked, in deeds of might, yea, even now.

8.46.d: विश्वेषामिरज्यन्तं वसूनां सासह्वांसं चिदस्य वर्पसः | कर्पयतो नूनमत्यथ ||
8.46.e: Him, Sovran Ruler of all precious things, who even hath power o’er this fair form of his,  As now it taketh shape, and afterward,

8.46.d: महः सु वो अरमिषे सतवामहे मीळ्हुषे अरंगमाय जग्मये | यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिर्विश्वमनुषां मरुतामियक्षसि गायेत्वा नमसा गिरा ||
8.46.e: We praise, so that the Mighty One may speed to you, Pourer of  bounties  , Traveller, prepared to go.  Thou favourest the Maruts known to all, by song and sacrifice.  With song and praise I sing to thee.

8.46.d: ये पातयन्ते अज्मभिर्गिरीणां सनुभिरेषाम | यज्ञं महिष्वणीनां सुम्नं तुविष्वणीनां पराध्वरे ||
8.46.e: We in the sacrifice perform their will whose voice is lifted high,  The worship of those Thundering Ones who o’er the ridges of these mountains fly in troops.

8.46.d: परभङगं दुर्मतीनामिन्द्र शविष्ठा भर | रयिमस्मभ्यं युज्यं चोदयन्मते जयेष्ठं चोदयन्मते ||
8.46.e: O Indra, Mightiest, bring us that which crushes men of evil minds,  Wealth suited to our needs, O Stirrer of the thought, best wealth, O thou who stirrest thought.

8.46.d: सनितः सुसनितरुग्र चित्र चेतिष्ठ सून्र्त | परासहा सम्राट सहुरिं सहन्तं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम ||
8.46.e: O Winner, noble winner, strong, wondrous, most splendid, excellent,  Sole Lord of victory, bring all-overpowering wealth, joy-giving, chief in deeds of might.

8.46.d: आ स एतु य ईवदानदेवः पूर्तमाददे | यथा चिद वशो अश्व्यः पर्थुश्रवसि कानीते.अस्या वयुष्याददे ||
8.46.e: Now let the godless man approach who hath received reward so great  As Vaśa, Aśvya, when this light of morning dawned, received from Pṛthuśravas, from Kanīta's son.

8.46.d: षष्टिं सहस्राश्व्यस्यायुतासनमुष्ट्रानां विंशतिंशता | दश शयावीनां शता दश तर्यरुषीणां दश गवां सहस्रा ||
8.46.e: Steeds sixty thousand and ten thousand kine, and twenty hundred camels I obtained;  Ten hundred brown in hue, and other ten red in three spots: in all, ten thousand kine.

8.46.d: दश शयावा रधद्रयो वीतवारास आशवः | मथ्रा नेमिं नि वाव्र्तुः ||
8.46.e: Ten browns that make my wealth increase, fleet steeds whose tails are long and fair,  Turn with swift whirl my chariot wheel;

8.46.d: दानासः पर्थुश्रवसः कानीतस्य सुराधसः | रथं हिरण्ययं ददन मंहिष्टः सूरिरभूद वर्षिष्ठमक्र्त शरवः ||
8.46.e: The gifts which Pṛthuśravas gave, Kanīta's son munificent.  He gave a chariot wrought of gold: the prince was passing bountiful, and won himself most lofty fame.

8.46.d: आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे | वयं हि ते चक्र्मा भूरि दावने सद्यश्चिन महि दावने ||
8.46.e: Come thou to this great rite of ours, Vāyu! to give us vigorous light.  We have served thee that thou mightest give much to us, yea, mightest quickly give great wealth.

8.46.d: यो अश्वेभिर्वहते वस्त उस्रास्त्रिः सप्त सप्ततीनाम | एभिः सोमेभिः सोमसुद्भिः सोमपा दानाय शुक्रपूतपाः ||
8.46.e: Who with thrice seven times seventy horses comes to us, invested with the rays of morn,  Through these our Soma-draughts and those who press, to give, drinker of pure bright Soma Juice.

8.46.d: यो म इमं चिदु तमनामन्दच्चित्रं दावने | अरट्वे अक्षेनहुषे सुक्र्त्वनि सुक्र्त्तराय सुक्रतुः ||
8.46.e: Who hath inclined this glorious one, bounteous himself, to give me gifts.  Borne on firm chariot with the prosperous Nahuṣa, wise, to a man yet more devout.

8.46.d: उचथ्ये वपुषि यः सवराळ उत वायो घर्तस्नाः | अश्वेषितं रजेषितं शुनेषितं पराज्म तदिदं नु तत ||
8.46.e: Sole Lord in beauty meet for praise, O Vāyu, dropping fatness down,  Hurried along by steeds, by camels, and by hounds, spreads forth thy train: even this it is.

8.46.d: अध परियमिषिराय षस्टिं सहस्रासनम | अश्वानामिन न वर्ष्णाम ||
8.46.e: So, as a prize dear to the strong, the sixty thousand have I gained,  Bulls that resemble vigorous steeds.

8.46.d: गावो न यूथमुप यन्ति वध्रय उप मा यन्ति वध्रयः ||
8.46.e: To me come oxen like a herd, yea, unto me the oxen come.

8.46.d: अध यच्चारथे गणे शतमुष्ट्रानचिक्रदत | अध शवित्नेषु विंशतिं शता ||
8.46.e: And in the grazing herd he made a hundred camels bleat for me,  And twenty hundred mid the white.

8.46.d: शतं दासे बल्बूथे विप्रस्तरुक्ष आ ददे | ते ते वायविमे जना मदन्तीन्द्रगोपा मदन्ति देवगोपाः ||
8.46.e: A hundred has the sage received, Dāsa Balbūtha's and Tarukṣa's gifts.  These are thy people, Vāyu, who rejoice with Indra for their guard, rejoice with Gods for guards.

8.46.d: अध सया योषणा मही परतीची वशमश्व्यम | अधिरुक्मा वि नीयते ||
8.46.e: And now to Vaśa Aśvya here this stately woman is led forth,  Adorned with ornaments of gold.

8.47.d: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्र दाशुषे | यमादित्या अभि दरुहो रक्षथा नेमघं नशदनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: GREAT help ye give the worshipper, Varuṇa, Mitra, Mighty Ones! No sorrow ever reaches him whom ye, Ādityas, keep from harm. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

8.47.d: विदा देवा अघानामादित्यासो अपाक्र्तिम | पक्षा वयो यथोपरि वयस्मे शर्म यछतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: O Gods, Ādityas, well ye know the way to keep all woes afar.  As the birds spread their sheltering wings, spread your protection over us.

8.47.d: वयस्मे अधि शर्म तत पक्षा वयो न यन्तन | विश्वानि विश्ववेदसो वरूथ्या मनामहे.अनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: As the birds spread their sheltering wings let your protection cover us.  We mean all shelter and defence, ye who have all things for your own.

8.47.d: यस्मा अरासत कषयं जीवातुं च परचेतसः | मनोर्विश्वस्य घेदिम आदित्या राय ईशते.अनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: To whomsoever they, Most Wise, have given a home and means of life,  O'er the whole riches of this man they, the Ādityas, have control.

8.47.d: परि णो वर्णजन्नघा दुर्गाणि रथ्यो यथा | सयामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मण्यादित्यानामुतावस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: As drivers of the car avoid ill roads, let sorrows pass us by.  May we be under Indra's guard, in the Ādityas’ favouring grace.

8.47.d: परिह्व्र्तेदना जनो युष्मादत्तस्य वायति | देवा अदभ्रमाश वो यमादित्या अहेतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: For verily men sink and faint through loss of wealth which ye have given.  Much hath he gained from you, O Gods, whom ye, Ādityas, have approached.

8.47.d: न तं तिग्मं चन तयजो न दरासदभि तं गुरु | यस्मा उ शर्म सप्रथ आदित्यासो अराध्वमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: On him shall no fierce anger fall, no sore distress shall visit him,  To whom, Ādityas, ye have lent your shelter that extendeth far.

8.47.d: युष्मे देवा अपि षमसि युध्यन्त इव वर्मसु | यूयं महो न एनसो यूयमर्भादुरुष्यतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Resting in you, O Gods, we are like men who fight in coats of mail.  Ye guard us from each great offence, ye guard us from each lighter fault.

8.47.d: अदितिर्न उरुष्यत्वदितिः शर्म यछतु | माता मित्रस्य रेवतो.अर्यम्णो वरुणस्य चानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: May Aditi defend us, may Aditi guard and shelter us,  Mother of wealthy Mitra and of Aryaman and Varuṇa.

8.47.d: यद देवाः शर्म शरणं यद भद्रं यदनातुरम | तरिधातु यद वरूथ्यं तदस्मासु वि यन्तनानेहसो व उतयःसुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: The shelter, Gods, that is secure, auspicious, free from malady,  A sure protection, triply strong, even that do ye extend to us.

8.47.d: आदित्या अव हि खयताधि कूलादिव सपशः | सुतीर्थमर्वतो यथानु नो नेषथा सुगमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Look down on us, Ādityas, as a guide exploring from the bank.  Lead us to pleasant ways as men lead horses to an easy ford.

8.47.d: नेह भद्रं रक्षस्विने नावयै नोपया उत | गवे च भद्रं धेनवे वीराय च शरवस्यते.अनेहसो न ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Ill be it for the demons' friend to find us or come near to us.  But for the milch-cow be it well, and for the man who strives for fame.

8.47.d: यदाविर्यदपीच्यं देवासो अस्ति दुष्क्र्तम | तरिते तद विश्वमाप्त्य आरे अस्मद दधातनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयोव ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Each evil deed made manifest, and that which is concealed, O Gods,  The whole thereof remove from us to Trita Āptya far away.

8.47.d: यच्च गोषु दुष्वप्न्यं यच्चास्मे दुहितर्दिवः | तरिताय तद विभावर्याप्त्याय परा वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Daughter of Heaven, the dream that bodes evil to us or to our kine,  Remove, O Lady of the Light, to Trita Āptya far away.

8.47.d: निष्कं वा घा कर्णवते सरजं वा दुहितर्दिवः | तरिते दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये परि दद्मस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Even if, O Child of Heaven, it make a garland or a chain of gold,  The whole bad dream, whate’er it be, to Trita Āptya we consign.

8.47.d: तदन्नाय तदपसे तं भागमुपसेदुषे | तरिताय च दविताय चोषो दुष्वप्न्यं वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: To him whose food and work is this, who comes to take his share therein,  To Trita, and to Dvita, Dawn! bear thou the evil dream away.

8.47.d: यथा कलां यथा शफं यथ रणं संनयामसि | एवा दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये सं नयामस्यनेहसो व ऊतयःसुूतयो व ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: As we collect the utmost debt, even the eighth and sixteenth part,  So unto Āptya we transfer together all the evil dream.

8.47.d: अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम | उषो यस्माद दुष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुछत्वनेहसो व ऊतयः सुूतयोव ऊतयः ||
8.47.e: Now have we conquered and obtained, and from our trespasses are free.  Shine thou away the evil dream, O Dawn, whereof we are afraid. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

8.48.d: सवादोरभक्षि वयसः सुमेधाः सवाध्यो वरिवोवित्तरस्य | विश्वे यं देवा उत मर्त्यासो मधु बरुवन्तो अभि संचरन्ति ||
8.48.e: WISELY have I enjoyed the savoury viand, religious-thoughted, best to find out treasure,  The food to which all Deities and mortals, calling it meath, gather themselves together.

8.48.d: अन्तश्च परागा अदितिर्भवास्यवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य | इन्दविन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणः शरौष्टीव धुरमनु राय रध्याः ||
8.48.e: Tlou shalt be Aditi as thou hast entered within, appeaser of celestial anger.  Indu, enjoying Indra's friendship, bring us—as a swift steed the car—forward to riches.

8.48.d: अपाम सोममम्र्ता अभूमागन्म जयोतिरविदाम देवान | किं नूनमस्मान कर्णवदरातिः किमु धूर्तिरम्र्त मर्त्यस्य ||
8.48.e: We have drunk Soma and become immortal; we have attained the light, the Gods discovered.  Now what may foeman's malice do to harm us? What, O Immortal, mortal man's deception?

8.48.d: शं नो भव हर्द आ पीत इन्दो पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः | सखेव सख्य उरुशंस धीरः पर ण आयुर्जीवसे सोमतारीः ||
8.48.e: Absorbed into the heart, be sweet, O Indu, as a kind father to his son, O Soma,  As a wise Friend to friend: do thou, wide-ruler, O Soma, lengthen out our days for living.

8.48.d: इमे मा पीता यशस उरुष्यवो रथं न गावः समनाहपर्वसु | ते मा रक्षन्तु विस्रसश्चरित्रादुत मा सरामाद्यवयन्त्विन्दवः ||
8.48.e: These glorious drops that give me freedom have I drunk. Closely they knit my joints as straps secure a car.  Let them protect my foot from slipping on the way: yea, let the drops I drink preserve me from disease.

8.48.d: अग्निं न मा मथितं सं दिदीपः पर चक्षय कर्णुहि वस्यसो नः | अथा हि ते मद आ सोम मन्ये रेवानिव पर चरापुष्टिमछ ||
8.48.e: Make me shine bright like fire produced by friction: give us a clearer sight and make us better.  For in carouse I think of thee, O Soma, Shall I, as a rich man, attain to comfort?

8.48.d: इषिरेण ते मनसा सुतस्य भक्षीमहि पित्र्यस्येव रायः | सोम राजन पर ण आयूंषि तारीरहानीव सूर्यो वासराणि ||
8.48.e: May we enjoy with an enlivened spirit the juice thou givest, like ancestral riches.  O Soma, King, prolong thou our existence as Sūrya makes the shining days grow longer.

8.48.d: सोम राजन मर्ळया नः सवस्ति तव समसि वरत्यास्तस्य विद्धि | अलर्ति दक्ष उत मन्युरिन्दो मा नो अर्यो अनुकामं परादाः ||
8.48.e: King Soma, favour us and make us prosper: we are thy devotees; of this be mindful.  Spirit and power are fresh in us, O Indu give us not up unto our foeman's pleasure.

8.48.d: तवं हि नस्तन्वः सोम गोपा गात्रे-गात्रे निषसत्था नर्चक्षाः | यत ते वयं परमिनाम वरतानि स नो मर्ळ सुषखादेव वस्यः ||
8.48.e: For thou hast settled in each joint, O Soma, aim of men's eyes and guardian of our bodies.  When we offend against thine holy statutes, as a kind Friend, God, best of all, be gracious.

8.48.d: रदूदरेण साख्या सचेय यो मा न रिष्येद धर्यश्व पीतः | अयं यः सोमो नयधाय्यस्मे तस्मा इन्द्रं परतिरमेम्यायुः ||
8.48.e: May I be with the Friend whose heart is tender, who, Lord of Bays! when quaffed will never harm me-  This Soma now deposited within me. For this, I pray for longer life to Indra.

8.48.d: अप तया अस्थुरनिरा अमीवा निरत्रसन तमिषीचीरभैषुः | आ सोमो अस्मानरुहद विहाया अगन्म यत्र परतिरन्त आयुः ||
8.48.e: Our maladies have lost their strength and vanished: they feared, and passed away into the darkness.  Soma hath risen in us, exceeding mighty, and we are come where men prolong existence.  12, Fathers, that Indu which our hearts have drunken, Immortal in himself, hath entered mortals.  So let us serve this Soma with oblation, and rest securely in his grace and favour.

8.48.d: यो न इन्दुः पितरो हर्त्सु पीतो.अमर्त्यो मर्त्यानाविवेश | तस्मै सोमाय हविषा विधेम मर्ळीके अस्य सुमतौ सयाम ||
8.48.e: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven.  So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches,

8.48.d: तवं सोम पित्र्भिः संविदानो.अनु दयावाप्र्थिवी आ ततन्थ | तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम वयं सयाम पतयो रयीणाम ||
8.48.e: Give us your blessing, O ye Gods’ preservers. Never may sleep or idle talk control us.  But evermore may we, as friends of Soma, speak to the synod with brave sons around us.

8.48.d: तरातारो देवा अधि वोचता नो मा नो निद्रा ईशत मोत जल्पिः | वयं सोमस्य विश्वह परियासः सुवीरासो विदथमावदेम ||
8.48.e: On all sides,. Soma, thou art our life-giver: aim of all eyes, light-finder, come within us.  Indu, of one accord with thy protections both from behind and from before preserve us.

8.48.d: तवं नः सोम विश्वतो वयोधास्त्वं सवर्विदा विशा नर्चक्षाः | तवं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सजोषाः पाहि पश्चातादुत वा पुरस्तात ||

8.49.d: अभि पर वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे | यो जरित्रिभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ||
8.49.e: AGNI, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as Invoking Priest.  Let the extended ladle full of oil balm thee, best Priest, to sit on sacred grass.

8.49.d: शतानीकेव पर जिगाति धर्ष्णुया हन्ति वर्त्राणि दाशुषे | गिरेरिव पर रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः ||
8.49.e: For unto thee, O Aṅgiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice.  To Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, we seek, foremost in sacrificial rites.

8.49.d: आ तवा सुतास इन्दवो मदा य इन्द्र गिर्वणः | आपो न वज्रिन्नन्वोक्यं सरः पर्णन्ति शूर राधसे ||
8.49.e: Agni, thou art Disposer, Sage, Herald, bright God! and worshipful,  Best offerer, cheerful, to be praised in holy rites, pure Lord! by singers with their hymns.

8.49.d: अनेहसं परतरणं विवक्षणं मध्वः सवादिष्ठमीं पिब | आ यथा मन्दसानः किरासि नः पर कषुद्रेव तमना धर्षत ||
8.49.e: Most Youthful and Eternal, bring the longing Gods to me, the guileless, for the feast.  Come, Vasu, to the banquet that is well-prepared: rejoice thee, gracious, with our songs.

8.49.d: आ न सतोममुप दरवद धियानो अश्वो न सोत्र्भिः | यं तेस्वधावन सवदयन्ति धेनव इन्द्र कण्वेषु रातयः ||
8.49.e: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, Preserver, righteous, and a Sage.  The holy singers, O refulgent kindled God! arrangers, call on thee to come.

8.49.d: उग्रं न वीरं नमसोप सेदिम विभूतिमक्षितावसुम | उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो न सिञ्चते कषरन्तीन्द्र धीतयः ||
8.49.e: Shine, Most Resplendent! blaze, send bliss unto the folk, and to thy worshipper  Great art thou.  So may my princes, with good fires, subduing foes, rest in the keeping of the Gods.

8.49.d: यद ध नूनं यद वा यज्ञे यद वा पर्थिव्यामधि | अतो नो यज्ञमाशुभिर्महेमत उग्र उग्रेभिरा गहि ||
8.49.e: O Agni, as thou burnest down to earth even high-grown underwood,  So, bright as Mitra is, burn him who injures us, him who plots ill against thy friend.

8.49.d: अजिरासो हरयो ये त आशवो वाता इव परसक्षिणः | येभिरपत्यं मनुषः परीयसे येभिर्विश्वं सवर्द्र्शे ||
8.49.e: Give us not as a prey to mortal enemy, nor to the wicked friend of fiends.  With conquering guards, auspicious, unassailable, protect us, O Most Youthful God.

8.49.d: एतावतस्त ईमह इन्द्र सुम्नस्य गोमतः | यथा परावो मघवन मेध्यातिथिं यथा नीपातिथिं धने ||
8.49.e: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn,  Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might, through four hymns, Vasu, guard thou us.

8.49.d: यथा कण्वे मघवन तरसदस्यवि यथा पक्थे दशव्रजे | यथा गोशर्ये असनोरजिश्वनीन्द्र गोमद धिरण्यवत ||
8.49.e: Preserve us from each fiend who brings the Gods no gift, preserve thou us in deeds of strength:  For we possess in thee the nearest Friend of all, for service of the Gods and weal.

8.50.d: पर सु शरुतं सुराधसमर्चा शक्रमभिष्टये | यः सुन्वते सतुवते काम्यं वसु सहस्रेणेव मंहते ||
8.50.e: BOTH boons,—may Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours,  And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice.

8.50.d: शतानीका हेतयो अस्य दुष्टरा इन्द्रस्य समिषो महीः | गिरिर्न भुज्मा मघवत्सु पिन्वते यदीं सुता अमन्दिषुः ||
8.50.e: For him, strong, independent Ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth for power and might.  Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.

8.50.d: यदीं सुतास इन्दवो.अभि परियममन्दिषुः | आपो न धायि सवनं म आ वसो दुघा इवोप दाशुषे ||
8.50.e: Fill thyself full, O Lord of wealth, O Indra, with the juice we shed.  We know thee, Lord of Bay Steeds victor in the fight, vanquishing e’en the invincible.

8.50.d: अनेहसं वो हवमानमूतये मध्वः कषरन्ति धीतयः | आ तवा वसो हवमानास इन्दव उप सतोत्रेषु दधिरे ||
8.50.e: Changeless in truth, O Maghavan Indra, let it be as thou in wisdom willest it.  May we, O fair of check, win booty with thine aid, O Thunderer, swiftly seeking it.

8.50.d: आ नः सोमे सवध्वर इयानो अत्यो न तोशते | यं ते सवदावन सवदन्ति गूर्तयः पौरे छन्दयसे हवम ||
8.50.e: Indra, with all thy saving helps give us assistance, Lord of power.  For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, Hero, finder-out of wealth.

8.50.d: पर वीरमुग्रं विविचिं धनस्प्र्तं विभूतिं राधसो महः | उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो वसुत्वना सदा पीपेथ दाशुषे ||
8.50.e: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, O God, art thou,  For no one may impair the gifts laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask.

8.50.d: यद ध नूनं परावति यद वा पर्थिव्यां दिवि | युजान इन्द्र हरिभिर्महेमत रष्व रष्वेभिरा गहि ||
8.50.e: For thou,—come to the worshipper!—wilt find great wealth to make us rich.  Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds.

8.50.d: रथिरासो हरयो ये ते अस्रिध ओजो वातस्य पिप्रति | येभिर्नि दस्युं मनुषो निघोषयो येभिः सवः परीयसे ||
8.50.e: Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thousands dost thou give.  With singers' hymns have we brought the Fort-render near, singing to Indra for his grace.

8.50.d: एतावतस्ते वसो विद्याम शूर नव्यसः | यथा पराव एतशं कर्त्व्ये धने यथा वशं दशव्रजे ||
8.50.e: Whether the simple or the sage, Indra, have offered praise to thee,  He Śatakratu! by his love hath gladdened thee, ambitious! ever pressing on!

8.50.d: यथा कण्वे मघवन मेधे अध्वरे दीर्घनीथे दमूनसि | यथा गोशर्ये असिषासो अद्रिवो मयि गोत्रं हरिश्रियम ||
8.50.e: If he the Strong of arm, the breaker-down of forts, the great Destroyer, hear my call,  We, seeking riches cry to Indra, Lord of wealth, to Śatakratu with our lauds.

8.51.d: यथा मनौ सांवरणौ सोममिन्द्रापिबः सुतम | नीपातिथौ मघवन मेध्यातिथौ पुष्टिगौ शरुष्टिगौ सचा ||
8.51.e: OFFER ye up as praise to him that wherein Indra takes delight.  The Soma-bringers magnify Indra's great energy with hymns. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.

8.51.d: पार्षद्वाणः परस्कण्वं समसादयच्छयानं जिव्रिमुद्धितम | सहस्राण्यसिषासद गवां रषिस्त्वोतो दस्यवे वर्कः ||
8.51.e: Sole among chiefs, companionless, impetuous, and peerless, he  Hath waxen great o’er many folk, yea., over all things born, in might.

8.51.d: य उक्थेभिर्न विन्धते चिकिद य रषिचोदनः | इन्द्रं तमछा वद नव्यस्या मत्यरिष्यन्तं न भोजसे ||
8.51.e: Lord of swift bounty, he will win e’en with a steed of worthless sort.  This, Indra, must be told of thee who wilt perform heroic deeds.

8.51.d: यस्मा अर्कं सप्तशीर्षाणमान्र्चुस्त्रिधातुमुत्तमे पदे | स तविमा विश्वा भुवनानि चिक्रददादिज्जनिष्ट पौंस्यम ||
8.51.e: Come to us hither: let us pay devotions that enhance thy might,  For which, Most Potent! thou wouldst fain bless the man here who strives for fame.

8.51.d: यो नो दाता वसूनामिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयम | विद्मा हयस्य सुमतिं नवीयसीं गमेम गोमति वरजे ||
8.51.e: For thou, O Indra, makest yet more bold the spirit of the bold  Who with strong Soma serveth thee, still ready with his reverent prayers.

8.51.d: यस्मै तवं वसो दानाय शिक्षसि स रायस पोषमश्नुते | तं तवा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ||
8.51.e: Worthy of song, he looketh down as a man looketh into wells.  Pleased with the Soma-bringer's skill he maketh him his mate and friend.

8.51.d: कदा चन सतरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे | उपोपेन नु मघवन भूय इन नु ते दानं देवस्य पर्च्यते ||
8.51.e: In strength and wisdom all the Gods, Indra, have yielded unto thee.  Be thou the Guard of all, O thou whom many praise.

8.51.d: पर यो ननक्षे अभ्योजसा करिविं वधैः शुष्णं निघोषयन | यदेदस्तम्भीत परथयन्नमूं दिवमादिज्जनिष्ट पार्थिवः ||
8.51.e: Praised, Indra, is this might of thine, best for the service of the Gods,  That thou with power dost slay Vṛtra, O Lord of Strength.

8.51.d: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः | तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे परीरवि तुभ्येत सो अज्यते रयिः ||
8.51.e: He makes the races of mankind like synods of the Beauteous One.  Indra knows this his manifest deed, and is renowned.

8.51.d: तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घर्तश्चुतं विप्रासो अर्कमान्र्चुः | अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वर्ष्ण्यं शवो.अस्मे सुवानास इन्दवः ||
8.51.e: Thy might, O Indra, at its birth, thee also, and thy mental power,  In thy care, Maghavan rich in kine! they have increased exceedingly.

8.52.d: यथा मनौ विवस्वति सोमं शक्रापिबः सुतम | यथा तरिते छन्द इन्द्र जुजोषस्यायौ मादयसे सचा ||
8.52.e: WITH powers of Mighty Ones hath he, Ancient, Beloved, been equipped,  Through whom the Father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.

8.52.d: पर्षध्रे मेध्ये मातरिश्वनीन्द्र सुवाने अमन्दथाः | यथा सोमं दशशिप्रे दशोण्ये सयूमरश्माव रजूनसि ||
8.52.e: Him, Maker of the sky, let stones wet with the Soma ne’er forsake,  Nor hymns and prayer that must be said.

8.52.d: य उक्था केवला दधे यः सोमं धर्षितापिबत | यस्मै विष्णुस्त्रीणि पदा विचक्रम उप मित्रस्य धर्मभिः ||
8.52.e: Indra who knew full well disclosed the kine to the Aṅgirases.  This his great deed must be extolled.

8.52.d: यस्य तवमिन्द्र सतोमेषु चाकनो वाजे वाजिञ्छतक्रतो | तं तवा वयं सुदुघामिव गोदुहो जुहूमसि शरवस्यवः ||
8.52.e: Indra, promoter of the song, the sage's Strengthener as of old,  Shall come to bless and succour us at presentation of this laud.

8.52.d: यो नो दाता स नः पिता महानुग्र ईशानक्र्त | अयामन्नुग्रो मघवा पुरूवसुर्गोरश्वस्य पर दातु नः ||
8.52.e: Now after their desire's intent the pious singers with the cry  Of Hail! have sung loud hymns to thee, Indra, to gain a stall of kine.

8.52.d: यस्मै तवं वसो दानाय मंहसे स रायस पोषमिन्वति | वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं सतोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे ||
8.52.e: With Indra rest all deeds of might, deeds done and yet to be performed,  Whom singers know devoid of guile.

8.52.d: कदा चन पर युछस्युभे नि पासि जन्मनी | तुरीयादित्य हवनं त इन्द्रियमा तस्थावम्र्तं दिवि ||
8.52.e: When the Five Tribes with all their men to Indra have sent out their voice,  And when the priest hath strewn much grass, this is the Friend's own dwelling-place.

8.52.d: यस्मै तवं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः शिक्षो शिक्षसि दाशुषे | अस्माकं गिर उत सुष्टुतिं वसो कण्ववच्छ्र्णुधी हवम ||
8.52.e: This praise is verily thine own: thou hast performed these manly deeds,  And sped the wheel upon its way.

8.52.d: अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं बरह्मेन्द्राय वोचत | पूर्वीरतस्य बर्हतीरनूषत सतोतुर्मेधा अस्र्क्षत ||
8.52.e: At the o’erflowing of this Steer, boldly he strode for life, and took  Soma as cattle take their corn.

8.52.d: समिन्द्रो रायो बर्हतीरधूनुत सं कषोणी समु सूर्यम | सं शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः ||
8.52.e: Receiving this and craving help, we, who with you are Dakṣa's sons,  Would fain exalt the Maruts’ Lord.

8.53.d: उपमं तवा मघोनां जयेष्ठं च वर्षभाणाम | पूर्भित्तमं मघवन्निन्द्र गोविदमीशानं राय ईमहे ||
8.53.e: MAY our hymns give thee great delight. Display thy bounty, Thunderer.  Drive off the enemies of prayer.

8.53.d: य आयुं कुत्समतिथिग्वमर्दयो वाव्र्धानो दिवे-दिवे | तं तवा वयं हर्यश्वं शतक्रतुं वाजयन्तो हवामहे ||
8.53.e: Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts. Mighty art thou  There is not one to equal thee.

8.53.d: आ नो विश्वेषां रसं मध्वः सिञ्चन्त्वद्रयः | ये परावति सुन्विरे जनेष्वा ये अर्वावतीन्दवः ||
8.53.e: Thou art the Lord of Soma pressed, Soma impressed is also thine.  Thou art the Sovran of the folk.

8.53.d: विश्वा दवेषांसि जहि चाव चा कर्धि विश्वे सन्वन्त्वा वसु | शीष्टेषु चित ते मदिरासो अंशवो यत्रा सोमस्य तर्म्पसि ||
8.53.e: Come, go thou forth, dwelling in heaven and listening to the prayers of men:  Thou fillest both the heavens and earth.

8.53.d: इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः | आ शन्तम शन्तमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा सवापे सवापिभिः ||
8.53.e: Even that hill with rocky heights, with hundreds, thousands, held within.  Thou for thy worshippers brakest through.

8.53.d: आजितुरं सत्पतिं विश्वचर्षणिं कर्धि परजास्वाभगम | पर सू तिरा शचीभिर्ये त उक्थिनः करतुं पुनत आनुषक ||
8.53.e: We call on thee both night and day to taste the flowing Soma juice:  Do thou fulfil our heart's desire.

8.53.d: यस्ते साधिष्ठो.अवसे ते सयाम भरेषु ते | वयं होत्राभिरुत देवहूतिभिः ससवांसो मनामहे ||
8.53.e: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong. necked and never yet bent down?  What Brahman ministers to him?

8.53.d: अहं हि ते हरिवो बरह्म वाजयुराजिं यामि सदोतिभिः | तवामिदेव तममे समश्वयुर्गव्युरग्रे मथीनाम ||
8.53.e: To whose libation doth the Steer, betake him with delight therein?  Who takes delight in Indra now?

8.54.d: एतत त इन्द्र वीर्यं गीर्भिर्ग्र्णन्ति कारवः | ते सतोभन्त ऊर्जमावन घर्तश्चुतं पौरासो नक्षन धीतिभिः ||
8.54.e: THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men from east and west, from north and south,  Come hither quickly with fleet steeds

8.54.d: नक्षन्त इन्द्रमवसे सुक्र्त्यया येषां सुतेषु मन्दसे | यथा संवर्ते अमदो यथा कर्श एवास्मे इन्द्र मत्स्व ||
8.54.e: If in the effluence of heaven, rich in its light, thou takest joy,  Or in the sea in Soma juice.

8.54.d: आ नो विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो गन्तनोप नः | वसवो रुद्रावसे न आ गमञ्छ्र्ण्वन्तु मरुतो हवम ||
8.54.e: With songs I call thee, Great and Wide, even as a cow to profit us,  Indra, to drink the Soma-draught.

8.54.d: पूषा विष्णुर्हवनं मे सरस्वत्यवन्तु सप्त सिन्धवः | आपो वातः पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः शर्णोतु पर्थिवी हवम ||
8.54.e: Hither, O Indra, let thy Bays bear up and, bring upon thy car  Thy glory, God! and majesty.

8.54.d: यदिन्द्र राधो अस्ति ते माघोनं मघवत्तम | तेन नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वर्धे भगो दानाय वर्त्रहन ||
8.54.e: Thou, Indra, wouldst be sung and praised as great, strong, lordly in thy deeds  Come hither, drink our Soma juice.

8.54.d: आजिपते नर्पते तवमिद धि नो वाज आ वक्षि सुक्रतो | वीतीहोत्राभिरुत देववीतिभिः ससवांसो वि शर्ण्विरे ||
8.54.e: We who have shed the Soma and prepared the feast are calling thee.  To sit on this our sacred grass.

8.54.d: सन्ति हयर्य आशिष इन्द्र आयुर्जनानाम | अस्मान नक्षस्वमघवन्नुपावसे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम ||
8.54.e: As, Indra, thou art evermore the common Lord of all alike,  As such we invocate thee now.

8.54.d: वयं त इन्द्र सतोमेभिर्विधेम तवमस्माकं शतक्रतो | महि सथूरं शशयं राधो अह्रयं परस्कण्वाय नि तोशय ||
8.54.e: The men with stones have milked for thee this nectar of the Soma juice:  Indra, be pleased with it, and drink.

8.55.d: भूरीदिन्द्रस्य वीर्यं वयख्यमभ्यायति | राधस्ते दस्यवे वर्क ||
8.55.e: LOUD singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke  With haste, that he may help, as the bard's Cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you.

8.55.d: शतं शवेतास उक्षणो दिवि तारो न रोचन्ते | मह्ना दिवं न तस्तभुः ||
8.55.e: Whom with fair helm, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not:  Giver of glorious wealth to him who sing a his praise, honouring him who toils and pours:

8.55.d: शतं वेणूञ्छतं शुनः शतं चर्माणि मलातानि | शतं मे बल्बजस्तुका अरुषीणां चतुःशतम ||
8.55.e: Śakra, who like a curry-comb for horses or a golden goad,  Indra, the Vṛtra-slayer, urges eagerly the opening of the stall of kine:

8.55.d: सुदेवाः सथ काण्वायना वयो-वयो विचरन्तः | अश्वासो नचङकरमत ||
8.55.e: Who for the worshipper scatters forth ample wealth, even though buried, piled in heaps:  May Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed Thunderer, act at his pleasure, as he lists.

8.55.d: आदित साप्तस्य चर्किरन्नानूनस्य महि शरवः | शयावीरतिध्वसन पथश्चक्षुषा चन संनशे ||
8.55.e: Hero whom many praise, what thou hast longed for, oven of old, from men.  All that we offer unto thee, O Indra, now, sacrifice, laud, effectual speech.

8.56.d: परति ते दस्यवे वर्क राधो अदर्श्यह्रयम | दयौर्न परथिना शवः ||
8.56.e: Now pray we to these Ksatriyas, to the Ādityas for their aid,  These who are gracious to assist.

8.56.d: दश मह्यं पौतक्रतः सहस्रा दस्यवे वर्कः | नित्याद रायो अमंहत ||
8.56.e: May Mitra bear us o’er distress, and Varuṇa and Aryaman,  Yea, the Ādityas, as they know.

8.56.d: शतं मे गर्दभानां शतमूर्णावतीनाम | शतं दासानति सरजः ||
8.56.e: For wonderful and meet for praise is these Ādityas’ saving help  To him who offers and prepares.

8.56.d: तत्रो अपि पराणीयत पूतक्रतायै वयक्ता | अश्वानामिन न यूथ्याम ||
8.56.e: The mighty aid of you, the Great, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman,  We claim to be our sure defence.

8.56.d: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितुर्हव्यवाट स सुमद्रथः | अग्निः शुक्रेण शोचिषा बर्हत सूरो अरोचत दिवि सूर्यो अरोचत ||
8.56.e: Guard us, Ādityas, still alive, before the deadly weapon strike:  Are yc not they who hear our call?

8.57.d: युवं देवा करतुना पूर्व्येण युक्ता रथेन तविषं यजत्रा | आगछतं नासत्या शचीभिरिदं तर्तीयं सवनं पिबाथः ||
8.57.e: EVEN as a car to give us aid, we draw thee hither for our bliss,  Strong in thy deeds, checking assault, Lord, Mightiest Indra, of the brave!

8.57.d: युवां देवास्त्रय एकादशासः सत्याः सत्यस्य दद्र्शे पुरस्तात | अस्माकं यज्ञं सवनं जुषाणा पातं सोममश्विना दीद्यग्नी ||
8.57.e: Great in thy power and wisdom, Strong, with thought that comprehendeth all  Thou hast filled full with majesty.

8.57.d: पनाय्यं तदश्विना कर्तं वां वर्षभो दिवो रजसः पर्थिव्याः | सहस्रं शंसा उत ये गविष्टौ सर्वानित तानुप याता पिबध्यै ||
8.57.e: Thou very Mighty One, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness grasp,  The golden bolt that breaks its way.

8.57.d: अयं वां भागो निहितो यजत्रेमा गिरो नासत्योप यातम | पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमस्मे पर दाश्वांसमवतं शचीभिः ||
8.57.e: Your Lord of might that ne’er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind,  I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.

8.58.d: यं रत्विजो बहुधा कल्पयन्तः सचेतसो यज्ञमिमं वहन्ति | यो अनूचानो बराह्मणो युक्त आसीत का सवित तत्र यजमानस्य संवित ||
8.58.e: I SEND you forth the song of praise for Indu, hero-gladdener.  With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.

8.58.d: एक एवाग्निर्बहुधा समिद्ध एकः सूर्यो विश्वमनु परभूतः | एकैवोषाः सर्वमिदं वि भात्येकं वा इदंवि बभूव सर्वम ||
8.58.e: Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, for those who long for his approach,  For those who turn away from him, lord of thy cows whom none may kill.

8.58.d: जयोतिष्मन्तं केतुमन्तं तरिचक्रं सुखं रथं सुषदं भूरिवारम | चित्रामघा यस्य योगे.अधिजज्ञे तं वां हुवेति रिक्तं पिबध्यै ||
8.58.e: The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of Soma juice:  Clans in the birth-place of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.

8.59.d: इमानि वां भागधेयानि सिस्रत इन्द्रावरुणा पर महे सुतेषु वाम | यज्ञे-यज्ञे ह सवना भुरण्यथो यत सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षथः ||
8.59.e: HE who, as Sovran Lord of men, moves with his chariots unrestrained,  The Vṛtra-slayer vanquisher, of fighting hosts, preeminent, is praised with song.

8.59.d: निष्षिध्वरीरोषधीराप आस्तामिन्द्रावरुणा महिमानमाशत | या सिस्रतू रजसः पारे अध्वनो ययोः शत्रुर्नकिरादेव ओहते ||
8.59.e: Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, in whose sustaining hand of old,  The splendid bolt of thunder was deposited, as the great Sun was set in heaven.

8.59.d: सत्यं तदिन्द्रावरुणा कर्शस्य वां मध्व ऊर्मिं दुहते सप्त वाणीः | ताभिर्दाश्वांसमवतं शुभस पती यो वामदब्धो अभि पाति चित्तिभिः ||
8.59.e: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore:  No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised o all, resistless, daring, bold in might.

8.59.d: घर्तप्रुषः सौम्या जीरदानवः सप्त सवसारः सदन रतस्य | या ह वामिन्द्रावरुणा घर्तश्चुतस्ताभिर्धत्तं यजमानाय शिक्षतम ||
8.59.e: The potent Conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the Mighty Ones,  The Kine who spread  afar  , sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths seat their loud voices out,

8.59.d: अवोचाम महते सौभगाय सत्यं तवेषाभ्यां महिमानमिन्द्रियम | अस्मान सविन्द्रावरुणा घर्तश्चुतस्त्रिभिः साप्तेभिरवतं शुभस पती ||
8.59.e: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine—  No, not a thousand Suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.

8.59.d: इन्द्रावरुणा यद रषिभ्यो मनीषां वाचो मतिं शरुतमदत्तमग्रे | यानि सथानान्यस्र्जन्त धीरा यज्ञं तन्वानास्तपसाभ्यपश्यम ||
8.59.e: Thou, Hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O Strongest One.  Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids.

8.59.d: इन्द्रावरुणा सौमनसमद्र्प्तं रायस पोषं यजमानेषु धत्तम | परजां पुष्टिं भूतिमस्मासु धत्तं दीर्घायुत्वाय पर तिरतं न आयुः ||
8.59.e: Let not a godless mortal gain this food, O thou whose life is long!  But one who yokes the bright-hued steeds, the Etasas, even Indra yoker of the Bays.

8.60.d: अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं तवा वर्णीमहे | आ तवामनक्तु परयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे ||
8.60.e: O AGNI, come here with the fires, we choose you as our invoking priest; let the presented offering anoint

8.60.d: अछा हि तवा सहसः सूनो अङगिरः सरुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे | ऊर्जो नपातं घर्तकेशमीमहे.अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम ||
8.60.e: Aṅgirasa, son of strength, the ladles go to find you in the sacrifice; we praise the ancient Agni in ourofferings, the grandson of food, butter-haired.

8.60.d: अग्ने कविर्वेधा असि होता पावक यक्ष्यः | मन्द्रो यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यो विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मबिः ||
8.60.e: Agni, you, wise, are the creator (of consequences); O purifier, you are the involving priest, worthy ofworship; bright one, you are to be praised in our sacrifices by the priests with hymns, yourself the chief ministrantworthy to be rejoiced in.

8.60.d: अद्रोघमा वहोशतो यविष्ठ्य देवानजस्र वीतये | अभि परयांसि सुधिता वसो गहि मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः ||
8.60.e: Most youthful, eternal one, bring the longing gods to me guileless, to eat (the oblation); giver ofdwellings, approach the well-plural ced food; rejoice, being set in your plural ce with praises

8.60.d: तवमित सप्रथा अस्यग्ने तरातरतस कविः | तवां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः ||
8.60.e: Deliverer Agni, you, the truthful and the seer, are widely spread; O kindled blazing one, the wisepraisers wait on you.

8.60.d: शोचा शोचिष्ठ दीदिहि विशे मयो रास्व सतोत्रे महानसि | देवानां शर्मन मम सन्तु सूरयः शत्रूषाहः सवग्नयः ||
8.60.e: Most resplendent (Agni), shine forth and illuminate (us); give happiness to your people, to yourworshipper, for you are great; may my priests abide in the bliss of the gods, subduing their enemies, possessingbright fires.

8.60.d: यथा चिद वर्द्धमतसमग्ने संजूर्वसि कषमि | एवा दहमित्रमहो यो अस्मध्रुग दुर्मन्मा कश्च वेनति ||
8.60.e: As, Agni, you consume old timber on the earth, so, cherisher of friends, do you burn our injurer,whosoever evil-minded wishes (our ill)

8.60.d: मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे रक्षस्विने माघशंसाय रीरधः | अस्रेधद्भिस्तरणिभिर्यविष्ठ्य शिवेभिः पाहि पायुभिः ||
8.60.e: Subject us not to a strong mortal enemy, nor to the malevolent; O most youthful, guard us with yourunharming delivering auspicious protections.

8.60.d: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्युत दवितीयया | पाहि गीर्भिस्तिस्र्भिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतस्र्भिर्वसो ||
8.60.e: Agni, protect us by one (rich), or protect us by a second; lord of strength, protect us by three sons;protect us, giver of dwellings, by four.

8.60.d: पाहि विश्वस्माद रक्षसो अराव्णः पर सम वाजेषु नो.अव | तवामिद धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वर्धे ||
8.60.e: Protect us from every impious rākṣasa, shield us in battles; we approach you, our nearest neighbour,our kinsman, for sacrifice and for increase.

8.60.d: आ नो अग्ने वयोव्र्धं रयिं पावक शंस्यम | रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्प्र्हं सुनीती सवयशस्तरम ||
8.60.e: Purifying Agni, bestow upon us food-augmenting excellent wealth; and (bring) us, O meter-out of good,by auspicious guidance, (a treasure) desired by many and bringing its own fame.

8.60.d: येन वंसाम पर्तनासु शर्धतस्तरन्तो अर्य आदिशः | स तवं नो वर्ध परयसा शचीवसो जिन्वा धियो वसुविदः ||
8.60.e: By which we may escape and destroy in battles our impetuous weapon- aiming enemies; O you who bywisdom establish our rites, bless us with food, prosper our wealth-obtaining offerings.

8.60.d: शिशानो वर्षभो यथाग्निः शर्ङगे दविध्वत | तिग्मा अस्य ननवो न परतिध्र्षे सुजम्भः सहसो यहुः ||
8.60.e: Agni tosses his horns, sharpening them as a bull; his sharp jaws are not to be resisted; he is mightytoothed, this son of strength.

8.60.d: नहि ते अग्ने वर्षभ परतिध्र्षे जम्भासो यद वितिष्टसे | सत्वं नो होतः सुहुतं हविष कर्धि वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु ||
8.60.e: Since you spread out on all sides, your teeth, bull Agni, are not to be resisted; O offerer, do you makeour oblation rightly presented; give us many precious (gifts).

8.60.d: शेषे वनेषु मात्रोः सं तवा मर्तास इन्धते | अतन्द्रो हव्या वहसि हविष्क्र्त आदिद देवेषु राजसि ||
8.60.e: You sleep within your mothers in the woods, mortals kindle you; unwearied you bear the offerings of thesacrificer, then you shine among the gods.

8.60.d: सप्त होतारस्तमिदीळते तवाग्ने सुत्यजमह्रयम | भिनत्स्यद्रिं तपसा वि शोचिषा पराग्ने तिष्ठ जनानति ||
8.60.e: The seven priests praise you, Agni, giver of good things and unfailing; you cleave the cloud with yourfierce splendour; go forth, having overcome our enemies.

8.60.d: अग्निम-अग्निं वो अध्रिगुं हुवेम वर्क्तबर्हिषः | अग्निं हितप्रयसः शश्वतीष्वा होतारं चर्षणीनाम ||
8.60.e: Now that we have cut the sacred grass, let us invoke for you Agni, Agni the irresistible; having plural cedthe oblations, let us invoke Agni, abiding in many (plural ces), the offerer of sacrifices for men.

8.60.d: केतेन शर्मन सचते सुषामण्यग्ने तुभ्यं चिकित्वना | इषण्यया नः पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ||
8.60.e: (The sacrificer) worships you by praises, Agni, with the experienced (priests) in the rite celebrated withbeautiful Sāman hymns;bring us of your own accord for our protection food of various kinds which may bealways in our reach.

8.60.d: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तेपानो देव रक्षसः | अप्रोषिवान गर्हपतिर्महानसि दिवस पायुर्दुरोणयुः ||
8.60.e: Divine Agni, worthy of praise, you are the guardian of men, the consumer of the rākṣasas; you aregreat, you the never-absent guardian of the (worshipper's) house, the protector of heaven, ever present in thedwelling.

8.60.d: मा नो रक्ष आ वेशीदाघ्र्णीवसो मा यातुर्यातुमावताम | परोगव्यूत्यनिरामप कषुधमग्ने सेध रक्षस्विनः ||
8.60.e: O you brilliant wealth, let not the rākṣasa enter us, nor the torment of the evil spirits; Agni, drive awayfurther than a gavyūti from us poverty, hunger and the strong demons.

8.61.d: उभयं शर्णवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः | सत्राच्यामघवा सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत ||
8.61.e: PREPARE oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve again  Who knows the ordering thereof,

8.61.d: तं हि सवराजं वर्षभं तमोजसे धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः | उतोपमानां परथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः ||
8.61.e: Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man,  Beside the shoot of active power.

8.61.d: आ वर्षस्व पुरूवसो सुतस्येन्द्रान्धसः | विद्मा हि तवा हरिवः पर्त्सु सासहिमध्र्ष्टं चिद दध्र्ष्वणिम ||
8.61.e: Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man;  With him for  tongue  they seize the food.

8.61.d: अप्रामिसत्य मघवन तथेदसदिन्द्र करत्वा यथा वशः | सनेम वाजं तव शिप्रिन्नवसा मक्षू चिद यन्तो अद्रिवः ||
8.61.e: He hath inflamed the twofold plain: life-giving, he hath climbed the wood,  And with his tongue hath struck the rock.

8.61.d: शग्ध्यू षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | भगंन हि तवा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ||
8.61.e: Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeks  The Mother to declare his praise.

8.61.d: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुक्र्द गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः | नकिर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत तवे यद-यद यामि तदा भर ||
8.61.e: And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his,  And traces of his car, are seen.

8.61.d: तवं हयेहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये | उद वाव्र्षस्व मघवन गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ||
8.61.e: The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work,  On the stream's loud-resounding bank.

8.61.d: तवं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मंहसे | आ पुरन्दरं चक्र्म विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तो.अवसे ||
8.61.e: Entreated by Vivasvān's ten, Indra cast down the water-jar  With threefold hammer from the sky.

8.61.d: अविप्रो वा यदविधद विप्रो वेन्द्र ते वचः | स पर ममन्दत्त्वाया शतक्रतो पराचामन्यो अहंसन ||
8.61.e: Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice:  The priests anoint it with the meath.

8.61.d: उग्रबाहुर्म्रक्षक्र्त्वा पुरन्दरो यदि मे शर्णवद धवम | वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं सतोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे ||
8.61.e: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above,  Exhaustless, with the mouth below.

8.61.d: न पापासो मनामहे नारायासो न जळ्हवः | यदिन नविन्द्रं वर्षणं सचा सुते सखायं कर्णवामहै ||
8.61.e: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank,  At the out-shedding of the fount.

8.61.d: उग्रं युयुज्म पर्तनासु सासहिं रणकातिमदाभ्यम | वेदा भर्मं चित सनिता रथीतमो वाजिनं यमिदू नशत ||
8.61.e: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice.  The handles twain are wrought of gold.

8.61.d: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कर्धि | मघवञ्छग्धितव तन न ऊतिभिर्वि दविषो वि मर्धो जहि ||
8.61.e: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth  Supply the liquid to the Bull.

8.61.d: तवं हि राधस्पते राधसो महः कषयस्यासि विधतः | तं तवा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ||
8.61.e: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cows  They meet together with their kin.

8.61.d: इन्द्र सपळ उत वर्त्रहा परस्पा नो वरेण्यः | स नो रक्षिषच्चरमं स मध्यमं स पश्चात पातु नः पुरः ||
8.61.e: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven,  To Indra, Agni light and prayer.

8.61.d: तवं नः पश्चादधरादुत्तरात पुर इन्द्र नि पाहि विश्वतः | आरे अस्मत कर्णुहि दैव्यं भयमारे हेतीरदेवीः ||
8.61.e: The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven,  Together with the Sun's seven rays.

8.61.d: अद्याद्या शवः-शव इन्द्र तरास्व परे च नः | विश्वा च नोजरितॄन सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः ||
8.61.e: I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuṇa.  That is the sick man's medicine.

8.61.d: परभङगी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिष्लो विर्याय कम | उभा ते बाहू वर्षणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः ||
8.61.e: From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home,  He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.

8.62.d: परो अस्मा उपस्तुतिं भरता यज्जुजोषति | उक्थैरिन्द्रस्य माहिनं वयो वर्धन्ति सोमिनो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: ROUSE ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Aśvins, to your car  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: अयुजो असमो नर्भिरेकः कर्ष्टीरयास्यः | पूर्वीरति पर वाव्र्धे विश्वा जातान्योजसा भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: Come, Aśvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eye  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: अहितेन चिदर्वता जीरदानुः सिषासति | परवाच्यमिन्द्र तत तव वीर्याणि करिष्यतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: Aśvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: आ याहि कर्णवाम त इन्द्र बरह्माणि वर्धना | येभिः शविष्ठ चाकनो भद्रमिह शरवस्यते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown?  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: धर्षतश्चिद धर्षन मनः कर्णोषीन्द्र यत तवम | तीव्रैः सोमैः सपर्यतो नमोभिः परतिभूषतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call,  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: अव चष्ट रचीषमो.अवतानिव मानुषः | जुष्ट्वी दक्षस्य सोमिनः सखायं कर्णुते युजं भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: The Aśvins, first to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: विश्वे त इन्द्र वीर्यं देवा अनु करतुं ददुः | भुवो विश्वस्य गोपतिः पुरुष्टुत भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: For Atri ye, O Aśvins, made a dwelling-place to shield him well,  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: गर्णे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमं देवतातये | यद धंसि वर्त्रमोजसा शचीपते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: समनेव वपुष्यतः कर्णवन मानुषा युगा | विदे तदिन्द्रश्चेतनमध शरुतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: Erst Saptavadhri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: उज्जातमिन्द्र ते शव उत तवामुत तव करतुम | भूरिगो भूरि वाव्र्धुर्मघवन तव शर्मणि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: अहं च तवं च वर्त्रहन सं युज्याव सनिभ्य आ | अरातीवा चिदद्रिवो.अनु नौ शूर मंसते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way?  Let your protecting help be near.

8.62.d: सत्यमिद वा उ तं वयमिन्द्रं सतवाम नान्र्तम | महानसुन्वतो वधो भूरि जयोतींषि सुन्वतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ||
8.62.e: One common brotherhood is yours, Aśvins your kindred is the same:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.63.d: स पूर्व्यो महानां वेनः करतुभिरानजे | यस्य दवारा मनुष पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे ||
8.63.e: EXERTING all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech  Agni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home.

8.63.d: दिवो मानं नोत सदन सोमप्र्ष्ठासो अद्रयः | उक्था बरह्मच शंस्या ||
8.63.e: Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting gifts  Eulogize with their songs of praise

8.63.d: स विद्वानङगिरोभ्य इन्द्रो गा अव्र्णोदप | सतुषे तदस्यपौंस्यम ||
8.63.e: Much-lauded Jātavedas, him who bears oblations up to heaven  Prepared in service of the Gods.

8.63.d: स परत्नथा कविव्र्ध इन्द्रो वाकस्य वक्षणिः | शिवो अर्कस्य होमन्यस्मत्रा गन्त्ववसे ||
8.63.e: To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vṛtra-slayer, are we come,  Him in whose presence Rksa's son, mighty Srutarvan, waxes great;

8.63.d: आदू नु ते अनु करतुं सवाहा वरस्य यज्यवः | शवात्रमर्का अनूषतेन्द्र गोत्रस्य दावने ||
8.63.e: To deathless Jātavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil,  Visible through the gloom of night

8.63.d: इन्द्रे विश्वानि वीर्या कर्तानि कर्त्वानि च | यमर्का अध्वरं विदुः ||
8.63.e: Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts,  With lifted ladles offering them.

8.63.d: यत पाञ्चजन्यया विशेन्द्रे घोषा अस्र्क्षत | अस्त्र्णाद बर्हणा विपो.अर्यो मानस्य स कषयः ||
8.63.e: O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee,  O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne’er deceived.

8.63.d: इयमु ते अनुष्टुतिश्चक्र्षे तानि पौंस्या | परावश्चक्रस्य वर्तनिम ||
8.63.e: Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet:  Grow mightier, eulogized therewith.

8.63.d: अस्य वर्ष्णो वयोदन उरु करमिष्ट जीवसे | यवं न पश्वा ददे ||
8.63.e: Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foe  Add loftier glory to thy fame.

8.63.d: तद दधाना अवस्यवो युष्माभिर्दक्षपितरः | सयाम मरुत्वतो वर्धे ||
8.63.e: Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car.  Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed.

8.63.d: बळ रत्वियाय धाम्न रक्वभिः शूर नोनुमः | जेषामेन्द्र तवया युजा ||
8.63.e: Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Aṅgiras,  Hear this my call, thou Holy One.

8.63.d: अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वर्त्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः | यः शंसते सतुवते धायि पज्र इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अस्मानवन्तु देवाः ||
8.63.e: Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil,  Such be thou in the fight with foes.

8.64.d: उत तवा मन्दन्तु सतोमः कर्णुष्व राधो अद्रिवः | अव बरह्मद्विषो जहि ||
8.64.e: YOKE, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods: As ancient Herald seat thyself.

8.64.d: पदा पणीन्रराधसो नि बाधस्व महानसि | नहि तवा कश्चन परति ||
8.64.e: And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods:  Give all our wishes sure effect.

8.64.d: तवमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र तवमसुतानाम | तवं राजा जनानाम ||
8.64.e: For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid,  Art holy, faithful to the Law.

8.64.d: एहि परेहि कषयो दिव्याघोषञ्चर्षणीनाम | ओभे पर्णासिरोदसी ||
8.64.e: This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousandfold, is head  And chief of riches and a Sage.

8.64.d: तयं चित पर्वतं गिरिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम | वि सतोत्र्भ्यो रुरोजिथ ||
8.64.e: As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh,  Aṅgiras, to the sacrifice.

8.64.d: वयमु तवा दिवा सुते वयं नक्तं हवामहे | अस्माकं काममा पर्ण ||
8.64.e: Now, O Virūpa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn,  Fair praise with voice that ceases not.

8.64.d: कव सय वर्षभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः | बरह्मा कस्तं सपर्यति ||
8.64.e: With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay low  The thief in combat for the kine.

8.64.d: कस्य सवित सवनं वर्षा जुजुष्वानव गछति | इन्द्रं कौ सविदा चके ||
8.64.e: Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away,  Like cows who leave the niggardly.

8.64.d: कं ते दाना असक्षत वर्त्रहन कं सुवीर्या | उक्थे क उ सविदन्तमः ||
8.64.e: Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foe  Smite us, as billows smite a ship.

8.64.d: अयं ते मानुषे जने सोमः पूरुषु सूयते | तस्येहि पर दरवा पिब ||
8.64.e: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength:  With terrors trouble thou the foe.

8.64.d: अयं ते शर्यणावति सुषोमायामधि परियः | आर्जीकीयेमदिन्तमः ||
8.64.e: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth?  Maker of room, make room for us.

8.64.d: तमद्य राधसे महे चारुं मदाय घर्ष्वये | एहीमिन्द्रद्रवा पिब ||
8.64.e: In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load:  Snatch up the wealth and win it all.

8.65.d: यदिन्द्र परागपागुदं नयग वा हूयसे नर्भिः | आ याहि तूयमाशुभिः ||
8.65.e: NOT to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts,  Lord Of magic power who rules with might.

8.65.d: यद वा परस्रवणे दिवो मादयासे सवर्णरे | यद वा समुद्रेन्धसः ||
8.65.e: This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vṛtra's bead  With hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

8.65.d: आ तवा गीर्भिर्महामुरुं हुवे गामिव भोजसे | इन्द्र सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.65.e: Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vṛtra, and  Released the waters of the sea.

8.65.d: आ त इन्द्र महिमानं हरयो देव ते महः | रथे वहन्तु बिभ्रतः ||
8.65.e: This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heaven  That he might drink the Soma juice.

8.65.d: इन्द्र गर्णीष उ सतुषे महानुग्र ईशानक्र्त | एहि नः सुतं पिब ||
8.65.e: Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars,  Indra we invocate with songs.

8.65.d: सुतावन्तस्त्वा वयं परयस्वन्तो हवामहे | इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ||
8.65.e: Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan,  That he may drink the Soma juice.

8.65.d: यच्चिद धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम | तं तवा वयं हवामहे ||
8.65.e: O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Śatakratu, drink  The Soma at this sacrifice.

8.65.d: इदं ते सोम्यं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः | जुषाण इन्द्र तत पिब ||
8.65.e: To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer!  Are offered from the heart with lauds.

8.65.d: विश्वानर्यो विपश्चितो.अति खयस्तूयमा गहि | अस्मे धेहिश्रवो बर्हत ||
8.65.e: Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites,  Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength.

8.65.d: दाता मे पर्षतीनां राजा हिरण्यवीनाम | मा देवा मघवा रिषत ||
8.65.e: Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed  The Soma which the mortar pressed.

8.65.d: सहस्रे पर्षतीनामधि शचन्द्रं बर्हत पर्थु | शुक्रं हिरण्यमा ददे ||
8.65.e: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar,  What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.

8.65.d: नपातो दुर्गहस्य मे सहस्रेण सुराधसः | शरवो देवेष्वक्रत ||
8.65.e: From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts,  Delicate, faithful. to the Law.

8.66.d: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रं सबाध ऊतये | बर्हद गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम ||
8.66.e: Thronging together, (worship) for your protection Indra full of might and the revealer of wealth; (worship him), chanting the Bṛhat-sāman at his sacrifice where the Soma is effused, I invoke him as (men invoke) abeneficent master of a household.

8.66.d: न यं दुध्रा वरन्ते न सथिरा मुरो मदे सुषिप्रमन्धसः | य आद्र्त्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यम ||
8.66.e: He, the handsome-jawed, whom, inthe intoxication of the Soma, the fierce (demons) withstand not, north firm gods, nor mortal (men)-- who confers glorious wealth on him who reverently praises him, offers the Soma and sings hymns.

8.66.d: यः शक्रो मर्क्षो अश्व्यो यो वा कीजो हिरण्ययः | स ऊर्वस्य रेजयत्यपाव्र्तिमिन्द्रो गव्यस्य वर्त्रहा ||
8.66.e: He Śakra, who is the purifier (of his worshippers), and well-skilled in horses, who is wonderful andgolden-bodied-- he, Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, shakes the hiding-plural ce of the numerous herd of kine.

8.66.d: निखातं चिद यः पुरुसम्भ्र्तं वसूदिद वपति दाशुषे | वज्री सुशिप्रो हर्यश्व इत करदिन्द्रः करत्वा यथा वशत ||
8.66.e: He who verily pours forth to the offerer the buried wealth accusative ulated by many, he, Indra, thethunderer, handsome-jawed, borne on bay steeds, does as he plural ases, (when propitiated) with sacrifice.

8.66.d: यद वावन्थ पुरुष्टुत पुरा चिच्छूर नर्णाम | वयं तत्त इन्द्र सं भरामसि यज्ञमुक्थं तुरं वचः ||
8.66.e: Hero, praised of many, what of old time you did desire from your votaries, that, Indra, we hasten to bringto you-- oblation and recited praise.

8.66.d: सचा सोमेषु पुरुहूत वज्रिवो मदाय दयुक्ष सोमपाः | तवमिद धि बरह्मक्र्ते काम्यं वसु देष्ठः सुन्वते भुवः ||
8.66.e: Bearer of the thunderbolt, invoked of many, radiant, drinker of the Soma, be present at our libations foryour exhilaration; for you are an abundant giver of desirable wealth to him who utters your praises and effusesthe Soma.

8.66.d: वयमेनमिदा हयो.अपीपेमेह वज्रिणम | तस्मा उ अद्य समना सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत शरुते ||
8.66.e: Today and yesterday we have here refreshed him, the thunderer; bring to him today our libation effusedfor (success in) battle; let him now hasten here on hearing our praise.

8.66.d: वर्कश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति | सेमं नः सतोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र पर चित्रया धिया ||
8.66.e: The obstructing robber, the destroyer of travelling enemies, is obedient to him in hiw ways; hasten,Indra, (drawn) by our gorgeous rite, welcoming this our hymn.

8.66.d: कदू नवस्याक्र्तमिन्द्रस्यास्ति पौंस्यम | केनो नु कं शरोमतेन न शुश्रुवे जनुषः परि वर्त्रहा ||
8.66.e: What act of might is there, unperformed by Indra? Who has not heard of his famous (heroism)? He, theslayer of Vṛtra, (is renowned) from his birth.

8.66.d: कदू महीरध्र्ष्टा अस्य तविषीः कदु वर्त्रघ्नो अस्त्र्तम | इन्द्रो विश्वान बेकनाटानहर्द्र्श उत करत्वा पणीन्रभि ||
8.66.e: When were his mighty forces ever languid? When was aught undestroyed before the slayer of Vṛtra?Indra by his energy overpowers all the huckstering usurers who see only this world's days.

8.66.d: वयं घा ते अपूर्व्येन्द्र बरह्माणि वर्त्रहन | पुरूतमासःपुरुहूत वज्रिवो भर्तिं न पर भरामसि ||
8.66.e: Indra, slayer of Vṛra, invoked of many, we, your many worshippers, offer new hymns to you, thunderer,as your wages.

8.66.d: पूर्वीश्चिद धि तवे तुविकूर्मिन्नाशसो हवन्त इन्द्रोतयः | तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना वसो गहि शविष्ठ शरुधि मे हवम ||
8.66.e: Indra, doer of many great deeds, (other worshippers) invoke the manifold hopes and protections whichabide in you; but rejecting the enemy's oblations, come to us bestower of dwellings; O mightiest, hear my appeal.

8.66.d: वयं घा ते तवे इद विन्द्र विप्र अपि षमसि | नहि तवदन्यः पुरुहूत कश्चन मघवन्नस्ति मर्डिता ||
8.66.e: Indra, we are your, therefore we, your worshippers, depend on you; other than you, Maghavan, invokedof many, there is no giver of happiness.

8.66.d: तवं नो अस्या अमतेरुत कषुधो.अभिशस्तेरव सप्र्धि | तवं न उती तव चित्रया धिया शिक्षा शचिष्ठ गातुवित ||
8.66.e: Deliver from us this poverty, hunger and calumny; give us (our desire) by your protection and wondrousworking; O mightiest, you know the right way.

8.66.d: सोम इद वः सुतो अस्तु कलयो मा बिभीतन | अपेदेष धवस्मायति सवयं घैषो अपायति ||
8.66.e: Let your effused Soma be only (for Indra); O sons of Kali, fear not; that malignant (spirit) departs, of hisown accord he departs.
